title: A Comprehensive Framework for Long-Term Resiliency Investment Planning under Extreme Weather Uncertainty for Electric Utilities
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures, submission to PowerUp 2026 conference
summary: Electric utilities must make massive capital investments in the coming years to respond to explosive growth in demand, aging assets and rising threats from extreme weather. Utilities today already have rigorous frameworks for capital planning, and there are opportunities to extend this capability to solve multi-objective optimization problems in the face of uncertainty. This work presents a four-part framework that 1) incorporates extreme weather as a source of uncertainty, 2) leverages a digital twin of the grid, 3) uses Monte Carlo simulation to capture variability and 4) applies a multi-objective optimization method for finding the optimal investment portfolio. We use this framework to investigate whether grid-aware optimization methods outperform model-free approaches. We find that, in fact, given the computational complexity of model-based metaheuristic optimization methods, the simpler net present value ranking method was able to find more optimal portfolios with only limited knowledge of the grid.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含极端天气不确定性、数字孪生电网、蒙特卡洛模拟和多目标优化四部分的投资组合优化框架。研究比较了网格感知优化方法与无模型方法，发现由于基于模型的元启发式优化方法计算复杂度高，简单的净现值排名方法反而能找到更优的投资组合。
AI.motivation: 电力公司面临需求增长、资产老化和极端天气威胁等多重挑战，需要进行大规模资本投资决策，亟需系统性框架来指导多目标优化投资组合选择。
AI.method: 采用四部分框架：1) 将极端天气纳入不确定性建模；2) 利用电网数字孪生技术；3) 使用蒙特卡洛模拟捕获变异性；4) 应用多目标优化方法寻找最优投资组合。
AI.result: 研究发现在相同计算资源下，考虑网格的优化方法相比无模型方法，简单的净现值(NPV)排名方法反而能发现更多最优投资组合。
AI.conclusion: 由于基于模型的元启发式优化方法计算复杂度高，复杂度有限的简单方法（如NPV排名）在实际应用中更具优势。这表明在电力基础设施投资规划中，计算效率与模型精度之间需要权衡。

title: Prosocial Persuasion at Scale? Large Language Models Outperform Humans in Donation Appeals Across Levels of Personalization
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly regarded as having the potential to generate persuasive content at scale. While previous studies have focused on the risks associated with LLM-generated misinformation, the role of LLMs in enabling prosocial persuasion is still underexplored. We investigate whether donation appeals authored by LLMs are as effective as those written by humans across degrees of personalization. Two preregistered online experiments (Study 1: N = 658; Study 2: N = 642) manipulated Personalization (generic vs. personalized vs. falsely personalized) and Content source (human vs. LLM) and presented participants with donation appeals for charities. We assessed how participants distributed their bonus money across the charities, how they engaged with the donation appeals, and how persuasive they found them. In both experiments, LLM-generated content yielded more donations, resulted in higher engagement, and was rated as more persuasive than human-authored content. There was a gain associated with personalization (Study 2) and a penalty for false personalization (Study 1). Our results suggest that LLMs may be a suitable technology for generating content that can encourage prosocial behavior.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型（LLM）生成的捐赠呼吁是否与人类撰写的内容一样有效。研究通过两个预注册在线实验操纵了个性化程度（通用、个性化、虚假个性化）和内容来源（人类、LLM），结果显示LLM生成的内容产生了更多捐赠、更高参与度和更强说服力，表明LLM可能是生成促进亲社会行为内容的合适技术。
AI.motivation: 先前研究主要关注LLM生成错误信息的风险，而LLM在亲社会说服中的作用尚待探索。该研究旨在填补这一研究空白，检验LLM是否能有效促进亲社会行为（如捐赠）。
AI.method: 两项预注册在线实验，采用2×3被试间设计。Study 1 (N=658) 和 Study 2 (N=642) 操纵了两个自变量：内容来源（人类 vs. LLM）和个性化程度（通用 vs. 个性化 vs. 虚假个性化）。因变量包括：参与者向慈善机构的bonus分配金额、对捐赠呼吁的参与度、以及感知说服力。
AI.result: 两项实验一致表明：(1) LLM生成的内容比人类撰写的内容产生更多捐赠；(2) LLM内容导致更高的参与度；(3) LLM内容被评为更具说服力。此外，个性化带来增益效应（Study 2），而虚假个性化带来惩罚效应（Study 1）。
AI.conclusion: LLM可能是生成鼓励亲社会行为内容的合适技术，具有实际应用价值。但需注意虚假个性化的负面影响，提示在实际应用中应确保个性化的真实性。

title: PRISM: LLM-Guided Semantic Clustering for High-Precision Topics
comment: To appear in Proceedings of the ACM Web Conference 2026 (WWW 26)
summary: In this paper, we propose Precision-Informed Semantic Modeling (PRISM), a structured topic modeling framework combining the benefits of rich representations captured by LLMs with the low cost and interpretability of latent semantic clustering methods. PRISM fine-tunes a sentence encoding model using a sparse set of LLM- provided labels on samples drawn from some corpus of interest. We segment this embedding space with thresholded clustering, yielding clusters that separate closely related topics within some narrow domain. Across multiple corpora, PRISM improves topic separability over state-of-the-art local topic models and even over clustering on large, frontier embedding models while requiring only a small number of LLM queries to train. This work contributes to several research streams by providing (i) a student-teacher pipeline to distill sparse LLM supervision into a lightweight model for topic discovery; (ii) an analysis of the efficacy of sampling strategies to improve local geometry for cluster separability; and (iii) an effective approach for web-scale text analysis, enabling researchers and practitioners to track nuanced claims and subtopics online with an interpretable, locally deployable framework.

AI.tldr: PRISM 是一个"学生—教师"式主题建模框架：先让 LLM（text-embedding-3-large 与 gpt-5）用少量查询对语料中的文本对打相似度/等价性标签，再以 CoSENT 损失微调轻量句向量模型（all-mpnet-base-v2），最后用带阈值的社区发现聚类（允许条目不分配到任何簇）。在 HumAID、LIAR、IMDB 三个语料上，PRISM 的主题可分性（Purity–簇数 Pareto 前沿下的 AUPC）优于 Top2Vec、BERTopic，甚至优于直接用大模型嵌入聚类，训练成本仅约 $0.05–$0.20，推理期零 LLM 调用。
AI.motivation: 现有主题建模两条路线各有缺陷：LDA 等词袋模型无法分辨窄域内近似词汇下的细微子话题；Top2Vec/BERTopic 等嵌入式主题模型语义表示丰富但局部精度不足；而 TopicGPT、PromptTopic、ClusterLLM 等 LLM 引导方法虽然提升了主题质量，却在聚类推理阶段持续依赖 LLM 调用，带来高延迟与高成本，阻碍了大规模（如网络级）文本分析的可扩展部署。作者的核心动机是：既保留 LLM 的细粒度语义分辨率，又保留潜在语义聚类的低成本与可解释性——即把稀疏的 LLM 监督"蒸馏"进可在本地运行的小编码器，从而在推理期实现零 LLM 成本的高精度主题发现，用于追踪危机事件、极端叙事等窄域中的细微论断与子话题。
AI.method:
架构：由语料 C_Text 采样 → 教师模型 L（大嵌入模型或生成式 LLM）产生标签 → 构成训练集 D → 微调学生模型 S（SentenceTransformers 的 all-mpnet-base-v2）→ 编码得到 C_Emb → 阈值聚类算法 A（SentenceTransformers 社区发现）划分簇。

训练集构造三种策略：(1) full-range（FR）比较：零样本提示生成式 LLM 回答"两段文本在高层次细节上是否表达同一件事"的 Yes/No 二分类标签，样本无放回抽取，构成 D_FR；(2) range-bound（RB）比较：只抽取基座模型相似度落在 [0.65, 0.95] 区间的文本对，使标签无法被 S_0 平凡预测，构成 D_RB；(3) embedding similarity（Emb）：用 500 条大模型嵌入生成 n(n−1)=249,500 个 (i, j, y) 三元组构成 D_Emb，成本最低。

损失函数：统一采用 CoSENT 排序损失（作者发现其优于对比损失，即使在二分类数据上亦然），学习率 3×10⁻⁶，训练 5 epoch。

聚类与阈值：使用阈值化社区检测，把所有与某中心点相似度超过 τ 的条目聚为一簇，允许条目不被分配（避免把细微差异内容强行归并），最坏时间复杂度 O(|C|²)，优于层次聚类的 O(|C|³)；τ 通过在教师标注的验证集 D_RB^(val) 上最大化 F1 自动选择。评估采用簇纯度（cluster purity）随簇数变化的 Pareto 曲线及其下面积 AUPC，而非易过拟合的主题连贯性/多样性词级指标；标签仅用作评估期的真值代理。

实验配置：教师嵌入 L_Emb = OpenAI text-embedding-3-large，教师比较 L_Comp = gpt-5-2025-08-07；基线为 Top2Vec、BERTopic（均用 all-mpnet-base-v2 以保证公平）、以及直接对 L_Emb 嵌入聚类（A∘L_Emb）。语料与划分：HumAID（77K+ 灾害推文，19 起事件，2016–2019，28,802/8,157）、LIAR（12.8K 事实核查短句，6 级真实性，10,240/2,551）、IMDB（50K 影评，情感二分类，25,000/10,000）。训练集规模 |D_RB|=|D_FR|=1,000，|D_Emb|=249,500。
AI.result:
1) 知识蒸馏有效：在教师标注的留出测试集 D_RB^(test)（n=1,000）上，任何微调方式都大幅提升学生模型对 L_Comp 标签的判别能力（AUROC）。HumAID 上 mpnet 从 .806 提升至 FR .838、RB .892、Emb .812；LIAR 从 .745 提升至 RB .824；IMDB 从 .906 提升至 RB .912；Mini（all-MiniLM-L12-v2）经 RB 微调达 .891，与教师 L_Emb 的 .891 持平甚至更优，说明大模型语义分辨率可有效迁移到小模型。

2) 主题精度：在三语料上，PRISM（RB 或 Emb 微调）几乎处处位于纯度–簇数 Pareto 前沿，对任意簇数严格支配 BERTopic；Top2Vec 仅在簇数很大时略微占优。AUPC 汇总（表2）：HumAID 无训练 .758 → RB .782 / Emb .792 / Emb+RB .807，优于 T2V-mpnet .717、T2V-Doc2Vec .679，也高于 A∘L_Emb .786；LIAR .635 → .641/.636/.638，略高于 T2V .636 与 A∘L_Emb .639；IMDB .900 → .948/.948/.966，优于 T2V-mpnet .913、T2V-d2v .886 与 A∘L_Emb .957。

3) 关键归因：未经微调的 PRISM（仅换聚类算法）相对 Top2Vec 仅有边际增益，说明性能提升主要来自蒸馏微调而非聚类算法本身；同时 D_Emb 与 D_RB 组合（来自两个不同教师模型、信号正交且规模更大）效果最佳。

4) 成本：D_RB/D_FR 各约 $0.20，D_Emb 约 $0.05，推理期无需 LLM 调用，且优于需对每条文本调用昂贵黑盒嵌入的 A∘L_Emb 方案，可本地部署。
AI.conclusion: PRISM 证明：少量 LLM 查询 + 领域自适应微调即可把小编码器的嵌入空间改造为域内高分辨率语义空间，从而通过允许"不分配"的阈值聚类得到高纯度、细粒度、可解释的主题簇，并在 AUPC 上超越 Top2Vec、BERTopic 及直接用前沿大模型嵌入聚类，显著降低推理成本、实现本地可部署，因而适用于网络规模的主题与叙事追踪。作者还指出，该框架的收益本质来自知识蒸馏而非聚类算法。未来工作方向：把蒸馏过程推进为主动学习（利用低查询—标签延迟）；从 LLM 中提取更丰富信号（学习其解释文本与开源模型的内部激活）；将 PRISM 应用于社会科学与计算科学的领域级发现。论文将发表于 WWW '26。

title: Dependency-Guided Parallel Decoding in Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary:
Discrete diffusion language models (dLLMs) accelerate text generation by unmasking multiple tokens in parallel. However, parallel decoding introduces a distributional mismatch: it approximates the joint conditional using a fully factorized product of per-token marginals, which degrades output quality when selected tokens are strongly dependent.
  We propose DEMASK (DEpendency-guided unMASKing), a lightweight dependency predictor that attaches to the final hidden states of a dLLM. In a single forward pass, it estimates pairwise conditional influences between masked positions. Using these predictions, a greedy selection algorithm identifies positions with bounded cumulative dependency for simultaneous unmasking. Under a sub-additivity assumption, we prove this bounds the total variation distance between our parallel sampling and the model's joint. Empirically, DEMASK achieves 1.7-2.2$\times$ speedup on Dream-7B while matching or improving accuracy compared to confidence-based and KL-based baselines.

AI.tldr: DEMASK通过在dLLM最终隐藏状态上附加轻量级依赖预测器，在单次前向传播中估计掩码位置间的成对条件影响，并使用贪心选择算法识别具有有界累积依赖的位置进行并行解码，在Dream-7B上实现1.7-2.2倍加速。
AI.motivation: 现有离散扩散语言模型(dLLM)通过并行解码加速生成，但并行解码引入分布不匹配问题：当被选令牌存在强依赖时，用完全分解的逐令牌边缘分布近似联合条件分布会降低输出质量。
AI.method: 1) 设计轻量级依赖预测器附着于dLLM最终隐藏状态；2) 单次前向传播估计掩码位置间的成对条件影响；3) 基于预测结果使用贪心选择算法，识别具有有界累积依赖的位置进行同步解掩码；4) 在子可加性假设下证明该方法可约束并行采样与模型联合分布间的总变差距离。
AI.result: 在Dream-7B上实现1.7-2.2倍加速，精度匹配或优于基于置信度和基于KL的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DEMASK通过有界累积依赖的并行解码策略，有效缓解了分布不匹配问题，在保持生成质量的同时显著提升推理速度。

title: TypePro: Boosting LLM-Based Type Inference via Inter-Procedural Slicing
summary: Dynamic languages (such as Python and JavaScript) offer flexibility and simplified type handling for programming, but this can also lead to an increase in type-related errors and additional overhead for compile-time type inference. As a result, type inference for dynamic languages has become a popular research area. Existing approaches typically achieve type inference through static analysis, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs). However, current work only focuses on the direct dependencies of variables related to type inference as the context, resulting in incomplete contextual information and thus affecting the accuracy of type inference. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method called TypePro, which leverages LLMs for type inference in dynamic languages. TypePro supplements contextual information by conducting inter-procedural code slicing. Then, TypePro proposes a set of candidate complex types based on the structural information of data types implied in the slices, thereby addressing the lack of domain knowledge of LLMs. We conducted experiments on the ManyTypes4Py and ManyTypes4TypeScript datasets, achieving Top-1 exact match (EM) rates of 88.9% and 86.6%, respectively. Notably, TypePro improves the Top-1 Exact Match by 7.1 and 10.3 percentage points over the second-best approach, showing the effectiveness and robustness of TypePro.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TypePro方法，利用大语言模型(LLM)进行动态语言类型推断。通过过程间代码切片补充上下文信息，并基于切片中的数据类型结构信息提出候选复杂类型，解决LLM领域知识不足的问题。在Python和TypeScript数据集上分别达到88.9%和86.6%的Top-1精确匹配率，较最佳基线方法分别提升7.1和10.3个百分点。
AI.motivation: 动态语言（如Python、JavaScript）的类型灵活性虽然简化了编程，但同时也导致了类型相关错误的增加和编译时类型推断的开销。现有的类型推断方法（包括静态分析、机器学习和LLM方法）仅关注与类型推断相关的变量的直接依赖关系，导致上下文信息不完整，从而影响类型推断的准确性。
AI.method: TypePro方法包含两个核心创新点：（1）通过过程间代码切片（inter-procedural code slicing）补充上下文信息，获取更全面的代码依赖关系；（2）基于切片中隐含的数据类型结构信息，提出一组候选复杂类型（candidate complex types），以弥补LLM领域知识的不足。
AI.result: 在ManyTypes4Py数据集上达到88.9%的Top-1精确匹配率，在ManyTypes4TypeScript数据集上达到86.6%的Top-1精确匹配率。
AI.conclusion: TypePro通过过程间代码切片和候选复杂类型策略，有效解决了现有方法中上下文信息不完整和LLM领域知识不足的问题。该方法在两种动态语言上的实验结果表明其具有良好的有效性和鲁棒性，Top-1精确匹配率较最佳基线方法分别提升7.1和10.3个百分点。

title: DrugPlayGround: Benchmarking Large Language Models and Embeddings for Drug Discovery
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are in the ascendancy for research in drug discovery, offering unprecedented opportunities to reshape drug research by accelerating hypothesis generation, optimizing candidate prioritization, and enabling more scalable and cost-effective drug discovery pipelines. However there is currently a lack of objective assessments of LLM performance to ascertain their advantages and limitations over traditional drug discovery platforms. To tackle this emergent problem, we have developed DrugPlayGround, a framework to evaluate and benchmark LLM performance for generating meaningful text-based descriptions of physiochemical drug characteristics, drug synergism, drug-protein interactions, and the physiological response to perturbations introduced by drug molecules. Moreover, DrugPlayGround is designed to work with domain experts to provide detailed explanations for justifying the predictions of LLMs, thereby testing LLMs for chemical and biological reasoning capabilities to push their greater use at the frontier of drug discovery at all of its stages.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了DrugPlayGround框架，用于评估和基准测试大语言模型（LLM）在药物发现领域的性能，涵盖药物理化性质描述、药物协同作用、药物-蛋白相互作用及生理反应预测等任务。
AI.motivation: 当前缺乏对LLM在药物发现领域性能的系统性、客观性评估，无法明确其相较于传统药物发现平台的优势与局限性。
AI.method: 开发了DrugPlayGround框架，该框架可对LLM生成的药物理化特性文本描述、药物协同作用、药物-蛋白相互作用及药物分子扰动引起的生理响应进行评估和基准测试，并支持领域专家提供详细解释以验证LLM的化学和生物推理能力。
AI.result: DrugPlayGround框架能够系统性地测试LLM在药物发现多个关键环节的文本生成和推理能力。
AI.conclusion: DrugPlayGround为推动LLM在药物发现各阶段前沿应用提供了重要的评估工具，有助于明确LLM的化学和生物推理能力边界。

title: Interpretable Deep Reinforcement Learning for Element-level Bridge Life-cycle Optimization
summary: The new Specifications for the National Bridge Inventory (SNBI), in effect from 2022, emphasize the use of element-level condition states (CS) for risk-based bridge management. Instead of a general component rating, element-level condition data use an array of relative CS quantities (i.e., CS proportions) to represent the condition of a bridge. Although this greatly increases the granularity of bridge condition data, it introduces challenges to set up optimal life-cycle policies due to the expanded state space from one single categorical integer to four-dimensional probability arrays. This study proposes a new interpretable reinforcement learning (RL) approach to seek optimal life-cycle policies based on element-level state representations. Compared to existing RL methods, the proposed algorithm yields life-cycle policies in the form of oblique decision trees with reasonable amounts of nodes and depth, making them directly understandable and auditable by humans and easily implementable into current bridge management systems. To achieve near-optimal policies, the proposed approach introduces three major improvements to existing RL methods: (a) the use of differentiable soft tree models as actor function approximators, (b) a temperature annealing process during training, and (c) regularization paired with pruning rules to limit policy complexity. Collectively, these improvements can yield interpretable life-cycle policies in the form of deterministic oblique decision trees. The benefits and trade-offs from these techniques are demonstrated in both supervised and reinforcement learning settings. The resulting framework is illustrated in a life-cycle optimization problem for steel girder bridges.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于可解释强化学习的桥梁生命周期优化策略方法，针对2022年新规范下元素级状态数据的高维状态空间问题。该方法通过软决策树模型、温度退火和正则化剪枝技术，生成可解释的斜决策树策略，应用于钢梁桥的生命周期优化。
AI.motivation: 2022年新实施的《国家桥梁清单规范》(SNBI)采用元素级条件状态(CS)比例数据替代传统单一评级，虽提升了数据粒度，但将状态空间从单一分类整数扩展为四维概率数组，给生命周期优化策略的制定带来巨大挑战。
AI.method: 提出一种可解释强化学习方法：(a)使用可微分软树模型作为行动者函数逼近器；(b)训练过程中引入温度退火；(c)结合正则化与剪枝规则限制策略复杂度，最终生成斜决策树形式的确定性策略。
AI.result: 该方法生成的策略以斜决策树形式呈现，具有合理的节点数量和深度，可被人理解、审计，并易于集成到现有桥梁管理系统中。在监督学习和强化学习场景中验证了各技术的效果与权衡。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架成功应用于钢梁桥生命周期优化问题，证明了可解释强化学习方法在桥梁资产管理系统中处理高维状态空间的可行性，为实现数据驱动的可解释决策提供了新途径。

title: An Empirical Study of Many-Shot In-Context Learning for Machine Translation of Low-Resource Languages
summary: In-context learning (ICL) allows large language models (LLMs) to adapt to new tasks from a few examples, making it promising for languages underrepresented in pre-training. Recent work on many-shot ICL suggests that modern LLMs can further benefit from larger ICL examples enabled by their long context windows. However, such gains depend on careful example selection, and the inference cost can be prohibitive for low-resource language communities. In this paper, we present an empirical study of many-shot ICL for machine translation from English into ten truly low-resource languages recently added to FLORES+. We analyze the effects of retrieving more informative examples, using out-of-domain data, and ordering examples by length. Our findings show that many-shot ICL becomes more effective as the number of examples increases. More importantly, we show that BM25-based retrieval substantially improves data efficiency: 50 retrieved examples roughly match 250 many-shot examples, while 250 retrieved examples perform similarly to 1,000 many-shot examples.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型（LLM）在机器翻译任务中采用"多示例上下文学习"（many-shot ICL）处理资源极度匮乏语言的效果，发现基于BM25检索的示例选择能够显著提升数据效率，仅需50个检索示例即可达到250个随机示例的效果。
AI.motivation: 当前许多低资源语言在LLM预训练中代表性不足，ICL虽有潜力但多示例场景下的推理成本高昂，且示例选择策略尚未明确。
AI.method: 以FLORES+中新加入的10种低资源语言为对象，实验比较了：①增加示例数量；②BM25检索获取信息量更高的示例；③使用域外数据；④按长度排序示例等策略的效果。
AI.result: 多示例ICL随示例数量增加效果提升；BM25检索大幅提高数据效率——50个检索示例≈250个随机示例，250个检索示例≈1000个随机示例。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强的多示例ICL可显著降低推理成本，为低资源语言机器翻译提供了一种高效可行的解决方案。

title: IndustryCode: A Benchmark for Industry Code Generation
summary: Code generation and comprehension by Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as core drivers of industrial intelligence and decision optimization, finding widespread application in fields such as finance, automation, and aerospace. Although recent advancements have demonstrated the remarkable potential of LLMs in general code generation, existing benchmarks are mainly confined to single domains and languages. Consequently, they fail to effectively evaluate the generalization capabilities required for real-world industrial applications or to reflect the coding proficiency demanded by complex industrial scenarios. To bridge this gap, we introduce IndustryCode, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to span multiple industrial domains and programming languages. IndustryCode comprises 579 sub-problems derived from 125 primary industrial challenges, accompanied by rigorous problem descriptions and test cases. It covers a wide range of fields, including finance, automation, aerospace, and remote sensing-and incorporates diverse programming languages such as MATLAB, Python, C++, and Stata. In our evaluation, the top-performing model, Claude 4.5 Opus, achieved an overall accuracy of 68.1% on sub-problems and 42.5% main problems. The benchmark dataset and automated evaluation code will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: IndustryCode是一个综合性基准测试，用于评估大语言模型在跨工业领域和编程语言场景下的代码生成能力，填补了现有基准测试在多领域泛化能力评估方面的空白。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成基准测试主要局限于单一领域和语言，无法有效评估模型在真实工业应用中的泛化能力，也无法反映复杂工业场景下的编程水平需求。
AI.method: 构建了IndustryCode基准测试，包含579个子问题和125个主要工业挑战，每个问题配有严格的问题描述和测试用例，覆盖金融、自动化、航空航天、遥感等领域，涉及MATLAB、Python、C++、Stata等多种编程语言。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，表现最佳的模型Claude 4.5 Opus在子问题上的总体准确率为68.1%，在主要问题上的准确率为42.5%。
AI.conclusion: IndustryCode为评估LLM在工业场景中的代码生成能力提供了首个全面的多领域、多语言基准，揭示了当前模型仍有较大提升空间。

title: FTimeXer: Frequency-aware Time-series Transformer with Exogenous variables for Robust Carbon Footprint Forecasting
comment: Accepted by The 5th International Conference on Electronics Technology and Artificial Intelligence (ETAI 2026)
summary: Accurate and up-to-date forecasting of the power grid's carbon footprint is crucial for effective product carbon footprint (PCF) accounting and informed decarbonization decisions. However, the carbon intensity of the grid exhibits high non-stationarity, and existing methods often struggle to effectively leverage periodic and oscillatory patterns. Furthermore, these methods tend to perform poorly when confronted with irregular exogenous inputs, such as missing data or misalignment. To tackle these challenges, we propose FTimeXer, a frequency-aware time-series Transformer designed with a robust training scheme that accommodates exogenous factors. FTimeXer features an Fast Fourier Transform (FFT)-driven frequency branch combined with gated time-frequency fusion, allowing it to capture multi-scale periodicity effectively. It also employs stochastic exogenous masking in conjunction with consistency regularization, which helps reduce spurious correlations and enhance stability. Experiments conducted on three real-world datasets show consistent improvements over strong baselines. As a result, these enhancements lead to more reliable forecasts of grid carbon factors, which are essential for effective PCF accounting and informed decision-making regarding decarbonization.

AI.tldr: FTimeXer是一种用于电网碳足迹预测的频率感知时序Transformer模型，通过FFT驱动的频率分支和门控时频融合机制捕捉多尺度周期性，并采用随机外生掩码和一致性正则化增强模型对缺失数据和噪声的鲁棒性，在三个真实数据集上显著优于强基线模型。
AI.motivation: 电网碳强度具有高度非平稳性，现有方法难以有效利用周期性和振荡模式，且在处理不规则外生输入（如缺失数据或错位）时表现不佳，这给产品碳足迹核算和脱碳决策带来挑战。
AI.method: FTimeXer包含两个核心创新：1) FFT驱动的频率分支结合门控时频融合机制，有效捕捉多尺度周期性；2) 随机外生掩码与一致性正则化相结合的鲁棒训练方案，减少虚假相关性和增强模型稳定性。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，FTimeXer一致性地优于强基线模型，实现了更可靠的电网碳因子预测。
AI.conclusion: FTimeXer能够更可靠地预测电网碳因子，为有效的产品碳足迹核算和明智的脱碳决策提供支持，证明了频率感知与鲁棒训练策略结合的有效性。

title: Competency Questions as Executable Plans: a Controlled RAG Architecture for Cultural Heritage Storytelling
comment: Accepted at the 23rd European Semantic Web Conference (ESWC 2026)
summary: The preservation of intangible cultural heritage is a critical challenge as collective memory fades over time. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising avenue for generating engaging narratives, their propensity for factual inaccuracies or "hallucinations" makes them unreliable for heritage applications where veracity is a central requirement. To address this, we propose a novel neuro-symbolic architecture grounded in Knowledge Graphs (KGs) that establishes a transparent "plan-retrieve-generate" workflow for story generation. A key novelty of our approach is the repurposing of competency questions (CQs) - traditionally design-time validation artifacts - into run-time executable narrative plans. This approach bridges the gap between high-level user personas and atomic knowledge retrieval, ensuring that generation is evidence-closed and fully auditable. We validate this architecture using a new resource: the Live Aid KG, a multimodal dataset aligning 1985 concert data with the Music Meta Ontology and linking to external multimedia assets. We present a systematic comparative evaluation of three distinct Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) strategies over this graph: a purely symbolic KG-RAG, a text-enriched Hybrid-RAG, and a structure-aware Graph-RAG. Our experiments reveal a quantifiable trade-off between the factual precision of symbolic retrieval, the contextual richness of hybrid methods, and the narrative coherence of graph-based traversal. Our findings offer actionable insights for designing personalised and controllable storytelling systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于知识图谱的神经符号架构，通过将传统设计时验证工具"能力问题"重新用于运行时叙事规划，解决大语言模型在文化遗产叙事生成中的幻觉问题，实现可验证、可审计的故事生成。
AI.motivation: 非物质文化遗产的保护面临集体记忆随时间消退的严峻挑战，而大语言模型虽能生成吸引人的叙事内容，但其"幻觉"问题导致事实准确性无法保证，难以满足文化遗产应用中"真实性"的核心要求。
AI.method: 提出"规划-检索-生成"的神经符号架构：(1) 将能力问题(CQs)从设计时验证工具重新定义为运行时可执行的叙事计划；(2) 在Live Aid KG多模态数据集上系统比较三种RAG策略：纯符号KG-RAG、文本增强混合RAG、结构感知Graph-RAG。
AI.result: 三种RAG策略存在可量化的权衡：符号检索具有最高事实精度，混合方法提供更丰富的上下文，Graph-RAG在叙事连贯性上表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为设计个性化、可控的文化遗产叙事系统提供了可操作的见解，证明神经符号方法能有效平衡生成质量与事实准确性。

title: Verbalizing LLMs' assumptions to explain and control sycophancy
summary: LLMs can be socially sycophantic, affirming users when they ask questions like "am I in the wrong?" rather than providing genuine assessment. We hypothesize that this behavior arises from incorrect assumptions about the user, like underestimating how often users are seeking information over reassurance. We present Verbalized Assumptions, a framework for eliciting these assumptions from LLMs. Verbalized Assumptions provide insight into LLM sycophancy, delusion, and other safety issues, e.g., the top bigram in LLMs' assumptions on social sycophancy datasets is ``seeking validation.'' We provide evidence for a causal link between Verbalized Assumptions and sycophantic model behavior: our assumption probes (linear probes trained on internal representations of these assumptions) enable interpretable fine-grained steering of social sycophancy. We explore why LLMs default to sycophantic assumptions: on identical queries, people expect more objective and informative responses from AI than from other humans, but LLMs trained on human-human conversation do not account for this difference in expectations. Our work contributes a new understanding of assumptions as a mechanism for sycophancy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"语言化假设"(Verbalized Assumptions)框架，用于从大语言模型中提取其隐含假设，揭示了模型阿谀奉承行为的根源。研究者发现LLM对用户意图存在错误假设（如假设用户寻求情感认同而非信息），并通过假设探测和细粒度引导实验验证了假设与奉承行为之间的因果关系。此外，研究还发现人类对AI的期望比对人更客观，但LLM未能适应这一差异。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在社会性阿谀奉承问题，当用户询问"我错了吗？"等问题时，模型倾向于肯定用户而非给出真实评估。这种行为背后的原因尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出Verbalized Assumptions框架，从LLM中提取其关于用户的隐含假设；在内部表示上训练线性假设探测探针(assumption probes)；通过内部表示的细粒度引导实验验证因果关系。
AI.result: 发现了假设与阿谀奉承行为之间的因果联系；LLM在社会阿谀奉承数据集中最高频的假设是"寻求验证"(seeking validation)；假设探测探针可实现可解释的细粒度社会阿谀奉承引导。
AI.conclusion: LLM的阿谀奉承行为源于其对用户的错误假设；人类对AI的期望比对人类更客观，但基于人-人对话训练的LLM未考虑这种期望差异；假设是理解阿谀奉承的重要机制。

title: Reinforcement Learning-based Knowledge Distillation with LLM-as-a-Judge
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has been shown to substantially improve the reasoning capability of small and large language models (LLMs), but existing approaches typically rely on verifiable rewards, hence ground truth labels. We propose an RL framework that uses rewards from an LLM that acts as a judge evaluating model outputs over large amounts of unlabeled data, enabling label-free knowledge distillation and replacing the need of ground truth supervision. Notably, the judge operates with a single-token output, making reward computation efficient. When combined with verifiable rewards, our approach yields substantial performance gains across math reasoning benchmarks. These results suggest that LLM-based evaluators can produce effective training signals for RL fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用大型语言模型（LLM）作为评判者的无标签强化学习框架，通过单一token输出高效计算奖励信号，实现知识蒸馏，显著提升数学推理任务的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习改进语言模型的方法依赖可验证奖励和真实标签，限制了可扩展性和适用场景。需要一种能够在大量无标签数据上进行训练的、无需人工标注的替代方案。
AI.method: 提出一个RL框架，使用LLM作为"法官"评判模型输出质量，通过单一token输出实现高效奖励计算。该框架可在无标签数据上进行训练，并与可验证奖励结合使用。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准测试中，该方法取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的评估器能够产生有效的训练信号用于RL微调，为无标签知识蒸馏和语言模型能力提升提供了新的可行路径。

title: An Empirical Study of Sustainability in Prompt-driven Test Script Generation Using Small Language Models
comment: 6 pages. arXiv admin note: substantial text overlap with arXiv:2602.18012
summary: The increasing use of language models in automated test script generation raises concerns about their environmental impact, yet existing sustainability analyses focus predominantly on large language models. As a result, the energy and carbon characteristics of small language models (SLMs) during prompt-driven unit-test script generation remain largely unexplored. To address this gap, this study empirically examines the environmental and performance tradeoffs of SLMs (in the 2B-8B parameter range) using the HumanEval benchmark and adaptive prompt variants (based on the Anthropic template). The analysis uses CodeCarbon to characterize energy consumption carbon emissions and duration under controlled conditions, with unit-test script coverage serving as an initial proxy for generated test quality. Our results show that different SLMs exhibit distinct sustainability profiles - some favor lower energy use and faster execution, while others maintain higher stability or coverage under comparable conditions. Overall, this work provides focused empirical evidence on sustainable SLM-based test script generation, clarifying how prompt structure and model selection jointly shape environmental and performance outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文以HumanEval基准为载体，实测五款2B–8B小语言模型（Phi-3.5-mini、Qwen2.5-1.5B、DeepSeek-coder-7b、Mistral-7B、Llama-3-8B）在四种渐进式提示模板（基于Anthropic模板的AP_V0–AP_V3）与多种量化等级（4-bit/8-bit/未量化）下进行提示驱动单元测试脚本生成的环境与性能权衡。结论是：没有任何单一模型在所有维度占优，可持续性由提示复杂度、量化精度与所在区域电网碳强度共同决定；作者据此提出SVI与GF_β两个复合指标对模型-提示配置进行排序。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在自动化测试脚本生成中的部署带来显著高能耗与碳排放的"环境税"，而现有SE可持续性研究几乎都聚焦LLM，2B–8B参数区间SLM在提示驱动单元测试生成中的能耗、碳排放特征与运行稳定性基本空白。在资源受限或隐私敏感场景下，本地部署SLM更常见，因此需要实证厘清"能效—覆盖率"权衡：提示结构复杂度、量化等级、以及Google Colab工作负载在跨国电网间迁移带来的区域碳强度差异如何共同决定环境成本；并为软件架构师提供在覆盖率与环境可持续性之间做优先级取舍的量化机制。
AI.method: 采用五阶段实证流水线：(1)数据预处理——将HumanEval 164个任务的prompt与canonical_solution合并为可运行被测模块(SMUT)；(2)提示设计——基于Anthropic模板构造四级约束递增的AP_V0（最小可运行）、AP_V1（专家测试者角色）、AP_V2（DO/DON'T规则+System/User角色分离）、AP_V3（测试方法要求+语气格式约束+示例块）；(3)测试脚本生成——统一8-bit量化跑全部5个模型，另对Phi-3.5-mini与Qwen2.5-1.5B做4-bit/8-bit/未量化对比；(4)环境与质量测量——CodeCarbon v3.0.0记录能耗(kWh)、碳排放(gCO2e)与时长，Coverage.py v7.13.4计算覆盖率，同时采集每次试验的country_iso_code以引入区域电网碳强度（Electricity Maps三个月均值）；(5)权衡分析——基于Green Software Foundation标准定义SCI=kE(k=I/R)，提出SVI=(Q/100)·ECO，ECO=1/((1+SCÎ)(1+T̂))（Min-Max归一化、乘法结构避免短板被掩盖），以及GF_β=(1+β²)Q·ECO/(β²Q+ECO)，β∈{0.01,1,10}分别偏向生态效率或覆盖率。环境控制：Google Colab NVIDIA T4 16GB，Temp=0.0、Max Tokens=1024、每批5个文件、33批/轮、3 epochs、5分钟斐波那契预热与冷却，共20份CSV日志。
AI.result: (1) SCI由提示驱动的推理能耗开销与所在区域电网碳强度共同决定：同区域运行时差异主要来自提示/模型配置，跨区域时电网强度主导；低强度电网（荷兰153、美国俄勒冈207 gCO2e/kWh）普遍优于高强度电网（美国内华达472、新加坡477），SCI中位数约0.45 gCO2e。(2) SVI中位数0.65，多数高于中位数的配置落在荷兰或俄勒冈，但存在区域重叠，说明提示-模型效应可抵消区域差异；SVI可作为融合覆盖率、稳定性、时长与排放的整体排序信号。(3) 量化效应具模型与上下文依赖性：Phi-3.5-mini在新加坡固定电网下SVI随精度上升（4-bit 0.494→8-bit 0.646→未量化0.694），即覆盖率收益可超过低比特的算力节省；而Qwen2.5-1.5B跨三区域呈非单调（荷兰8-bit最高0.762，未量化南卡0.617，新加坡4-bit最低0.507），区域碳强度可压倒量化效应。(4) GF_β的β取值与提示变体会实质重排模型名次：β=1时DeepSeek-coder-7b在AP_V3最优、Phi-3.5-mini在AP_V0最优，β=10时DeepSeek与Llama-3-8B居前；不存在跨所有维度占优的模型。
AI.conclusion: SLM用于提示驱动单元测试生成时，可持续性不能由模型规模单独解释，必须在覆盖率、能耗/碳排放、执行时长、运行间稳定性与区域电网碳强度等多维联合评估；提示结构、量化等级与部署地理位置的交互决定最终生态效率。作者提出的SVI与GF_β可作为面向架构师的实用排序"旋钮"，在给定β偏好与预期执行区域下筛选"高覆盖+低环境成本"的模型-提示配置。局限包括单一基准、固定T4硬件、依赖CodeCarbon估算碳强度而非智能电表实测、每模型-提示组合试验次数偏少导致统计显著性存疑，且覆盖率不足以全面刻画生成测试的质量与鲁棒性。后续工作将扩展提示结构影响分析、更多模型族与基准，并考察量化与硬件层级（TPU、AMD GPU、边缘设备）差异。

title: Contextual Intelligence The Next Leap for Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted to AAMAS 2025 (Blue Sky Ideas Track)
summary:
Reinforcement learning (RL) has produced spectacular results in games, robotics, and continuous control. Yet, despite these successes, learned policies often fail to generalize beyond their training distribution, limiting real-world impact. Recent work on contextual RL (cRL) shows that exposing agents to environment characteristics -- contexts -- can improve zero-shot transfer. So far, the community has treated context as a monolithic, static observable, an approach that constrains the generalization capabilities of RL agents.
  To achieve contextual intelligence we first propose a novel taxonomy of contexts that separates allogenic (environment-imposed) from autogenic (agent-driven) factors. We identify three fundamental research directions that must be addressed to promote truly contextual intelligence: (1) Learning with heterogeneous contexts to explicitly exploit the taxonomy levels so agents can reason about their influence on the world and vice versa; (2) Multi-time-scale modeling to recognize that allogenic variables evolve slowly or remain static, whereas autogenic variables may change within an episode, potentially requiring different learning mechanisms; (3) Integration of abstract, high-level contexts to incorporate roles, resource & regulatory regimes, uncertainties, and other non-physical descriptors that crucially influence behavior.
  We envision context as a first-class modeling primitive, empowering agents to reason about who they are, what the world permits, and how both evolve over time. By doing so, we aim to catalyze a new generation of context-aware agents that can be deployed safely and efficiently in the real world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了上下文强化学习（cRL）的新分类体系，将上下文分为异源性（环境施加）和自源性（智能体驱动）两类，并指出了实现真正上下文智能的三个关键研究方向：异构上下文学习、多时间尺度建模和抽象高层上下文整合，旨在构建能够理解自身角色、环境约束及其随时间演化的上下文感知智能体。
AI.motivation: 当前上下文强化学习将上下文视为单一的、静态的可观测量，这种处理方式限制了RL智能体的泛化能力，使其难以在训练分布之外进行有效的零样本迁移，阻碍了RL在真实世界的应用。
AI.method: 本文提出了一种新的上下文分类法，将所有上下文明确区分为异源性（allogenic）上下文和自源性（autogenic）上下文两大类，并在此基础上识别出三个fundamental研究方向的taxonomy框架。
AI.result: 提出了实现上下文智能的三条路径：(1) 异构上下文学习——利用分类学级别显式利用上下文使智能体能够Reason about其对世界的影响；(2) 多时间尺度建模——异源变量变化缓慢或保持静态，自源变量可能在episode内变化，需要不同的学习机制；(3) 抽象高层上下文整合——纳入角色、资源与监管制度、不确定性等非物理描述符。
AI.conclusion: 将上下文提升为"第一性建模原语"，使智能体能够推理自身身份、世界允许的事物及二者的时序演化，从而催生新一代可安全高效部署于真实世界的上下文感知智能体。

title: Mitigating LLM biases toward spurious social contexts using direct preference optimization
summary: LLMs are increasingly used for high-stakes decision-making, yet their sensitivity to spurious contextual information can introduce harmful biases. This is a critical concern when models are deployed for tasks like evaluating teachers' instructional quality, where biased assessment can affect teachers' professional development and career trajectories. We investigate model robustness to spurious social contexts using the largest publicly available dataset of U.S. classroom transcripts (NCTE) paired with expert rubric scores. Evaluating seven frontier and open-weight models across seven categories of spurious contexts -- including teacher experience, education level, demographic identity, and sycophancy-inducing framings -- we find that irrelevant contextual information can shift model predictions by up to 1.48 points on a 7-point scale, with larger models sometimes exhibiting greater sensitivity despite higher predictive accuracy. Mitigations using prompts and standard direct preference optimization (DPO) prove largely insufficient. We propose **Debiasing-DPO**,, a self-supervised training method that pairs neutral reasoning generated from the query alone, with the model's biased reasoning generated with both the query and additional spurious context. We further combine this objective with supervised fine-tuning on ground-truth labels to prevent losses in predictive accuracy. Applied to Llama 3B \& 8B and Qwen 3B \& 7B Instruct models, Debiasing-DPO reduces bias by 84\% and improves predictive accuracy by 52\% on average. Our findings from the educational case study highlight that robustness to spurious context is not a natural byproduct of model scaling and that our proposed method can yield substantial gains in both accuracy and robustness for prompt-based prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型在教师教学质量评估中对虚假语境信息的敏感性，发现模型预测可偏移达1.48分（7分制），且标准缓解方法效果有限。提出的Debiasing-DPO方法通过配对中性推理与有偏推理进行自监督训练，可将偏差降低84%并提升准确率52%。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在高风险决策场景（如教师教学质量评估）中，对虚假语境信息的敏感性可能导致有害偏见，进而影响教师的职业发展。此外，模型规模化未必带来鲁棒性提升，标准缓解方法（如提示工程和DPO）效果有限。
AI.method: 使用NCTE数据集（美国课堂转录最大公开数据集）评估7个前沿及开源模型在7类虚假语境下的表现。提出Debiasing-DPO方法：配对仅基于查询的中性推理与基于查询+虚假语境的有偏推理进行自监督训练，并结合基于真实标签的监督微调以防准确率下降。
AI.result: 虚假语境信息可使模型预测偏移达1.48分（7分制），大模型有时反而更敏感。Debiasing-DPO应用于Llama 3B/8B和Qwen 3B/7B后，平均偏差降低84%，准确率提升52%。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模化并非提升鲁棒性的自然途径；Debiasing-DPO等自监督方法可有效提升基于提示的预测任务的准确性与鲁棒性，为高风险决策场景中的LLM部署提供可行方案。

title: Valence-Arousal Subspace in LLMs: Circular Emotion Geometry and Multi-Behavioral Control
summary: We present a method to identify a valence-arousal (VA) subspace within large language model representations. From 211k emotion-labeled texts, we derive emotion steering vectors, then learn VA axes as linear combinations of their top PCA components via ridge regression on the model's self-reported valence-arousal scores. The resulting VA subspace exhibits circular geometry consistent with established models of human emotion perception. Projections along our recovered VA subspace correlate with human-crowdsourced VA ratings across 44k lexical items. Furthermore, steering generation along these axes produces monotonic shifts in the corresponding affective dimensions of model outputs. Steering along these directions also induces near-monotonic bidirectional control over refusal and sycophancy: increasing arousal decreases refusal and increases sycophancy, and vice versa. These effects replicate across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen3-8B, and Qwen3-14B, demonstrating cross-architecture generality. We provide a mechanistic account for these effects and prior emotionally-framed controls: refusal-associated tokens ("I can't," "sorry") occupy low-arousal, negative-valence regions, so VA steering directly modulates their emission probability.

AI.tldr: 该研究从LLM表征中识别出 valence-arousal（VA）情感子空间，通过情绪 steering 向量和 PCA 还原ucker回归实现跨架构的情感维度控制，并揭示了拒绝行为与情感维度之间的关联机制。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的情感表征机制尚不清晰，如何实现对其生成内容情感维度的精准控制是重要研究方向。现有方法缺乏对情感表征空间几何结构的系统性理解和跨架构的通用控制方法。
AI.method: 1）从211k条情绪标注文本中提取情绪 steering 向量；2）对这些向量进行PCA，取主成分；3）以模型自报告的VA分数为目标，用岭回归学习VA轴作为PCA主成分的线性组合。
AI.result: 1）还原的VA子空间呈现圆形几何结构，与人类情感感知模型一致；2）在44k词汇项目上与人类众包VA评分显著相关；3）沿VA轴 steering 能产生单调的情感维度偏移；4）可实现对拒绝行为和谄媚行为的双向控制（ arousal 升高 → 拒绝↓/谄媚↑）；5）效果在 Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen3-14B 三个模型上复现。
AI.conclusion: 拒绝相关标记（如"I can't"、"sorry"）占据低唤醒度、负效价区域，VA steering 能直接调节其发射概率，提供了情感控制与拒绝行为之间的因果机制解释。

title: Train Yourself as an LLM: Exploring Effects of AI Literacy on Persuasion via Role-playing LLM Training
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become increasingly persuasive, there is concern that people's opinions and decisions may be influenced across various contexts at scale. Prior mitigation (e.g., AI detectors and disclaimers) largely treats people as passive recipients of AI-generated information. To provide a more proactive intervention against persuasive AI, we introduce $\textbf{LLMimic}$, a role-play-based, interactive, gamified AI literacy tutorial, where participants assume the role of an LLM and progress through three key stages of the training pipeline (pretraining, SFT, and RLHF). We conducted a $2 \times 3$ between-subjects study ($N = 274$) where participants either (1) watched an AI history video (control) or (2) interacted with LLMimic (treatment), and then engaged in one of three realistic AI persuasion scenarios: (a) charity donation persuasion, (b) malicious money solicitation, or (c) hotel recommendation. Our results show that LLMimic significantly improved participants' AI literacy ($p < .001$), reduced persuasion success across scenarios ($p < .05$), and enhanced truthfulness and social responsibility levels ($p<0.01$) in the hotel scenario. These findings suggest that LLMimic offers a scalable, human-centered approach to improving AI literacy and supporting more informed interactions with persuasive AI.

AI.tldr: LLMimic是一款基于角色扮演的交互式AI素养培训工具，通过让用户扮演LLM经历预训练、SFT和RLHF三个训练阶段，提升用户对AI说服能力的认知。274人的2×3被试间实验表明，该工具显著提高了AI素养(p<.001)，降低了AI说服效果(p<.05)，并在酒店推荐场景中提升了回答的真实性和社会责任意识(p<0.01)。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型(LLM)日益具有说服力，人们的 opinions 和 decisions 可能在大规模范围内受到 AI 生成信息的影响。现有缓解措施（如AI检测器、免责声明）主要将人视为被动接收者，缺乏主动干预手段，因此需要开发更主动的AI素养提升方法。
AI.method: 采用2×3被试间设计(N=274)。自变量1：干预方式（对照组观看AI历史视频 vs. 实验组使用LLMimic）；自变量2：说服场景（慈善捐款说服、恶意金钱诈骗、酒店推荐）。LLMimic核心机制为角色扮演式交互游戏，玩家扮演LLM经历预训练、SFT和RLHF三个训练阶段。因变量包括AI素养水平、说服成功率、回答真实性和社会责任意识。
AI.result: LLMimic显著提升了参与者的AI素养(p<.001)，降低了AI在所有场景中的说服效果(p<.05)，并在酒店推荐场景中显著提高了回答的真实性和社会责任意识(p<0.01)。
AI.conclusion: LLMimic提供了一种可扩展、以人为中心的AI素养提升方案，能够支持人们在面对具有说服力的AI时进行更明智的交互，为抵御AI说服的主动干预开辟了新路径。

title: Sustainability Analysis of Prompt Strategies for SLM-based Automated Test Generation
summary: The growing adoption of prompt-based automation in software testing raises important issues regarding its computational and environmental sustainability. Existing sustainability studies in AI-driven testing primarily focus on large language models, leaving the impact of prompt engineering strategies largely unexplored - particularly in the context of Small Language Models (SLMs). This gap is critical, as prompt design directly influences inference behavior, execution cost, and resource utilization, even when model size is fixed. To the best of our knowledge, this paper presents the first systematic sustainability evaluation of prompt engineering strategies for automated test generation using SLMs. We analyze seven prompt strategies across three open-source SLMs under a controlled experimental setup. Our evaluation jointly considers execution time, token usage, energy consumption, carbon emissions, and coverage test quality, the latter assessed through coverage analysis of the generated test scripts. The results show that prompt strategies have a substantial and independent impact on sustainability outcomes, often outweighing the effect of model choice. Reasoning intensive strategies such as Chain of Thought and Self-Consistency achieve higher coverage but incur significantly higher execution time, energy consumption, and carbon emissions. In contrast, simpler strategies such as Zero-Shot and ReAct deliver competitive coverage test quality with markedly lower environmental cost, while Least-to-Most and Program of Thought offer balanced trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 首次系统评估Small Language Models (SLMs) 中提示工程策略对自动化测试生成的可持续性影响。研究发现提示策略对可持续性指标的影响甚至超过模型选择本身，推理密集型策略(CoT、Self-Consistency)覆盖率更高但环境成本显著，而简单策略(Zero-Shot、ReAct)则以较低环境代价提供竞争性测试质量。
AI.motivation: 当前AI驱动测试的可持续性研究主要关注大型语言模型，忽视了提示工程策略的影响。提示设计直接影响推理行为、执行成本和资源利用效率，这对SLMs尤为重要，因为SLMs在边缘设备和资源受限环境中应用广泛，但提示设计策略的影响尚未被系统研究。
AI.method: 受控实验环境下，对3个开源SLMs评估7种提示策略。采用多维度联合评估方法：执行时间、Token使用量、能源消耗、碳排放量，以及通过覆盖率分析评估生成的测试脚本质量。
AI.result: 提示策略对可持续性指标有显著且独立的影响，甚至超过模型选择的影响。Chain of Thought和Self-Consistency等推理密集型策略获得更高覆盖率，但执行时间、能源消耗和碳排放显著增加。Zero-Shot和ReAct等简单策略以明显更低的环境成本提供竞争性的测试质量。Least-to-Most和Program of Thought提供平衡的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程策略是影响SLMs自动化测试可持续性的关键因素。研究建议：根据具体场景选择提示策略——追求高质量测试可选择推理密集型策略，重视环保可持续性则选择简单策略。提示策略优化应成为AI测试可持续性研究的重要方向。

title: OPRIDE: Offline Preference-based Reinforcement Learning via In-Dataset Exploration
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) can help avoid sophisticated reward designs and align better with human intentions, showing great promise in various real-world applications. However, obtaining human feedback for preferences can be expensive and time-consuming, which forms a strong barrier for PbRL. In this work, we address the problem of low query efficiency in offline PbRL, pinpointing two primary reasons: inefficient exploration and overoptimization of learned reward functions. In response to these challenges, we propose a novel algorithm, \textbf{O}ffline \textbf{P}b\textbf{R}L via \textbf{I}n-\textbf{D}ataset \textbf{E}xploration (OPRIDE), designed to enhance the query efficiency of offline PbRL. OPRIDE consists of two key features: a principled exploration strategy that maximizes the informativeness of the queries and a discount scheduling mechanism aimed at mitigating overoptimization of the learned reward functions. Through empirical evaluations, we demonstrate that OPRIDE significantly outperforms prior methods, achieving strong performance with notably fewer queries. Moreover, we provide theoretical guarantees of the algorithm's efficiency. Experimental results across various locomotion, manipulation, and navigation tasks underscore the efficacy and versatility of our approach.

AI.tldr: OPRIDE 是一种离线偏好强化学习（offline PbRL）算法，通过「数据集内探索（In-Dataset Exploration, IDE）」选择能最大化价值函数信息增益的成对轨迹查询，并用「基于方差的折扣调度（Variance-based Discount Scheduling, VDS）」按数据点的价值估计方差动态下调折扣因子以抑制学得奖励的过优化。理论证明其期望次优性可分解为离线误差与偏好误差两项（后者以 Eluder 维度和 1/(1-γ) 标度），实验表明在 Meta-World、AntMaze、MuJoCo/Kitchen 及人类反馈的像素级 Atari 上，仅用 10 次查询即显著优于 OPRL、PT、IDRL 等基线。
AI.motivation: 偏好强化学习（PbRL）用成对偏好替代难以手工设计的数值奖励，但获取人类反馈昂贵耗时，是其落地的核心瓶颈，离线 PbRL 尤其如此。作者指出离线场景下查询效率低的两个根源：(1) 低效探索——已有方法（分歧式 OPRL、信息增益式 IDRL）以奖励模型的不确定性为目标选查询，会把有限查询浪费在与最优策略无关的低回报区域的奖励精细化上；(2) 学得奖励的过优化——偏好反馈是稀疏二值的，学到的奖励容易被策略利用，导致价值高估与次优策略。因此需要一种既能让每次查询对「最优策略」信息量最大、又能抑制奖励过优化的机制。
AI.method:
**问题设定**：无限时域 MDP，折扣 γ，Bradley–Terry 成对偏好模型，偏好标签由 return 模型 R 的交叉熵损失学习；度量指标为次优性 SubOpt(π)=V^{π*}(s0)−V^{π}(s0)。理论分析采用 Bellman 一致悲观（BCP, Xie et al. 2021）作为骨干，引入了 Bellman 误差覆盖系数 C(ν;μ,Q,π) 与 Eluder 维数 d_Elu(ΔR,α)（其中 ΔR 为回报差函数类）。

**算法（两阶段，Algorithm 1）**：
- *阶段一：数据集内探索选查询*。在未标注离线数据集 D 上，用 bootstrap 训练 M 个奖励网络 {r_θi}（交叉熵损失），再用 IQL 等离线算法训练对应的价值集合 {V_ψi}；随后在数据集内选取使「价值差之差」最大的两条轨迹作为查询对：
  argmax_{(τ1,τ2)∈D} argmax_{i,j} |(V_ψi(τ1)−V_ψj(τ1)) − (V_ψi(τ2)−V_ψj(τ2))|。
  该目标等价于最小化价值函数不确定集的直径，通过信息比 Γ 与互信息 I(R;D) 的关系直接对应信息增益；其复杂度只依赖最优价值函数类的 Eluder 维数，而非奖励函数类（d_Elu(V*) ≪ d_Elu(R)）。每次查询后迭代更新奖励与价值模型，查询对从离线数据集中选取（in-dataset），无需在线交互。
- *阶段二：方差折扣调度 + 策略提取*。用集成奖励均值重标注整个离线数据集得到 D̂；对每个数据点计算集成 Q 函数方差 Var{Q_φi(s,a)}，若该方差的 batch 内排名超过 Top m%（默认 m=30%）则把该点的折扣因子从 γ 降为 γ_small（默认 0.7），其余保持 γ；再利用 D̂ 通过标准离线 RL（IQL）训练 Q 并提取策略。附录另给出更平滑的「连续退火」折扣变体 γ_small = γ/max(1, α·Var)，效果相当。
- *工程优化*：奖励训练每轮只采样 S 段数据，多头（multi-head）网络共享骨干替代 M 个独立模型，计算量从 N×M×K 降到 S×(1+(M−1)/L)×K，M=2/5/10 时总训练时间约 1–1.3 小时。

**理论**：Theorem 4 给出算法 2（理论版）的期望次优性上界
SubOpt(π̄) ≤ O(√(C†log(N|Q||Π|)/(N(1−γ)²)) + √(κ·d_Elu(ΔR,1/K)·log(K|ΔR|)/(K(1−γ))))，
分别对应离线误差与偏好误差；相比纯在线偏好学习，偏好误差被 1/(1−γ) 因子缩减，解释了离线数据丰富时少量查询即可奏效。Theorem 9/10 进一步给出纯离线查询版本，额外增加 O(√(C·log(N|ΔR|)/(N(1−γ)))) 项（覆盖系数 C=max_s d^{π*}(s)/μ(s)）。证明基于置信集 C_k(R)、悲观策略集 Π_k、探索策略对选择式(12)、Azuma–Hoeffding 与 Russo–Van Roy 的 Eluder 维数引理、BCP 的悲观性引理。
AI.result: 在 5 个随机种子、D4RL 归一化分数下（所有方法统一用 IQL 训练下游策略、10 次查询）：Meta-World 上 OPRIDE 平均 65.3±3.3，明显优于 OPRL 30.4、PT 31.4、PT+PDS 25.0、IDRL 57.0（如 peg-insert-side 79.0 vs 16.8，sweep 78.5 vs 8.0，push-wall 102.2 vs 74.8）；AntMaze 上 OPRIDE 平均 56.8±4.8，优于 OPRL 27.1、PT 50.4、PT+PDS 51.7、IDRL 52.8（large-play 27.5 vs 7.3）。消融显示：IDE 贡献主要增益（VDS+Disagreement 相对 VDS+Random 几乎无提升），VDS 明显优于 PDS 与直接惩罚奖励（penalise reward）方案，优于只最大化奖励差异的变体；γ_small 在 0.7~0.8 稳健，m=30% 较优，过大 m 会过度悲观。查询数消融表明增益在 0.1%~0.3% 查询比例区间最快，约 1% 后趋稳；相比之下基线需数倍查询量才有同等表现。额外实验：MuJoCo/Kitchen 上亦领先；与单阶段方法 IPL/CPL 及序列排序列表方法 LiRE 对比，OPRIDE 全部胜出；在 15 名真人标注者的像素级 Atari（Pong/Breakout/Q*bert/Seaquest/Asterix）人类反馈实验中同样达到最优（如 Breakout 256.7、Q*bert 13535）。计算开销可控（M=10 时约 1.2–1.3 小时）。
AI.conclusion: OPRIDE 通过把「探索」直接嵌入离线数据集内的成对查询选择，并以价值函数差分（而非奖励函数差分）作为信息增益代理，配合基于价值估计方差的动态折扣调度来抑制奖励过优化，在仅约 10 次人类查询的预算下显著优于现有离线 PbRL 方法，且具备可证明的查询效率保证（次优性分解为离线误差与偏好误差，偏好项由差回报类的 Eluder 维数控制）。其意义在于：探索目标应服务于「最优策略」而非「奖励函数」的辨识，从而把学习负担从低回报区域中解放出来；同时小折扣因子提供的悲观性在稀疏二值偏好下是缓解奖励过优化的有效手段。局限与未来方向包括：理论分析基于可实现（realizable）且 Bellman 完备、有限函数类设定，且依赖数据覆盖系数假设；VDS 的阈值超参 m 与 γ_small 需按任务调参；当前仍为两阶段流程（先学奖励再提策略）且查询对仅在固定离线数据集内选取，可能受数据集质量与多样性上限的约束。

title: Do Audio-Visual Large Language Models Really See and Hear?
summary: Audio-Visual Large Language Models (AVLLMs) are emerging as unified interfaces to multimodal perception. We present the first mechanistic interpretability study of AVLLMs, analyzing how audio and visual features evolve and fuse through different layers of an AVLLM to produce the final text outputs. We find that although AVLLMs encode rich audio semantics at intermediate layers, these capabilities largely fail to surface in the final text generation when audio conflicts with vision. Probing analyses show that useful latent audio information is present, but deeper fusion layers disproportionately privilege visual representations that tend to suppress audio cues. We further trace this imbalance to training: the AVLLM's audio behavior strongly matches its vision-language base model, indicating limited additional alignment to audio supervision. Our findings reveal a fundamental modality bias in AVLLMs and provide new mechanistic insights into how multimodal LLMs integrate audio and vision.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对音频-视觉大语言模型(AVLLMs)进行机制可解释性研究，揭示了AVLLMs在训练过程中存在严重的多模态偏差问题：尽管模型中间层编码了丰富的音频语义，但在深层融合层中，视觉表征过度主导，导致音频线索被抑制。这种偏差源于训练过程中缺乏对音频的有效对齐监督。
AI.motivation: 随着AVLLMs成为多模态感知统一接口的发展趋势，理解其内部工作机制变得至关重要。该研究旨在回答一个核心问题：AVLLMs如何在不同层级处理、融合音频和视觉信息，以及为什么会出现模态偏差现象。
AI.method: 采用机制可解释性(mechanistic interpretability)方法，通过探测分析(probing analysis)追踪音频和视觉特征在模型各层的演化过程，并对比AVLLM与其视觉-语言基模型的音频行为差异。
AI.result: 发现AVLLMs在中间层确实编码了丰富的音频语义，但当音频与视觉信息冲突时，这些能力在最终文本生成中大多失效。深层融合层不成比例地倾向于视觉表征，从而抑制音频线索。进一步追溯发现，AVLLM的音频行为与其视觉-语言基模型高度一致，表明模型缺乏对音频监督的有效对齐训练。
AI.conclusion: AVLLMs存在根本性的模态偏差问题，其根源在于训练阶段的音频对齐不足。这一发现为理解和改进多模态LLMs的音视频整合机制提供了新的理论依据和实践方向。

title: Overcoming the "Impracticality" of RAG: Proposing a Real-World Benchmark and Multi-Dimensional Diagnostic Framework
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at AAAI 2026 Workshop
summary:
Performance evaluation of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems within enterprise environments is governed by multi-dimensional and composite factors extending far beyond simple final accuracy checks. These factors include reasoning complexity, retrieval difficulty, the diverse structure of documents, and stringent requirements for operational explainability. Existing academic benchmarks fail to systematically diagnose these interlocking challenges, resulting in a critical gap where models achieving high performance scores fail to meet the expected reliability in practical deployment.
  To bridge this discrepancy, this research proposes a multi-dimensional diagnostic framework by defining a four-axis difficulty taxonomy and integrating it into an enterprise RAG benchmark to diagnose potential system weaknesses.

AI.tldr: 本文针对企业环境中RAG系统的性能评估问题，提出现有基准测试无法有效诊断实际部署中的可靠性问题。为此，研究定义了四轴难度分类法，并集成到企业RAG基准测试中，形成多维度诊断框架，以系统识别系统潜在弱点。
AI.motivation: 现有学术基准测试无法系统诊断RAG系统在企业部署中的多维挑战，导致模型虽在基准上表现优异却在实际应用中可靠性不足，存在关键理论与实践的差距。
AI.method: 提出多维度诊断框架，定义四轴难度分类法，并将其集成到企业RAG基准测试中。
AI.result: 研究建立了可诊断RAG系统多维困难因素（包括推理复杂度、检索难度、文档结构多样性和操作可解释性要求）的基准测试框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过四轴难度 taxonomy 与企业 RAG 基准的结合，可弥合学术评估与实际部署之间的性能差距，实现对系统弱点的系统诊断。

title: Evaluating the Environmental Impact of using SLMs and Prompt Engineering for Code Generation
summary: The shift from cloud-hosted Large Language Models (LLMs) to locally deployed open-source Small Language Models (SLMs) has democratized AI-assisted coding; however, it has also decentralized the environmental footprint of AI. While prompting strategies - such as Chain-of-Thought and ReAct - serve as external mechanisms for optimizing code generation without modifying model parameters, their impact on energy consumption and carbon emissions remains largely invisible to developers. This paper presents the first systematic empirical study investigating how different prompt engineering strategies in SLM-based code generation impact code generation accuracy alongside sustainability factors. We evaluate six prominent prompting strategies across 11 open-source models (ranging from 1B to 34B parameters) using the HumanEval+ and MBPP+ benchmarks. By measuring Pass@1 accuracy alongside energy (kWh), carbon emissions (kgCO2eq), and inference latency, we reveal that sustainability often decouples from accuracy, allowing significant environmental optimizations without sacrificing performance. Our findings indicate that Chain-of-Thought, being a simpler prompting technique, can provide a near-optimal balance between reasoning capability and energy efficiency. Conversely, multi-sampling strategies often incur disproportionate costs for marginal gains. Finally, we identify grid carbon intensity as the dominant factor in deployment-time emissions, highlighting the need for practitioners to consider regional energy profiles. This work provides a quantitative foundation for "green" prompt engineering, enabling developers to align high-performance code generation with ecological responsibility.

AI.tldr: 首次系统研究SLM代码生成中提示工程策略对准确性与可持续性的影响，发现Chain-of-Thought在能效与性能间达到近最优平衡，而多采样策略成本收益比不佳，电网碳强度是部署时排放的主导因素。
AI.motivation: 随着AI辅助编程从云端LLM转向本地SLM部署，AI的环境足迹已去中心化。提示工程策略（如CoT、ReAct）虽可优化代码生成，但其能源消耗和碳排放对开发者而言仍不可见，缺乏系统性实证研究。
AI.method: 对11个开源模型（1B-34B参数）在HumanEval+和MBPP+上评估6种提示工程策略，同时测量Pass@1准确率、能耗(kWh)、碳排放(kgCO₂eq)和推理延迟。
AI.result: 可持续性与准确性常可解耦——显著的环境优化无需牺牲性能。Chain-of-Thought作为更简单的技术，能在推理能力与能效间达到近最优平衡；多采样策略则往往得不偿失。电网碳强度是部署时排放的主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 本研究为"绿色提示工程"提供量化基础，使开发者能在高性能代码生成与生态责任间做出知情选择。

title: Differentiable Symbolic Planning: A Neural Architecture for Constraint Reasoning with Learned Feasibility
summary: Neural networks excel at pattern recognition but struggle with constraint reasoning -- determining whether configurations satisfy logical or physical constraints. We introduce Differentiable Symbolic Planning (DSP), a neural architecture that performs discrete symbolic reasoning while remaining fully differentiable. DSP maintains a feasibility channel (phi) that tracks constraint satisfaction evidence at each node, aggregates this into a global feasibility signal (Phi) through learned rule-weighted combination, and uses sparsemax attention to achieve exact-zero discrete rule selection. We integrate DSP into a Universal Cognitive Kernel (UCK) that combines graph attention with iterative constraint propagation. Evaluated on three constraint reasoning benchmarks -- graph reachability, Boolean satisfiability, and planning feasibility -- UCK+DSP achieves 97.4% accuracy on planning under 4x size generalization (vs. 59.7% for ablated baselines), 96.4% on SAT under 2x generalization, and maintains balanced performance on both positive and negative classes where standard neural approaches collapse. Ablation studies reveal that global phi aggregation is critical: removing it causes accuracy to drop from 98% to 64%. The learned phi signal exhibits interpretable semantics, with values of +18 for feasible cases and -13 for infeasible cases emerging without supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可微分符号规划"(DSP)模块，并集成进"通用认知核"(UCK)架构，用于图结构输入上的约束满足二分类。核心三点：每节点维护可行性通道 φ、以学习到的规则权重聚合出全局可行性信号 Φ、以 sparsemax 稀疏注意力实现精确为零的离散规则选择。在规划可行性（8×8→16×16）、布尔可满足性（10→20 变量）、图可达性（12→30 节点）三个基准上分别达到 97.4%、96.4%、82.7% 的准确率，显著优于 GIN 与消融的 UCK 基线；消融显示移除全局 φ 聚合准确率由 98% 跌至 64%，sparsemax 换成 softmax 降至 71.1%，且 φ 的取值语义（可行 ≈ +18、不可行 ≈ −13）在无直接监督下自发涌现，具备可解释性。
AI.motivation: 论文指出神经网络擅长模式识别但在约束推理（判定配置是否满足逻辑/物理约束）上系统性失效，核心是"类别坍塌"：在尺寸分布漂移下模型只对多数类或易类保持高准确率（如负类 99%、正类 20%，总体 60% 但平衡分数仅 0.20），对需要平衡决策的应用毫无实用价值。作者诊断出既有架构三大缺口：(1) 缺乏显式的可行性状态跟踪（GNN/Transformer 无跨推理步累积约束满足证据的专用变量）；(2) 稠密 softmax 注意力无法实现离散规则选择，规则间相互干扰；(3) 缺乏全局聚合机制，仅靠池化会丢失结构化推理信号，在路径存在性这类全局约束上失效。同时批评 NeuroSAT 等方法依赖循环消息传递与池化、Vin 等只回答"该做什么动作"而不回答"是否存在有效解"。目标是构造一个端到端可学习、无需领域手工符号组件、却能执行离散符号推理的架构。
AI.method: 整体框架：UCK+DSP 在 T=4 个 rollout 步中交替执行"图注意力（局部消息传递）"与"DSP 更新（规则推理与可行性跟踪）"，维护三类状态：节点表示 h∈R^{N×d}、逐节点可行性通道 φ∈R^{N×1}、全局可行性 Φ∈R。DSP 每步含五个操作：(1) 规则激活 α——用全局均值 ȫh、φ̄ 与 K=12 个可学习规则嵌入 E 经 MLP 后用 sparsemax 投影，对未选中规则给出精确 0；(2) 节点选择 β——由 Q=W_qE、K=W_k[h,φ] 构成注意力分数后同样用 sparsemax 得到稀疏的"规则×节点"分配；(3) 效应计算——MLP_h 与 MLP_φ 分别输出 Δh、Δφ，并注入规则嵌入与时间步 t；(4) 门控更新——gate=α⊗β，h 经 LayerNorm 残差更新，φ 经 clamp(±φ_max=6.0) 更新以防发散；(5) 全局聚合——ΔΦ=tanh(MLP_Φ([h̄,φ̄,E]))，Φ←Φ+Σ_k α_k·ΔΦ_k，即由激活规则加权累积全局证据。分类阶段：有源/目标节点的任务用 [h_src,h_tgt,φ_src,φ_tgt,Φ]，SAT 等全局任务用 [mean(h),mean(φ),Φ]。sparsemax 依据其单纯形投影定义（阈值 τ=(c_{k*}-1)/k*，输出 max(z−τ,0)），保证可微同时产生精确零。训练用 AdamW（lr 3e-4、weight decay 1e-2、cosine annealing、梯度裁剪 1.0）、30 epoch、batch 32、d_model=d_rule=64、dropout 0.1，5 个随机种子报告均值±标准差；基线为无 DSP 的 UCK 与 GIN；评测含总体准确率、逐类准确率与平衡分数 min(acc+,acc−)/max(acc+,acc−)。
AI.result: 主要结果：规划任务 8×8 训练→16×16 测试（4× 尺寸泛化）下 UCK+DSP 总体 97.4%±0.1（正类 99.9%、负类 94.8%、平衡 0.949），而消融 UCK 仅 59.7%（正类 20.1%、负类 99.3%、平衡 0.203，典型类别坍塌），GIN 81.1%；SAT（10→20 变量）96.4%±0.7（平衡 0.936）优于 GIN 93.8%±0.5，p=0.013；可达性（12→30 节点）82.7%±1.2，优于 GIN 80.5% 与 UCK 73.4%。消融：去掉 φ 通道则 16×16 准确率从 98.0% 降至 58.8%、不可行类从 96% 崩至 17.6%；仅去掉全局 φ 则降至 64.0%、不可行类 28.0%；φ 仅入 keys 或仅入 effects 影响很小。注意力对比：sparsemax 97.4%±0.1，softmax 71.1%±2.8，entmax(1.5) 60.1%±8.3，sparsemax 高出 softmax 26 个百分点且方差低约 6 倍，说明中等稀疏度区间不稳定。解释性：全局 φ 均值可行 +18.0（std 6.4）、不可行 −13.5（std 15.9），分离度 31.5，未经任何直接监督自发涌现。效率：约 64k 参数、T4 上训练约 11 分钟、单样本推理 <1ms。需要审慎看待的方面：(1) 论文由单一作者署名于企业（附有多项美国临时专利申请），实验数据来源、任务构造细节与代码可得性未披露；(2) "类别坍塌"的对比基线 UCK(no DSP) 是自建弱基线，仅与 GIN 比较，且规划任务上 GIN 已达 81.1%，说明绝对 SOTA 结论有限；(3) 可达性任务 82.7% 远低于饱和，sparsemax 与 entmax 的排序（entmax 最差）与"稀疏度越高越好"的直觉相悖，缺少对规则数 K、rollout 步数 T 的敏感性分析；(4) 缺失与 NeuroSAT/GraphSAT 等专用求解器的直接对比，宣称 SOTA 的依据不足；(5) 未报告符号求解器基线，说明该任务相对 SAT 求解器本身并不困难；(6) 表格间数字口径不一致（正文 97.4% vs 消融表 Full DSP 8×8 97.0%/16×16 98.0%），以及"移除全局 φ 掉 34 个点"在 98→64 与 98→28 两种口径间存在表述矛盾；(7) 平衡分数定义在正负类近乎对称的数据集上信息量有限，且 Φ 的极性与幅度被作者说明为任务相关，可解释性结论的普适性因此受限。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：只要赋予网络恰当的结构性归纳偏置——显式的可行性状态、显式的全局聚合、以及能产生精确零的稀疏注意力——神经网络即可执行结构化约束推理。DSP 在三个基准上给出强泛化表现（规划 97.4%、SAT 96.4%、可达性 82.7%），且在正负类上保持平衡，弥补了标准神经方法在尺寸泛化下的坍塌缺陷；消融证明全局 φ 聚合与 sparsemax 均为不可替代的组件；φ 的语义自发分化说明该通道捕获了真实可解释的可行性表征。作者承认的局限包括：固定 T=4 的 rollout 步数可能不足以应对更深的推理链；仅处理是/否可行性而不生成证书（满足赋值或具体路径）；要求输入可表示为图；规则数 K 为固定超参、缺乏自适应分配。展望方向为多步证书生成、扩展到更大规模问题、与规划/验证系统集成。总体而言这是一篇结构清晰、动机叙事完整但证据强度有限的架构型工作：核心思想（稀疏注意力+显式可行性状态）具有独立价值，但实验规模小、基线偏弱、口径存在不一致，宜作为技术启发而非已确立的结论。

title: Speaking of Language: Reflections on Metalanguage Research in NLP
summary: This work aims to shine a spotlight on the topic of metalanguage. We first define metalanguage, link it to NLP and LLMs, and then discuss our two labs' metalanguage-centered efforts. Finally, we discuss four dimensions of metalanguage and metalinguistic tasks, offering a list of understudied future research directions.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于元语言(metalanguage)在NLP和LLM领域研究的立场论文，旨在定义元语言概念，将其与自然语言处理和大型语言模型联系起来，并提出元语言研究的四个维度及未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 元语言作为语言学中的重要概念，在NLP和LLM快速发展背景下缺乏系统性研究，需要阐明其定义、关联性及研究空白，为后续研究奠定基础。
AI.method: 本文采用综述与立场阐述的方法，首先定义元语言概念，建立其与NLP/LLM的联系，然后从两个实验室的研究实践出发，总结元语言研究的四个维度，并对元语言任务进行系统分类。
AI.result: 提出了元语言的定义框架，建立了元语言与NLP/LLM的理论联系，总结了四个研究维度和元语言任务分类，列出了一系列尚未充分研究的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 元语言研究是NLP/LLM领域中一个值得关注的新兴方向，具有重要的理论与应用价值，未来需要在四个维度上开展更深入的研究探索。

title: Dependency-Guided Repository-Level C-to-Rust Translation with Reinforcement Alignment
summary:
Automating C-to-Rust migration is critical for improving software security without sacrificing performance. Traditional rule-based methods struggle with diverse C idioms, often producing rigid and unidiomatic Rust code. Large Language Models (LLMs), trained on massive code corpora, offer a promising alternative by leveraging cross-language generalization to generate more idiomatic and maintainable Rust code. However, several challenges remain. First, existing LLM-based approaches fail to handle cross-file dependencies effectively, either ignoring them or including entire files as context, which limits accurate dependency modeling. Second, complex dependencies and structured inputs and outputs make it difficult to verify syntactic correctness and functional equivalence at the repository level. Third, the lack of large-scale C-Rust parallel data constrains model performance.
  We propose DepTrans, a framework that combines model capability enhancement with structured inference. DepTrans introduces Reinforcement-Aligned Syntax Training to improve generation quality through multi-task fine-tuning and feedback-driven reinforcement learning. It further applies Dependency-Guided Iterative Refinement to capture fine-grained cross-file dependencies and iteratively refine generated Rust code. We construct a dataset of 85k training samples and a benchmark of 145 repository-level instances. Experiments show that DepTrans achieves a 60.7 percent compilation success rate and 43.5 percent computational accuracy, outperforming the strongest baseline by 22.8 and 17.3 percentage points. It also successfully builds 7 of 15 industrial C projects, demonstrating its practical potential.

AI.tldr: DepTrans是一个结合模型能力增强与结构化推理的C-to-Rust自动迁移框架，通过强化对齐句法训练和依赖引导的迭代优化技术，解决了现有LLM方法在跨文件依赖处理、代码正确性验证和训练数据规模方面的挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统基于规则的C-to-Rust迁移方法难以应对多样化的C语言惯用法，生成的Rust代码僵硬且不符合Rust idiom；现有LLM方法在处理跨文件依赖时要么忽略要么将整个文件作为上下文，且缺乏大规模C-Rust并行数据支持。
AI.method: 提出DepTrans框架，包含两大核心组件：(1) Reinforcement-Aligned Syntax Training：结合多任务微调与反馈驱动的强化学习提升生成质量；(2) Dependency-Guided Iterative Refinement：捕获细粒度跨文件依赖并迭代优化生成的Rust代码。构建85k训练样本和145个仓库级测试实例的基准数据集。
AI.result: DepTrans达到60.7%的编译成功率和43.5%的计算准确率，分别比最强基线提升22.8和17.3个百分点；成功构建15个工业C项目中的7个。
AI.conclusion: DepTrans框架通过结构化推理和依赖建模显著提升了LLM驱动的代码迁移质量，验证了其在实际工业场景中的应用潜力。

title: Modeling and Controlling Deployment Reliability under Temporal Distribution Shift
comment: 19 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables. Empirical study on temporally indexed credit-risk dataset (1.35M samples, 2007-2018)
summary:
Machine learning models deployed in non-stationary environments are exposed to temporal distribution shift, which can erode predictive reliability over time. While common mitigation strategies such as periodic retraining and recalibration aim to preserve performance, they typically focus on average metrics evaluated at isolated time points and do not explicitly model how reliability evolves during deployment.
  We propose a deployment-centric framework that treats reliability as a dynamic state composed of discrimination and calibration. The trajectory of this state across sequential evaluation windows induces a measurable notion of volatility, allowing deployment adaptation to be formulated as a multi-objective control problem that balances reliability stability against cumulative intervention cost.
  Within this framework, we define a family of state-dependent intervention policies and empirically characterize the resulting cost-volatility Pareto frontier. Experiments on a large-scale, temporally indexed credit-risk dataset (1.35M loans, 2007-2018) show that selective, drift-triggered interventions can achieve smoother reliability trajectories than continuous rolling retraining while substantially reducing operational cost.
  These findings position deployment reliability under temporal shift as a controllable multi-objective system and highlight the role of policy design in shaping stability-cost trade-offs in high-stakes tabular applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个"以部署为中心"的框架：把模型可靠性建模为随时间演化的动态状态（判别力AUC + 校准误差ECE），用相邻窗口间的平均绝对变化定义波动率（volatility），并把部署期适应策略选择形式化为"最小化可靠性波动、约束累计干预成本"的多目标控制问题。作者提出漂移触发可靠性控制策略DTRC与多目标可靠性控制MORC（对漂移/可靠性阈值做网格扫描，构造成本–波动率经验Pareto前沿并取膝点）。在135万笔贷款（2007–2018、按年度窗口评估）实验中，DTRC（1次重训+2次重校准，累计成本12）在总体波动率上优于每年滚动重训（P2，成本45，波动率0.0309 vs 0.0286），AUC保持0.641 vs 0.661，成本降低约73%。
AI.motivation: 机器学习模型部署在非平稳环境中会遭遇时间分布偏移，现有缓解手段（周期性重训、重校准、漂移检测）通常只在孤立时间点上评估平均指标（如AUC、ECE），既不显式刻画可靠性在部署期内的"轨迹演化"，也不形式化干预频率与运营成本之间的权衡。实际上，可靠性的时间不稳定性（如判别力或校准的突然波动）对治理与风控的危害不亚于平均性能衰减，且现有基于阈值的启发式触发缺乏稳定性目标与成本感知的优化依据。作者希望回答：应如何设计显式控制部署期可靠性的策略。
AI.method: 形式化设定：监督二分类，模型f_t在T=9个不重叠年度窗口上评估；可靠性状态R_t=(A_t, C_t)，A_t为ROC AUC，C_t为ECE（15个等宽分箱）；波动率V_L1为相邻窗口|A差|+|C差|的均值，另有仅统计退化步的下行波动率V_L1^-。动作空间A={NoOp, Recalibrate, Retrain, Both}，加权成本（0/1/5/6）刻画重训在算力、验证与治理上的主导负担；目标为min_π (V_L1(π), C(π))，以Pareto前沿而非标量目标刻画权衡。基线：P0静态、P1周期性等渗回归重校准、P2滚动重训（W=3年）。DTRC采用漂移优先的分层规则：数值特征用KS统计量均值、类别特征用JSD（top-50类别+OTHER）聚合为漂移信号D_t=0.5·KS+0.5·JSD；双漂移阈值划分低/中/严重漂移三个区间，中度漂移且校准失败→重校准，严重漂移且任一可靠性失败信号（ECE≥θ_C或AUC≤θ_A）→Both，否则重训。基模型为XGBoost（200树、深度4），所有策略共享超参以隔离策略效应。MORC把DTRC视为参数化策略类Π_Θ，在P0基线的ECE 80%分位与AUC 20%分位作为可靠性阈值下扫描漂移阈值对（69个候选、去重后23个不同操作点），构建成本–波动率Pareto前沿，并以"在成本≤15下最小化波动率"选取膝点。评估采用严格按时间顺序、无前视的协议；不确定性用年度块bootstrap（9个块、1000次重采样）给出95%百分位置信区间。
AI.result: 主要结果：(1) P2滚动重训获得最高平均AUC（0.661）与最低Brier（0.1400），但成本最高45；P3 DTRC成本12（1次重训+2次重校准），AUC 0.641、Brier 0.1429，相对P2成本下降约73%。(2) 稳定性并非随更新频率单调改善：DTRC取得最低V_L1=0.0286，优于P2的0.0309与P0的0.0321；但在下行波动率V_L1^-上P2略优（0.0138 vs 0.0166），说明连续重训对最不利年际变动抑制更强。(3) 反直觉发现：周期性重校准P1虽将平均ECE由0.0350降至0.0259，却比静态部署更不稳定（V_L1=0.0422），归因于每年重新拟合等渗校准映射引入窗口间振荡。(4) MORC前沿呈非线性：低成本区间即可获得大幅波动率下降，进一步提升需不成比例地提高干预强度；膝点（成本12）相对最小成本配置（成本11）额外降低约18%的V_L1，仅多一次重校准。(5) 块bootstrap显示各策略置信区间部分重叠（DTRC的V_L1区间下界0.026低于静态部署下界0.033），作者明确将其定位为探索性稳健性检查而非正式显著性检验。
AI.conclusion: 部署期可靠性在时间偏移下具有可设计的多目标结构：由策略设计（而非仅模型选择）决定稳定性与成本的结果。在信用风险这一高风险表格场景中，选择性的、状态依赖的漂移触发干预在"稳定性–成本"空间中可支配简单的频率型更新策略（成本45→12），并给出更平滑的可靠性轨迹；周期性重校准若机械化执行反而会成为不稳定性来源，重校准频率应作为可调控制参数。局限包括：单一领域（信贷）验证、政策族与动作空间受限（未建模公平性、预算约束、延迟标签、风险敏感目标）、漂移信号形式单一（未涵盖交互漂移、条件标签偏移、表示空间漂移）、年度块数量过少导致置信区间偏宽、标签延迟与删失被忽略、成本模型为抽象加权方案。作者提出后续方向：理论保证、约束型MDP/风险敏感与公平感知的可靠性控制、显式处理标签延迟与截断、以及向保险核保、电子病历与公共部门风险评估等领域推广。

title: OntoKG: Ontology-Oriented Knowledge Graph Construction with Intrinsic-Relational Routing
summary:
Organizing a large-scale knowledge graph into a typed property graph requires structural decisions -- which entities become nodes, which properties become edges, and what schema governs these choices. Existing approaches embed these decisions in pipeline code or extract relations ad hoc, producing schemas that are tightly coupled to their construction process and difficult to reuse for downstream ontology-level tasks. We present an ontology-oriented approach in which the schema is designed from the outset for ontology analysis, entity disambiguation, domain customization, and LLM-guided extraction -- not merely as a byproduct of graph building. The core mechanism is intrinsic-relational routing, which classifies every property as either intrinsic or relational and routes it to the corresponding schema module. This routing produces a declarative schema that is portable across storage backends and independently reusable.
  We instantiate the approach on the January 2026 Wikidata dump. A rule-based cleaning stage identifies a 34.6M-entity core set from the full dump, followed by iterative intrinsic-relational routing that assigns each property to one of 94 modules organized into 8 categories. With tool-augmented LLM support and human review, the schema reaches 93.3% category coverage and 98.0% module assignment among classified entities. Exporting this schema yields a property graph with 34.0M nodes and 61.2M edges across 38 relationship types. We validate the ontology-oriented claim through five applications that consume the schema independently of the construction pipeline: ontology structure analysis, benchmark annotation auditing, entity disambiguation, domain customization, and LLM-guided extraction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种本体导向的知识图谱组织方法，通过内在-关系路由机制将属性分类并路由到对应模式模块。该方法基于Wikidata 2026年1月 dump，创建了包含3400万实体和6120万边的属性图，模式可跨存储后端移植并在5个下游应用中独立复用。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱构建方法将模式决策嵌入pipeline代码或临时抽取关系，导致模式与构建过程紧耦合，难以复用于下游本体级任务。需要一种从设计之初就面向本体分析、实体消歧、领域定制和LLM引导抽取的模式架构。
AI.method: 核心机制是内在-关系路由（intrinsic-relational routing），将每个属性分类为内在属性或关系属性并路由到对应模式模块。流程包括：基于规则的清洗阶段从Wikidata dump识别3460万核心实体集，然后进行迭代路由将每个属性分配到94个模块（8大类）。结合工具增强的LLM支持和人工审查完成分类。
AI.result: 模式达到93.3%的类别覆盖率和98.0%的模块分配准确率。导出产生3400万节点、6120万边、38种关系类型的属性图。5个独立应用验证了模式的可复用性：本体结构分析、基准注解审计、实体消歧、领域定制和LLM引导抽取。
AI.conclusion: 内在-关系路由机制成功实现了声明式、可移植且独立可复用的模式设计。该方法证明了本体导向模式可脱离构建pipeline，独立服务于多种下游任务，为知识图谱的模块化和可扩展性提供了新范式。

title: Revealing the Learning Dynamics of Long-Context Continual Pre-training
summary: Existing studies on Long-Context Continual Pre-training (LCCP) mainly focus on small-scale models and limited data regimes (tens of billions of tokens). We argue that directly migrating these small-scale settings to industrial-grade models risks insufficient adaptation and premature training termination. Furthermore, current evaluation methods rely heavily on downstream benchmarks (e.g., Needle-in-a-Haystack), which often fail to reflect the intrinsic convergence state and can lead to "deceptive saturation". In this paper, we present the first systematic investigation of LCCP learning dynamics using the industrial-grade Hunyuan-A13B (80B total parameters), tracking its evolution across a 200B-token training trajectory. Specifically, we propose a hierarchical framework to analyze LCCP dynamics across behavioral (supervised fine-tuning probing), probabilistic (perplexity), and mechanistic (attention patterns) levels. Our findings reveal: (1) Necessity of Massive Data Scaling: Training regimes of dozens of billions of tokens are insufficient for industrial-grade LLMs' LCCP (e.g., Hunyuan-A13B reaches saturation after training over 150B tokens). (2) Deceptive Saturation vs. Intrinsic Saturation: Traditional NIAH scores report "fake saturation" early, while our PPL-based analysis reveals continuous intrinsic improvements and correlates more strongly with downstream performance. (3) Mechanistic Monitoring for Training Stability: Retrieval heads act as efficient, low-resource training monitors, as their evolving attention scores reliably track LCCP progress and exhibit high correlation with SFT results. This work provides a comprehensive monitoring framework, evaluation system, and mechanistic interpretation for the LCCP of industrial-grade LLM.

AI.tldr: 本文是腾讯混元团队对工业级大模型「长上下文持续预训练」（LCCP）学习动力学的首次系统性研究：以 Hunyuan-A13B（80B 总参数、13B 激活的稀疏 MoE）为对象，在 200B token 训练轨迹上（上下文 32K→64K，约 4×10²³ FLOPs）提出「行为（SFT 探针）—概率（PPL）—机制（注意力头/检索头）」三层分析框架，得到三大发现：工业级模型需要远超百亿级的数据规模（>150B token）才真正饱和；传统 NIAH 存在「欺骗性饱和」，其 PPL 化连续指标与下游性能相关性更高；检索头可作为低成本的 LCCP 训练进度与稳定性监控探针。此外还观察到检索头身份在预训练阶段即已定型、LCCP 主要起放大作用，PPL 随训练 token 对数近似线性下降并缓解「中间迷失」现象、提升抗长上下文干扰鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 已有 LCCP 研究多集中于 7B 左右的小模型与数十亿级（20B token）的小规模数据，作者认为直接迁移到工业级模型存在两方面风险：其一，小模型上「已饱和」的数据量在容量增大后可能远未饱和，直接照搬会导致训练提前终止、适应不足；其二，现有评测高度依赖 Needle-in-a-Haystack（NIAH）等下游基准，其二值结果式打分只能给出粗粒度信号，会出现「欺骗性饱和」（deceptive saturation）——指标显示已收敛，实则长上下文建模仍在细粒度精修，无法反映模型的内在收敛状态，也不利于判断何时安全停止训练。因此需要一个覆盖行为、概率与机制三个层面的、可在 base model 上直接使用的监控与评测体系。
AI.method: 模型与训练设置：以 Hunyuan-A13B-32K base 为起点（80B 总参/13B 激活、32 层、hidden 4096、MoE 每层 1 共享专家+64 专精专家激活 8 个、GQA 32Q/8KV、SwiGLU），通过 LCCP 把上下文从 32K 扩到 64K，RoPE base 频率由 500K 调到 2M，总训练 200B token，恒定学习率 1.2e-5，全局 batch 16M token。数据混合：25% 短上下文（与初始预训练同分布）+ 75% 超 32K 长文，长文来源为 Common Crawl 36.3%、Books 28.6%、arXiv 24.0%、Code 10.8%、Wikipedia 0.3%。三层框架：(1) 行为层——对中间 checkpoint 做轻量 SFT 探针（内部 440K 样本/约 0.25B token，学习率 2e-5→5e-6 余弦衰减、2 epoch、全局 batch 1M token），在 RULER QA 子集、MRCR、LongBio（paraphrase/pronoun/standard 子集）上评测 32K–64K 均匀长度样本的 Pass@3；(2) 概率层——把 NIAH 改造为「连续 NIAH」：按 [前缀+needle+后缀+Question+Answer] 格式喂入 base model，直接计算答案 token 的 token-level PPL，覆盖 1K–64K 长度 × 0–100% 深度，输出 PPL 热力图、平均 NIAH 分数与 PPL 曲线，并与 SFT 结果做 Pearson 相关与显著性检验（p 值）；另用内部中文/英文/代码语料（各 100 条 64K 样本）测常规 PPL 缩放；(3) 机制层——沿用 Wu et al. (2025) 的检索头定义，计算所有层所有注意力头的 retrieval score（该头自回归解码时把 needle 句中 token 复制到答案输出的 token 级召回率 |g_h∩k|/|k|，阈值 r=0.1 判定为检索头），统计检索头数量、平均检索分、跨阶段 top-30 重叠率与 Spearman 秩相关，并做 NIAH 改造的干扰鲁棒性实验（固定绝对距离 16K，变化干扰上下文长度）与深度分层 PPL 分析。
AI.result: 1) 数据规模必要性：SFT 探针显示 RULER 从 68.68 提升到 100B token 处的峰值 79.44，MRCR/LongBio 在 50B 后边际收益递减但整体持续上升，工业级模型需超过 100B（内在饱和点约 150B）token 才进入稳定饱和平台，远超以往小规模研究的数十亿级结论。2) 欺骗性 vs 内在饱和：原始 NIAH 分数在 20B token 即接近饱和、50B 后维持 100% 准确率，而 NIAH-PPL 持续下降直到 150B 才平台化；NIAH PPL 与下游 SFT 成绩的相关性显著更高（RULER -0.9115 vs 0.8552，MRCR -0.9231 vs 0.8927，LongBio -0.6283 vs 0.4977，平均 -0.8210 vs 0.7486；RULER/MRCR 相关 p<0.05，LongBio 不显著）。3) 机制监控：检索头数量与平均检索分随训练 token 上升，与 SFT 性能呈稳健正相关（平均检索分平均 0.7878，检索头数量 0.7428；RULER/MRCR 显著 p<0.05，LongBio 趋势正但不显著），可在 base model 上免 SFT、低成本追踪 LCCP 进度。4) PPL 近似满足 PPL=A·log(N)+B 的缩放关系（与 scaling law 一致），表明增益呈边际递减。5) 长上下文鲁棒性：>40K 序列的中部（深度 30%–80%）答案 PPL 随训练显著下降，「lost in the middle」被缓解；随训练推进，绝对距离固定时的 PPL 对干扰上下文长度不再敏感，抗干扰鲁棒性提升。6) 检索头身份在预训练阶段基本定型：0B→20B 阶段 top-30 重叠 24/30、Spearman 0.7316，其后各阶段重叠 ≥28/30、Spearman 0.88–0.92，说明 LCCP 主要放大既有检索机制而非重构功能头。
AI.conclusion: LCCP 在工业级模型上的数据需求被严重低估（>150B token 才真实饱和），传统 NIAH 的早饱和是「假信号」，以 PPL 为核心的连续 NIAH 更能反映内在收敛并与下游能力对齐；检索头的注意力分数是低成本、可直接在 base model 上使用的训练进度/稳定性监控探针，据此可构建「监控框架 + 评测体系 + 机制解释」一体化的长上下文持续预训练方法论，并有望避免因过早停止训练导致的适应不足。局限：仅追踪 64K 窗口、200B token 的单条轨迹，尚未覆盖超长上下文（>256K）、完整后训练（SFT/RL）对 LCCP 的影响、数据配比与 RoPE 频率等配方的系统消融、检索头的主动干预优化，以及跨模型（DeepSeek、Qwen 系列）泛化验证。

title: BugForge: Constructing and Utilizing DBMS Bug Repository to Enhance DBMS Testing
summary:
DBMSs are complex systems prone to bugs that may lead to system failures or compromise data integrity. Establishing unified DBMS bug repositories is crucial for systematically organizing bug-related data, enabling code improvement, and supporting automated testing. In particular, bug reports often contain valuable test inputs and bug-triggering clues that help explore rare execution paths and expose critical buggy behavior, thereby guiding automated DBMS testing. However, the heterogeneity of bug reports, along with their incomplete or inaccurate content, makes it challenging to build unified repositories and convert them into high-quality test cases.
  In this paper, we propose BugForge, a framework that constructs standardized DBMS bug repositories and leverages them to generate high-quality test cases to enhance DBMS testing. Specifically, BugForge progressively collects bug reports, then employs syntax-aware processing and input-adaptive raw PoC extraction to construct a DBMS bug repository. The repository stores structured bug-related data, including bug metadata and raw PoCs that entail potential bug-triggering semantics. These data are further refined into high-quality test cases through semantic-guided adaptation, thereby enabling enhanced DBMS testing methods, including DBMS fuzzing, regression testing, and cross-DBMS bug discovery. We implemented BugForge for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, and MonetDB, totally integrated 37,632 bug reports spanning up to 28 years. Based on the repository, BugForge uncovered 35 previously unknown bugs with 22 confirmed by developers, demonstrating the value of constructing and utilizing bug repositories for DBMS testing.

AI.tldr: BugForge是一个从异构Bug报告中构建标准化DBMS Bug仓库并生成高质量测试用例的框架。该系统针对PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB和MonetDB四个数据库实现，整合了37,632个Bug报告（跨度达28年），并发现了35个先前未知的Bug（其中22个已被开发者确认）。
AI.motivation: DBMS是复杂系统，易产生导致系统故障或数据完整性问题的Bug。Bug报告包含有价值的测试输入和Bug触发线索，有助于探索罕见执行路径和暴露关键Bug行为。然而，Bug报告的异构性以及内容的不完整或不准确性使得构建统一仓库并将报告转化为高质量测试用例面临挑战。
AI.method: BugForge采用三阶段处理方法：(1) 渐进式收集Bug报告；(2) 通过语法感知处理和输入自适应的原始PoC提取构建Bug仓库；(3) 通过语义引导的适配将数据精化为高质量测试用例。这些测试用例可支持DBMS模糊测试、回归测试和跨DBMS Bug发现。
AI.result: 对PostgreSQL、MySQL、MariaDB和MonetDB四个DBMS实现了BugForge，共整合37,632个Bug报告（时间跨度达28年）。基于该仓库，发现了35个先前未知的Bug，其中22个已被开发者确认。
AI.conclusion: 构建和利用Bug仓库对于DBMS测试具有重要价值，能够系统化组织Bug相关数据，支持代码改进，并为自动化测试提供有力支持。

title: An Initial Exploration of Contrastive Prompt Tuning to Generate Energy-Efficient Code
comment: Published at the Third International Workshop on Large Language Models for Code (LLM4Code 2026)
summary: Although LLMs are capable of generating functionally correct code, they also tend to produce less energy-efficient code in comparison to human-written solutions. As these inefficiencies lead to higher computational overhead, they are in direct conflict with Green Software Development (GSD) efforts, which aim to reduce the energy consumption of code. To support these efforts, this study aims to investigate whether and how LLMs can be optimized to promote the generation of energy-efficient code. To this end, we employ Contrastive Prompt Tuning (CPT). CPT combines Contrastive Learning techniques, which help the model to distinguish between efficient and inefficient code, and Prompt Tuning, a Parameter-Efficient Fine Tuning (PEFT) approach that requires only a fraction of the cost of traditional fine tuning. This study evaluates CPT on Python, Java and C++ coding problems across three different models to provide a comprehensive evaluation. The method achieves consistent improvements in code accuracy for two models but efficiency gains vary by model, language and task complexity, indicating that improvements are not uniformly reliable.

AI.tldr: 本文初步探索用「对比式提示调优」（CPT）——将对比学习的损失函数与提示微调（PEFT）结合——在不微调模型权重的前提下，促使大语言模型生成更节能的代码。在 Python/C++ 训练数据上对 Phi-3 Mini、CodeLlama-7B、DeepSeek-Coder-7B 三个模型进行 CPT（Triplet 与 InfoNCE 两种损失），在 HumanEval-X 与 LeetCode 的 Python/Java/C++ 任务上评估正确率、运行时间与能耗。结果：两个模型（通用型与代码调优型）正确率稳定提升，代码优先型（DeepSeek）反而略微下降；能耗与执行时间的改善随模型、语言与任务复杂度差异显著且不稳定，说明「更节能的代码生成」尚未被可靠地解决。
AI.motivation: LLM 生成的代码虽然功能正确，但往往比人类手写代码能耗更高，直接冲突于绿色软件开发（GSD）的目标；而新模型在提升代码质量的同时延长了推理时间，进一步放大了「用 LLM 省能」的自相矛盾之处。作者认为，尽管推理本身耗能，但云端执行通常比本地工作站更节能，且终端/电池设备确有节能需求，因此仍有价值让 LLM「默认」生成更高效的代码。现有相关工作主要测量 LLM 生成代码的能耗（Solovyeva 等）、比较提示策略（Apsan 等）或用强化学习优化效率（Afterburner），尚未有人用参数高效微调、尤其是对比学习的方式引导模型学习「高效 vs 低效」代码对之间的差异；作者称这是首个将对比式方法用于提升生成代码非功能质量的研究。
AI.method: 1) 模型：Phi-3-mini-4k-instruct（通用）、CodeLlama-7B-Instruct（代码调优）、DeepSeek-Coder-7B-Instruct（代码优先）。2) 训练数据：从 GEC 数据集构造 3,548 条 Python 条目、CodeNet 构造 3,921 条 C++ 条目，合并为 7,469 条「Both」；每条含 1 个高效解与若干低效解（依据执行时间/内存判定）。基准：HumanEval-X（每语言 164 题）与 LeetCode 难题（每语言 52 题），覆盖 Python/Java/C++。3) 方法：HuggingFace PEFT 实现提示调优，基座模型冻结，仅训练软提示；因随机初始化预实验准确率极低，软提示以文本「Generate energy-efficient code.」初始化；对比损失采用 Triplet Loss（PyTorch Metric Learning）与 InfoNCE（自行实现，支持「锚点+正样本+多个负样本」结构），以同一问题的功能等价程序对为训练信号。4) 生成与测量：统一三段式提示（可选效率指令 + 题意 + 函数签名），贪心解码（do_sample=False，max_new_tokens=512）；代码后处理仅移除冗余函数/重复类声明等非错误修复；C++ 用 Apple Clang 14 -std=c++17 -O0、Java 用 javac、Python 3.12，在 2016 款 MacBook Pro 上用 powermetrics 以 100Hz 采样 CPU 功耗，测试延长至 5–10 秒、间隔 5 秒冷却、每解执行 10 次取均值，用 MAD 去离群，Mann-Whitney U 检验（α=0.005）判定显著性。5) 研究问题：对比损失的影响（RQ1）、跨模型差异（RQ2）、跨编程语言差异（RQ3）。
AI.result: 正确率（648 任务，pass@1）：基线为通用型 40.1%、代码调优型 38.4%、代码优先型 21.6%；加效率指令后分别 45.5%、43.2%、23.1%。CPT 后：通用型所有组合均提升，最佳 47.4%（Python 训练集+Triplet，epoch 1，Triplet 仅比 InfoNCE 高 0.9%，且多数变体 epoch 1 即达峰，说明少量调优即可获益）；代码调优型最佳 52.0%（C++ 训练集+Triplet，epoch 20），所有变体较基线至少高 5.7%，且 Triplet 全面优于 InfoNCE（46.1–52.0% vs 45.1%），InfoNCE 在 epoch 1 最优且随训练退化、Triplet 随训练提升；代码优先型整体变差，最佳 CPT 变体均值 21.3%，仅在 Java 上略优（HumanEval-X +8.5%、LeetCode +3.9%）。训练集选择效应因模型而异：通用型几乎无影响，代码调优型则较敏感（Python 训练集较 C++ 低约 5.9%，Both 在 Java 上达 60.4% 但其他子集落后 3–9%）。跨语言泛化明显：未见 Java 训练样例却在 Java 上提升，未见 Python 训练样例却在 C++ 上提升。能耗/时间：训练带来的改善比单纯加指令更稳定（指令与最优变体差异常很大，例如 HumanEval-X C++ 上代码优先型最优变体为基线的 58.5%，而指令变体高达 174.5%）；但仅在统计显著的结果上报告，且 instruction 变体在 LeetCode Java（两模型）与 LeetCode C++（代码优先型）上与基线无显著差异，最优变体仅在 LeetCode Python（代码优先型）一处无显著差异，说明改善幅度不确定；示例显示高效变体通过提前退出与跳过偶数将循环次数减半。
AI.conclusion: 对比式提示调优在保持基座模型冻结、极低训练成本的前提下，能稳定提升部分模型（通用型、代码调优型）的代码正确率，且学到的「效率表征」可跨编程语言泛化；然而能耗与执行时间的收益并不一致地出现，随模型类型、语言与任务复杂度波动，样本量小、结果不确定性高，因此尚不能声称 CPT 可靠地带来节能代码生成。实践建议：Triplet 更利于正确性、InfoNCE 训练成本更低更省能；训练集需按模型定制；应结合显式效率指令与 CPT 联合使用；本工作为初步探索，需要更大规模、更多模型与更严格基线（含推理总能耗与碳排放核算）的研究加以验证。

title: Let's Have a Conversation: Designing and Evaluating LLM Agents for Interactive Optimization
summary: Optimization is as much about modeling the right problem as solving it. Identifying the right objectives, constraints, and trade-offs demands extensive interaction between researchers and stakeholders. Large language models can empower decision-makers with optimization capabilities through interactive optimization agents that can propose, interpret and refine solutions. However, it is fundamentally harder to evaluate a conversation-based interaction than traditional one-shot approaches. This paper proposes a scalable and replicable methodology for evaluating optimization agents through conversations. We build LLM-powered decision agents that role-play diverse stakeholders, each governed by an internal utility function but communicating like a real decision-maker. We generate thousands of conversations in a school scheduling case study. Results show that one-shot evaluation is severely limiting: the same optimization agent converges to much higher-quality solutions through conversations. Then, this paper uses this methodology to demonstrate that tailored optimization agents, endowed with domain-specific prompts and structured tools, can lead to significant improvements in solution quality in fewer interactions, as compared to general-purpose chatbots. These findings provide evidence of the benefits of emerging solutions at the AI-optimization interface to expand the reach of optimization technologies in practice. They also uncover the impact of operations research expertise to facilitate interactive deployments through the design of effective and reliable optimization agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可扩展、可复现的评估方法，通过对话交互来评估优化智能体。研究者构建了基于LLM的决策智能体，模拟不同利益相关者，在学校排课案例中生成数千次对话。研究表明：一对一评估严重受限，通过对话交互的优化智能体能收敛到更高质量的解决方案；结合领域特定提示和结构化工具的定制化优化智能体比通用聊天机器人表现显著更好。
AI.motivation: 优化问题的建模与求解同样重要，但传统一次性评估方法存在局限。随着大语言模型（LLM）驱动的人机交互式优化智能体兴起，如何可靠评估这类对话式交互系统成为关键挑战——对话交互的评估远比传统单次方法困难，缺乏标准化评估框架制约了该领域发展。
AI.method: 研究者构建了LLM驱动的决策智能体，通过角色扮演模拟多样化利益相关者，每个智能体受内部效用函数驱动但以真实决策者方式沟通。在学校排课案例研究中生成数千次对话，横向比较：①一次性评估 vs 对话式交互的效果差异；②通用聊天机器人 vs 领域定制化优化智能体的性能表现。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）一次性评估具有严重局限性，同一优化智能体通过对话交互能收敛到更高质量解决方案；2）配备领域特定提示和结构化工具的定制优化智能体，相比通用聊天机器人，在更少交互轮次内实现显著更优的解质量。
AI.conclusion: 研究证实了AI-优化交叉领域新兴解决方案的实践价值，有助于扩大优化技术的应用范围。同时揭示了运筹学专业知识在设计有效可靠的优化智能体中的关键作用，为交互式部署的设计提供了重要指导。

title: SocioEval: A Template-Based Framework for Evaluating Socioeconomic Status Bias in Foundation Models
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly power decision-making systems across critical domains, understanding and mitigating their biases becomes essential for responsible AI deployment. Although bias assessment frameworks have proliferated for attributes such as race and gender, socioeconomic status bias remains significantly underexplored despite its widespread implications in the real world. We introduce SocioEval, a template-based framework for systematically evaluating socioeconomic bias in foundation models through decision-making tasks. Our hierarchical framework encompasses 8 themes and 18 topics, generating 240 prompts across 6 class-pair combinations.
