(2019) 的 UD/DM 边预测量级相当；但即便最好的预测也无法在增强后 LM 中超过基线。(3) 噪声与下界：句内锚点打乱在 p_Gold ∈ {0.9,0.8,0.7,0.6,0.5} 时对 PTG 与 EDS 均为充分性下界，EDS 在 {0.4…0.0} 亦成立；比特翻转在 |p_Gold−0.5| ≥ 0.3（即 0.9/0.8/0.2/0.1/0.0）时为下界，信号强度关于 0.5 对称甚至完全翻转（p=0）仍优于基线。(4) 关键洞察：整体准确率明显更差的"打乱"切片反而比"预测"切片带来更好的 PPL；预测切片的正确性方差远大于打乱切片；预测切片虽对高 surprisal 词的 F1 更低，却恰恰在高 surprisal 词上带来最大 NLL 改善，同时略微抬高占多数的低 surprisal 词的 surprisal，从而抵消整体收益——说明单点正确率分数会掩盖关键分布信息。(5) 受益最大的是低频高 surprisal 的名词、形容词、动词，尤其是分词/分词结构（如 dividing、has begged、will be relocated）；排在前面的收益多来自命名实体与日期，疑为过拟合伪影。
AI.conclusion: 提出并实践了一个"充分性下界"框架：给定信号 ξ、系统 Σ 与阈值 θ，以 ξ 在数据集上的（多变量）分布来刻画"何种质量的信号才足以支撑系统达到 θ"，从而区分表示/预测器设计中的有效成分与冗余。三点具体结论：① 语义表示可以大幅简化——去掉边标签与锚点的二值层次结构即可带来 LM 收益（也是金标准下的"丰富度下界"），并因取消锚点而更易适配 AMR 等无锚表示（仍需外部对齐器提供基本锚定）；② 充分性不能由单一聚合分数判定，需同时考虑信号与噪声的分布（正确性方差、与 surprisal 的耦合），因为噪声分布比整体错误率更决定成败；③ 预测结构对 LM 的收益主要体现在 Zipf 尾部（罕见高 surprisal 词），这为低资源/长尾建模提供了希望。局限：下界目前只是经验性乐观估计，缺少形式化保证（需定义"与已知下界足够相似"的 goodness-of-fit 准则）；完整自举系统尚未建成（可能需要 Viterbi/beam search 等结构化解码，牺牲运行速度）；评测仅限 PPL，尚未考察 cloze 人类规范等心理语言学指标。

title: R2-Write: Reflection and Revision for Open-Ended Writing with Deep Reasoning
summary: While deep reasoning with long chain-of-thought has dramatically improved large language models in verifiable domains like mathematics, its effectiveness for open-ended tasks such as writing remains unexplored. In this paper, we conduct a systematic investigation revealing that existing mainstream reasoning models achieve limited gains on open-ended writing tasks. Our further analysis shows that these models lack deep reflection and revision patterns in open-ended writing, resulting in substantially smaller improvements compared to mathematical reasoning tasks. To address this limitation, we introduce R2-Write: an automated framework that synthesizes high-quality thinking trajectories enriched with explicit reflection and revision patterns through iterative writer-judge interaction. To prevent redundant reflections, we design a process reward mechanism that supervises reflection quality during reinforcement learning, improving both performance and token efficiency. Extensive experiments across multiple creative writing and deep-research benchmarks demonstrate significant improvements, validating that explicitly incorporating reflection and revision patterns unlocks deep reasoning capabilities for open-ended writing tasks.

AI.tldr: 现有主流推理模型在开放式写作任务中效果有限，主要原因是缺乏深度反思和修改模式。R2-Write通过迭代式writer-judge交互合成高质量思维轨迹，并引入过程奖励机制监督反思质量，在创意写作和深度研究基准上取得显著改进。
AI.motivation: 尽管链式推理显著提升了LLM在数学等可验证领域的性能，但其对开放式写作任务的效果尚未被探索。作者发现现有推理模型在写作任务上收益有限，需要深入研究其原因。
AI.method: 1. 系统性调查现有推理模型的写作表现；2. 分析发现缺乏深度反思和修改模式是关键问题；3. 提出R2-Write框架，通过迭代writer-judge交互合成高质量思维轨迹；4. 设计过程奖励机制，在强化学习中监督反思质量，减少冗余反思。
AI.result: R2-Write在多个创意写作和深度研究基准上实现显著改进，提升了性能和token效率。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入反思和修改模式能够解锁开放式写作任务的深度推理能力，为LLM在创意写作领域的发展提供了新方向。

title: ROMAN: A Multiscale Routing Operator for Convolutional Time Series Models
summary: We introduce ROMAN (ROuting Multiscale representAtioN), a deterministic operator for time series that maps temporal scale and coarse temporal position into an explicit channel structure while reducing sequence length. ROMAN builds an anti-aliased multiscale pyramid, extracts fixed-length windows from each scale, and stacks them as pseudochannels, yielding a compact representation on which standard convolutional classifiers can operate. In this way, ROMAN provides a simple mechanism to control the inductive bias of downstream models: it can reduce temporal invariance, make temporal pooling implicitly coarse-position-aware, and expose multiscale interactions through channel mixing, while often improving computational efficiency by shortening the processed time axis. We formally analyze the ROMAN operator and then evaluate it in two complementary ways by measuring its impact as a preprocessing step for four representative convolutional classifiers: MiniRocket, MultiRocket, a standard CNN-based classifier, and a fully convolutional network (FCN) classifier. First, we design synthetic time series classification tasks that isolate coarse position awareness, long-range correlation, multiscale interaction, and full positional invariance, showing that ROMAN behaves consistently with its intended mechanism and is most useful when class information depends on temporal structure that standard pooled convolution tends to suppress. Second, we benchmark the same models with and without ROMAN on long-sequence subsets of the UCR and UEA archives, showing that ROMAN provides a practically useful alternative representation whose effect on accuracy is task-dependent, but whose effect on efficiency is often favorable. Code is available at https://github.com/gon-uri/ROMAN

AI.tldr: ROMAN是一种用于时间序列的确定性算子，通过构建抗混叠多尺度金字塔、提取固定长度窗口并将其堆叠为伪通道，将时间尺度和粗粒度时间位置映射到显式通道结构中，同时缩短序列长度。
AI.motivation: 标准卷积分类器在处理时间序列时存在归纳偏置问题，如时间不变性过强、时间池化缺乏粗粒度位置感知能力、难以捕捉多尺度交互作用，且计算效率受限于序列长度。需要一种简单机制来控制下游模型的归纳偏置。
AI.method: ROMAN构建抗混叠多尺度金字塔，从每个尺度提取固定长度窗口并堆叠为伪通道，形成紧凑表示。标准卷积分类器可直接在此表示上操作。该方法可减少时间不变性、使时间池化隐式具备粗粒度位置感知能力、并通过通道混合暴露多尺度交互。
AI.result: 合成任务实验表明ROMAN行为与其设计机制一致，在类别信息依赖标准池化卷积易抑制的时间结构时最有效。UCR和UEA档案长序列子集基准测试表明，ROMAN对准确率的影响具有任务依赖性，但对效率的影响通常是有利的。
AI.conclusion: ROMAN为时间序列分析提供了一种实用的替代表示方法，可作为预处理步骤提升卷积分类器的效率和特定场景下的性能。

title: JoyAI-LLM Flash: Advancing Mid-Scale LLMs with Token Efficiency
comment: Xiaodong He is the corresponding author
summary: We introduce JoyAI-LLM Flash, an efficient Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model designed to redefine the trade-off between strong performance and token efficiency in the sub-50B parameter regime. JoyAI-LLM Flash is pretrained on a massive corpus of 20 trillion tokens and further optimized through a rigorous post-training pipeline, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) across diverse environments. To improve token efficiency, JoyAI-LLM Flash strategically balances \emph{thinking} and \emph{non-thinking} cognitive modes and introduces FiberPO, a novel RL algorithm inspired by fibration theory that decomposes trust-region maintenance into global and local components, providing unified multi-scale stability control for LLM policy optimization. To enhance architectural sparsity, the model comprises 48B total parameters while activating only 2.7B parameters per forward pass, achieving a substantially higher sparsity ratio than contemporary industry leading models of comparable scale. To further improve inference throughput, we adopt a joint training-inference co-design that incorporates dense Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) and Quantization-Aware Training (QAT). We release the checkpoints for both JoyAI-LLM-48B-A3B Base and its post-trained variants on Hugging Face to support the open-source community.

AI.tldr: JoyAI-LLM Flash是一款高效的MoE语言模型，在500亿参数以下规模实现了性能与token效率的最佳权衡。模型总参数480亿，激活仅27亿，稀疏比远超同类模型。通过20万亿token预训练，结合SFT、DPO和大规模RL后训练，并创新性提出FiberPO算法（受纤维化理论启发）和thinking/non-thinking双模式设计提升token效率。采用Dense MTP和QAT联合训练-推理协同设计提升推理吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 当前50B参数以下规模的大语言模型在强性能和token效率之间存在权衡困境；现有MoE架构的稀疏比和推理效率仍有提升空间；传统RL算法缺乏多尺度稳定性控制能力。
AI.method: 1) 预训练20万亿token；2) 后训练包括SFT、DPO和多环境大规模RL；3) 提出FiberPO算法，将信任域维护分解为全局和局部分量，实现统一的多尺度稳定性控制；4) 设计thinking/non-thinking双认知模式平衡token效率；5) 采用Dense MTP和QAT联合训练-推理协同设计；6) 架构包含48B总参数，激活2.7B参数。
AI.result: 在50B参数以下规模实现了性能与token效率的最优权衡；稀疏比显著高于同规模业界领先模型；Dense MTP和QAT协同设计有效提升推理吞吐量；已开源Base和后训练版本checkpoint。
AI.conclusion: JoyAI-LLM Flash证明了通过创新的MoE架构设计（FiberPO算法、多尺度稳定性控制、MTP+QAT协同设计）可在保持高性能的同时大幅提升token效率和推理效率，为50B以下规模MoE模型提供了新的设计范式。

title: VoxelCodeBench: Benchmarking 3D World Modeling Through Code Generation
summary: Evaluating code generation models for 3D spatial reasoning requires executing generated code in realistic environments and assessing outputs beyond surface-level correctness. We introduce a platform VoxelCode, for analyzing code generation capabilities for 3D understanding and environment creation. Our platform integrates natural language task specification, API-driven code execution in Unreal Engine, and a unified evaluation pipeline supporting both automated metrics and human assessment. To demonstrate its utility, we construct VoxelCodeBench, a benchmark of voxel manipulation tasks spanning three reasoning dimensions: symbolic interpretation, geometric construction, and artistic composition. Evaluating leading code generation models, we find that producing executable code is far easier than producing spatially correct outputs, with geometric construction and multi-object composition proving particularly challenging. By open-sourcing our platform and benchmark, we provide the community with extensible infrastructure for developing new 3D code generation benchmarks and probing spatial reasoning in future models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VoxelCode平台和VoxelCodeBench基准测试，用于评估代码生成模型在3D空间推理方面的能力。研究发现生成可执行代码远容易于生成空间正确的输出，几何构建和多对象组合尤其困难。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成模型评估缺乏针对3D空间推理的专业工具，需要在逼真环境中执行代码并评估输出质量，而非仅检查表面正确性。
AI.method: 构建了VoxelCode平台，集成自然语言任务规范、Unreal Engine API驱动代码执行、统一评估pipeline（支持自动指标和人工评估），并创建了涵盖符号解释、几何构建、艺术组合三个维度的VoxelCodeBench基准测试。
AI.result: 对领先代码生成模型评估表明：生成可执行代码远容易于生成空间正确的输出；几何构建和多对象组合任务尤其具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 开源平台和基准测试为社区提供可扩展基础设施，用于开发新型3D代码生成基准测试并探测未来模型的的空间推理能力。

title: Querying Structured Data Through Natural Language Using Language Models
summary: This paper presents an open source methodology for allowing users to query structured non textual datasets through natural language Unlike Retrieval Augmented Generation RAG which struggles with numerical and highly structured information our approach trains an LLM to generate executable queries To support this capability we introduce a principled pipeline for synthetic training data generation producing diverse question answer pairs that capture both user intent and the semantics of the underlying dataset We fine tune a compact model DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B using QLoRA with 4 bit quantization making the system suitable for deployment on commodity hardware We evaluate our approach on a dataset describing accessibility to essential services across Durangaldea Spain The fine tuned model achieves high accuracy across monolingual multilingual and unseen location scenarios demonstrating both robust generalization and reliable query generation Our results highlight that small domain specific models can achieve high precision for this task without relying on large proprietary LLMs making this methodology suitable for resource constrained environments and adaptable to broader multi dataset systems We evaluate our approach on a dataset describing accessibility to essential services across Durangaldea Spain The fine tuned model achieves high accuracy across monolingual multilingual and unseen location scenarios demonstrating both robust generalization and reliable query generation Our results highlight that small domain specific models can achieve high precision for this task without relying on large proprietary LLMs making this methodology suitable for resource constrained environments and adaptable to broader multi dataset systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种开源方法，通过自然语言查询结构化非文本数据集，替代传统RAG方法。采用合成数据训练+QLoRA微调DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B模型，在西班牙Durangaldea的服务可及性数据集上验证，实现了单语、多语及新地点场景下的高精度查询生成。
AI.motivation: 当前RAG方法在处理数值型和高度结构化信息时表现不佳，用户难以通过自然语言有效查询结构化数据集。
AI.method: 1) 设计合成训练数据生成管道，产生多样化的问答对；2) 使用QLoRA + 4位量化技术微调DeepSeek R1 Distill 8B模型；3) 在Durangaldea服务可及性数据集上进行评估。
AI.result: 微调模型在单语、多语及未见地点场景下均达到高精度，展现了强泛化能力和可靠的查询生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 小型领域专用模型可在资源受限环境下实现高精度查询生成，无需依赖大型商业LLM，该方法具有可扩展性和多数据集适应性。

title: WGFINNs: Weak formulation-based GENERIC formalism informed neural networks'
summary: Data-driven discovery of governing equations from noisy observations remains a fundamental challenge in scientific machine learning. While GENERIC formalism informed neural networks (GFINNs) provide a principled framework that enforces the laws of thermodynamics by construction, their reliance on strong-form loss formulations makes them highly sensitive to measurement noise. To address this limitation, we propose weak formulation-based GENERIC formalism informed neural networks (WGFINNs), which integrate the weak formulation of dynamical systems with the structure-preserving architecture of GFINNs. WGFINNs significantly enhance robustness to noisy data while retaining exact satisfaction of GENERIC degeneracy and symmetry conditions. We further incorporate a state-wise weighted loss and a residual-based attention mechanism to mitigate scale imbalance across state variables. Theoretical analysis contrasts quantitative differences between the strong-form and the weak-form estimators. Mainly, the strong-form estimator diverges as the time step decreases in the presence of noise, while the weak-form estimator can be accurate even with noisy data if test functions satisfy certain conditions. Numerical experiments demonstrate that WGFINNs consistently outperform GFINNs at varying noise levels, achieving more accurate predictions and reliable recovery of physical quantities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WGFINNs（弱形式基于的 GENERIC 形式化信息神经网络），将动力系统的弱形式（Galerkin 型积分分部）损失与 GFINN 的结构保持架构相结合，使网络在含噪观测数据下仍能精确满足 GENERIC 退化与对称性条件（能量守恒、熵不减），并通过状态加权损失与状态级残差注意力（State-RBA）缓解量纲/尺度不平衡。理论证明强形式估计量在噪声下随 Δt→0 发散，而弱形式估计量在测试函数满足特定条件时可保持精度；四个数值算例（双气体容器换热换体积、热弹性双摆、线性阻尼系统、1D/1V Vlasov–Poisson 电场动力学）显示 WGFINNs 在各噪声水平下均显著优于 GFINNs，并能可靠恢复能量/熵等物理量。
AI.motivation: 从含噪轨迹数据中发现控制方程是科学机器学习的核心挑战。GFINNs 通过硬约束架构（E_NN、S_NN、L_NN、M_NN）严格满足 GENERIC 退化条件与第一、第二热力学定律，但其训练依赖强形式损失，需要对噪声数据做数值微分以拟合逐点时间导数；微分是病态运算，会放大噪声，在低信噪比下导致辨识彻底崩溃。已有的弱形式方法（如字典/Galerkin 方法）虽抗噪，但需要预定义候选函数库，只能表示为线性组合，若真实物理机制不在库中即失败；且既有弱形式系统辨识工作多基于纯数据驱动或字典方法，缺少对弱形式学习一致性的数学论证。因此需要一种既非字典式、又能保持热力学结构、同时对噪声鲁棒的学习框架。
AI.method:
**整体框架**：WGFINNs = 弱形式损失 + GFINN 结构化架构 + 状态级加权与 State-RBA。

1. **弱形式损失**：对 ẋ=f(x) 乘以紧支撑测试函数 φ∈V 并分部积分得 -∫φ̇x dt = ∫f(x)φ dt；用梯形求积离散时间积分，得弱形式损失 L_W^weak(θ) = (1/(J·d·N_traj)) Σ_i ||Y^(i)Φ̇ + F_NN^(i)(θ)Φ||_W²，其中 Φ_{qj}=h φ_j(s_q)、Φ̇_{qj}=h φ̇_j(s_q)，Y、F_NN 为噪声观测与网络在各求积点的取值。

2. **测试函数**：采用单峰分段多项式 φ(t)=C(t-a)^p(b-t)^p（p≥2 保证 φ 与 φ̇ 在支撑端点消失），由三个超参刻画：支撑宽度 ℓ、多项式次数 p、重叠度 s（重叠时间点数 ℓ_overlap=⌊ℓ(1-√(1-s^{1/p}))⌋），测试函数个数 J=1+⌊(K+1-ℓ)/(ℓ-ℓ_overlap)⌋；每个算例单独调参。

3. **GFINN 结构**：基于 Theorem 2（斜对称矩阵 A_i 构造 Q_h 使 Q_h∇h=0），令 L_NN=(Q_{S_NN})ᵀ B_NN Q_{S_NN}（B_NN 斜对称），M_NN 与 E_NN 类似构造，从而精确满足 L∇S=M∇E=0、L 斜对称、M 对称半正定。

4. **状态加权与 State-RBA**：W=diag(1/σ_1,…,1/σ_d)，σ_l 为该状态量在全轨迹上的标准差；State-RBA 用 λ^k=γλ^{k-1}+η*√W e^{k-1}/||√W e^{k-1}||_∞ 更新权重，θ^k=θ^{k-1}-η∇L_{W diag(λ^k)}，残差 e^k 在弱形式下取 |YΦ̇+F_NN Φ| 的列绝对值均值，强形式下取一步预测误差绝对值均值。

5. **理论分析（单变量线性系统 ẋ=λx）**：Proposition 1 给出弱形式"主方程"，证明弱形式损失最小解产生与数据一致的轨迹；Theorem 3 证明强形式最优估计满足 Δt[θ*−λ]→ −σ²/(x₀²(e^{λT}−1)/(2λT)+σ²)（几乎必然），即误差随 Δt→0 发散，但存在使 θ*=λ 的特殊步长；Theorem 4 给出弱形式相对误差解析式，与噪声水平 σ 线性相关且 σ=0 时精确；Theorem 5 在 m=1 情形构造满足条件的测试函数，证明 S→∞ 时几乎必然 θ*→λ，而 S→0 时误差以概率发散。
AI.result: **理论层面**：强形式估计量在噪声下随步长减小而发散（存在偶然的"完美"步长）；弱形式估计量的误差与噪声水平线性相关，无噪时精确，其收敛/发散行为由测试函数支撑长度 S 控制——S 越大越准、S 过小则失效；弱形式仅用 2m+1 个样本导致方差高于强形式。**数值层面**（四算例，5 次独立重复，训练/测试轨迹 80/20，AdamW）：① 双气体容器换热换体积（d=4）：WGFINNs 相对 ℓ2 测试误差在各噪声水平下均显著低于 GFINNs，10% 噪声时 GFINNs 轨迹失真而 WGFINNs 准确，学习到的能量/熵等值线与 GT 吻合、沿轨迹的熵满足第二定律；② 热弹性双摆（d=10）：同样呈现低噪声下相当、高噪声下 GFINNs 显著劣化的差距；③ 线性阻尼系统（d=3）：WGFINNs 在 0–10% 噪声下稳定准确，GFINNs 在 10% 噪声下失效；④ 1D/1V Vlasov–Poisson 电场（d=8，440 条轨迹）：低噪声两者接近，噪声增大后 GFINNs 误差显著放大而 WGFINNs 保持准确。此外，无噪数据下对比表明仅用加权损失（不加 RBA）时熵等小量级变量会明显偏离，加入状态加权后各状态量精度均衡，说明权重与 RBA 解决尺度不平衡、而弱形式才是抗噪的关键。
AI.conclusion: WGFINNs 将弱形式学习框架与 GENERIC 结构保持网络结合，在噪声数据下实现了既鲁棒又热力学一致的辨识：弱形式把导数转移到光滑解析测试函数上，规避数值微分对噪声的放大；GFINN 架构保证能量守恒与熵不减的硬约束；状态加权损失与 State-RBA 保证不同尺度状态变量的均衡学习。理论分析阐明了强/弱形式估计量在噪声下的本质差异，数值实验在四类热力学与等离子体系统上验证了方法的优势，并能从高噪声观测中可靠反演能量与熵等物理量。局限与未来方向：测试函数超参需逐算例调优；弱形式方差偏大、误差强烈依赖支撑长度；推广到激波流体动力学、混沌流体系统以及开放系统的非自治辨识（作者在 LLNL MI300A 上实现，代码开源）。

title: Steerable but Not Decodable: Function Vectors Operate Beyond the Logit Lens
summary: Function vectors (FVs) -- mean-difference directions extracted from in-context learning demonstrations -- can steer large language model behavior when added to the residual stream. We hypothesized that FV steering failures reflect an absence of task-relevant information: the logit lens would fail alongside steering. We were wrong. In the most comprehensive cross-template FV transfer study to date - 4,032 pairs across 12 tasks, 6 models from 3 families (Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B-v0.3; base and instruction-tuned), 8 templates per task - we find the opposite dissociation: FV steering succeeds even when the logit lens cannot decode the correct answer at any layer. This steerability-without-decodability pattern is universal: steering exceeds logit lens accuracy for every task on every model, with gaps as large as -0.91. Only 3 of 72 task-model instances show the predicted decodable-without-steerable pattern, all in Mistral. FV vocabulary projection reveals that FVs achieving over 0.90 steering accuracy still project to incoherent token distributions, indicating FVs encode computational instructions rather than answer directions. FVs intervene optimally at early layers (L2-L8); the logit lens detects correct answers only at late layers (L28-L32). The previously reported negative cosine-transfer correlation (r=-0.572) dissolves at scale: pooled r ranges from -0.199 to +0.126, and cosine adds less than 0.011 in R-squared beyond task identity. Post-steering analysis reveals a model-family divergence: Mistral FVs rewrite intermediate representations; Llama/Gemma FVs produce near-zero changes despite successful steering. Activation patching confirms causal localization: easy tasks achieve perfect recovery at targeted layers; hard tasks show zero recovery everywhere.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过4,032个实验对验证了功能向量(FV) steering的一个反直觉发现：FV steering成功时，logit lens可能完全无法解码正确答案。FV在浅层(L2-L8)干预最有效，而logit lens仅在深层(L28-L32)才能检测答案。FV编码的是计算指令而非答案方向，表现为高steering准确率但词汇投影仍不连贯。研究还发现模型家族差异：Mistral FV重写中间表征，而Llama/Gemma FV产生近零变化但仍能成功steer。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为FV steering失败与logit lens无法解码正确答案应当相关——如果模型内部没有正确计算答案，steering也无法生效。本研究旨在系统验证这一假设，通过大规模跨模板FV迁移研究检验steerability与decodability之间的关系。
AI.method: 最全面的跨模板FV迁移研究：12个任务 × 6个模型(Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-2-9B, Mistral-7B-v0.3，含base和instruction-tuned变体) × 8个模板/任务 = 4,032个实验对。采用logit lens分析、FV词汇投影、激活 patching等方法，评估不同层级的decodability和steerability。
AI.result: 发现普遍的"steerability-without-decodability"模式：FV steering在所有任务和模型上都优于logit lens，差距最大达0.91。仅3/72的task-model组合显示预期的"decodable-without-steerable"模式(均在Mistral)。FV在浅层(L2-L8)干预最优，而logit lens仅在深层(L28-L32)检测到正确答案。先前报道的负余弦转移相关(r=-0.572)在规模化后消失。
AI.conclusion: FV通过编码计算指令(而非答案方向)实现行为控制，解释了steerability与decodability的解离。浅层FV干预触发深层计算重构，揭示了LLM中"指令执行"与"答案解码"机制的分离。激活patching证实easy任务可在目标层完美恢复，而hard任务在各层均无法恢复，表明因果定位具有任务依赖性。

title: Multi-Aspect Knowledge Distillation for Language Model with Low-rank Factorization
summary: Knowledge distillation is an effective technique for pre-trained language model compression. However, existing methods only focus on the knowledge distribution among layers, which may cause the loss of fine-grained information in the alignment process. To address this issue, we introduce the Multi-aspect Knowledge Distillation (MaKD) method, which mimics the self-attention and feed-forward modules in greater depth to capture rich language knowledge information at different aspects. Experimental results demonstrate that MaKD can achieve competitive performance compared with various strong baselines with the same storage parameter budget. In addition, our method also performs well in distilling auto-regressive architecture models.

AI.tldr: MaKD（Multi-aspect Knowledge Distillation）通过SVD低秩分解初始化学生模型，并在预训练阶段以分层策略进行三类蒸馏：浅层做矩阵级蒸馏（MHA的Q/K/V与FNN的升降维投影），深层做层级蒸馏（注意力分布KL散度 + 隐层状态MSE），最后做模型级logits软标签蒸馏，从而在同等参数预算下于GLUE、SQuAD及指令跟随任务上超越DistilBERT、TinyBERT、MiniLM v2等基线。
AI.motivation: 预训练语言模型（PLM）存储、内存与计算开销大，制约其在线部署，知识蒸馏（KD）是主流压缩手段。现有KD方法主要分两类：logits-based（对齐软标签分布）与feature-based（对齐token嵌入、隐层状态、自注意力分布等层间特征）。作者指出这些方法仅关注"层间"知识分布，粒度较粗：注意力权重是Q与K交互后的结果，若能单独对齐Q/K/V等矩阵，可保留更低层的细粒度特征表达；而PLM的自注意力矩阵本身蕴含层次化、多粒度的语言信息。因此核心问题是：能否将层内的细粒度自注意力矩阵知识与层间中间层信息结合，以改善师生分布对齐。同时，师生模型层数/宽度不同会导致跨层映射的错位问题，需要先消除这一gap。
AI.method:
1）低秩分解初始化：对Transformer中的线性矩阵（MHA的W^Q/W^K/W^V/W^O、FNN的W^U/W^D）做SVD，保留前k个奇异值，将W≈U[:, :k]Σ[:k,:k]V^T[:, :k]=AB，参数从n·m降为k(n+m)，通过不同秩k获得不同压缩率；因学生与教师隐藏维度相同，从而消除跨层映射错位。

2）三个粒度的蒸馏目标：
- 矩阵蒸馏（Matrix Distillation，浅层）：L_MHA为教师/学生各注意力头Q、K、V矩阵的逐头MSE平均；L_FNN为FNN上投影与下投影矩阵的逐头MSE平均；L_matrix = L_MHA + L_FNN。
- 层级蒸馏（Layer Distillation，深层）：L_attn为注意力分布的逐头KL散度；L_hidn为隐层状态H^L的MSE；L_layer = L_attn + L_hidn。
- 模型蒸馏（Model Distillation）：L_model为MLM/NSP两个预训练任务logits经温度缩放后的软交叉熵。

3）多层级学习策略（Eq.19）：第1~L/2层用L_matrix，L/2~L层用L_layer，最后输出层用L_model，即"浅层学局部/表层特征、深层传高层语义"的层次化蒸馏。

4）实验设置：教师为BERT_BASE（109M，L=12，d=768，d_f=3072，A_h=12）；预训练语料为英文Wikipedia + BooksCorpus；batch size 512，峰值学习率1e-4，40万步，AdamW（β1=0.9, β2=0.99），8张A100混合精度；微调阶段对学习率做网格搜索并用5个随机种子取验证集最优。基线为DistilBERT、TinyBERT、MiniLM v2。
AI.result: GLUE（表1）：MaKD_256（67.0M）平均82.0，优于TinyBERT_6（81.4）与MiniLM v2_6（81.0），CoLA上比两大SOTA高7.3%；MaKD_64（24.1M）平均79.3，显著优于4层基线（DistilBERT 74.0、TinyBERT 77.6、MiniLM v2 78.8）。用61.4%/22.1%参数分别保留教师99.8%/96.5%性能，12层768维学生比BERT_BASE快2.0×。SQuAD（表2）：MaKD_256平均74.8，优于TinyBERT_6（70.2）、DistilBERT_6（67.9）、MiniLM v2（73.8）。消融（表3）：去掉L_matrix平均从81.8降至80.2，掉L_model降2.1（至79.7），MHA贡献大于FNN且二者互补；L_layer去掉降至80.8。层级分配（表4）：矩阵蒸馏置于浅层（86.3）优于深层（84.7）与全部层（85.9）；层级蒸馏置于深层（86.2）优于浅层（84.8）；"浅层矩阵+深层层级+模型级"组合最优（86.8）。自回归（表5）：GPT-2 124M教师→77.4M学生，Dolly/SelfInst/Vicuna平均Rouge-L 13.53，优于SFT 11.34、KD 11.41、SeqKD 11.67；LLaMA-3 1.23B→0.69B时MaKD平均15.24为最佳，GPT-2场景下以62%参数达到教师约82%的性能。
AI.conclusion: MaKD通过"低秩分解初始化 + 层次化多粒度蒸馏（矩阵级/层级/模型级）"的组合，在相同存储参数预算下取得优于现有强基线的竞争力表现，既适用于encoder-only（BERT_BASE）也适用于decoder-only自回归模型（GPT-2、LLaMA-3），说明其可为后续大语言模型压缩研究提供方法基础。局限：多粒度（粗+细）结合带来比既有方法更多的训练时间；实验模型规模有限，未验证更大规模LLM及低于10%压缩率（更高压缩比）的情形；未来将拓展至更多领域与场景。

title: Complex-Valued GNNs for Distributed Basis-Invariant Control of Planar Systems
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, submitted to CDC 2026 main track
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are a well-regarded tool for learned control of networked dynamical systems due to their ability to be deployed in a distributed manner. However, current distributed GNN architectures assume that all nodes in the network collect geometric observations in compatible bases, which limits the usefulness of such controllers in GPS-denied and compass-denied environments. This paper presents a GNN parametrization that is globally invariant to choice of local basis. 2D geometric features and transformations between bases are expressed in the complex domain. Inside each GNN layer, complex-valued linear layers with phase-equivariant activation functions are used. When viewed from a fixed global frame, all policies learned by this architecture are strictly invariant to choice of local frames. This architecture is shown to increase the data efficiency, tracking performance, and generalization of learned control when compared to a real-valued baseline on an imitation learning flocking task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种复值（complex-valued）参数化的分布式图神经网络架构，使平面多机器人群体控制器对各智能体局部坐标系（体坐标系）的选择实现解析意义上的全局不变性：2D几何特征与基底间旋转在复域中表示，GNN层内采用复值线性层与相位等变（phase-equivariant）激活函数，消息函数用边上的SO(2)相对旋转把邻居的隐状态消息旋回本地坐标系，从而可在无GPS/无罗盘条件下工作。在DAGGER模仿学习的群体编队（flocking）任务上，相比实值SAGEConv基线，该架构在表征效率、跟踪性能与泛化能力上均显著更优（基线在通信半径减小20%时速度方差恶化近两个数量级，而本文模型仅小幅退化）。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式GNN控制器假设所有节点在"兼容的"（共同的）全局参考系下采集几何观测，这在GPS-denied、compass-denied环境中难以满足。更深层的问题在于：即便每个智能体能在自身机体系观测到邻居的原始几何编码（如速度），第一层产生的隐状态编码位于与机体坐标系相关的高维基中；从第二层起隐状态无法被直接观测而必须被传输，各节点收到的编码处于不同隐空间坐标系，直接相加在数学上是无意义的，除非先变换到公共坐标系。此外，实值权重矩阵上要满足SO(2)等变（交错条件 ρ_b W ρ_a^{-1} = W）需对权重施加复杂约束，难以实现。目标是在不依赖全局参考系的前提下，让GNN学到的策略（从固定全局系观察时）对局部基底选择严格不变。
AI.method: 1) 数学框架：引入群与群作用、线性表示、等变/不变定义；用复表示 ρ_C(R)=e^{jθ_R} 表示二维旋转群 SO(2)，因 ρ_C(R) 是标量，故对高维复隐向量的旋转等价于逐点标量乘法，无需构造 GL_n(C) 的复杂表示。给出定理III.1（全局基底不变 ⟺ 局部等变 Θ(δ▷G)=δ▷Θ(G)）与引理III.1（各组件等变则复合仍等变），作为逐层设计的依据。2) 复值SAGEConv层：节点特征经同构 γ: R²→C 复数化；消息函数 ψ(x_j, e_ij)=ρ_C(e_ij^{-1}) x_j，用边上的相对旋转把邻居隐状态旋入本地帧；聚合用mean（线性算子，天然等变）；更新函数为无偏置复值权重 W∈C^{m×k} 作用于[自身特征; 聚合结果]。定理IV.1证明复值矩阵乘对SO(2)等变（标量乘法可交换性），从而避免实值情形下对权重的苛刻约束。3) 等变激活与偏置：改造split phase-amplitude tanh，加入可学习的幅值偏置 b_i 与相位偏置 θ_i：σ(c_i)=e^{jθ_i} tanh(|c_i|+b_i) c_i/|c_i|（c_i=0时取0）；幅值偏置替代传统加性偏置，因为标量偏置会在局部系中保持不变，可能在某些基底下抵消输出、另一些基底下加倍其长度，从而破坏不变性。4) 实验：n个全向双积分器机器人群体，图按通信半径C建边，参考（nominal）控制器为邻居对齐+目标间距D的近距离吸引/远距排斥项；由于其本地化实现会迅速发散，采用DAGGER模仿学习在仅局部连通图上逼近全连通名义控制器；输入为非线性特征 a(i)=Σ(v_i−ρ(e_ij^{-1})v_j)、Σ T_ij/|T_ij|²、Σ T_ij/|T_ij|⁴；损失为复数意义下的平均平方绝对误差；基线为实值SAGEConv+tanh，并在消息中附加边旋转角θ_ij以保证其同样获得边信息；每个回合随机初始化机体旋转并逐步加噪旋转以避免学到依赖全局系的策略；对层数(2/3/4)×宽度(8/16/32)共9种配置做参数扫描。
AI.result: 表征能力：全部9个基不变模型都能紧贴名义控制器的速度方差曲线，且试验间标准差很窄；其中仅"2层×8神经元"的小模型即可准确跟踪名义控制器，说明该架构在"需跨帧转换几何数据"的任务上学习效率高。基线模型在所有配置下均无法很好逼近名义控制器（速度方差标准差显著更大），且增大参数量反而使性能下降（疑似过拟合）。泛化-长时滚动：训练仅2秒，扩展到5秒时基不变模型仍紧密跟随名义控制器曲线，而基线模型标准差随进入陌生状态而增大（2.2秒附近出现方差尖峰）。泛化-缩小通信半径（1→0.8）：两者速度方差均上升，但基不变模型仍在名义控制器一个数量级内且仍能可靠下降，群体形态与速度对齐基本保持（仅一个智能体掉队、速度幅值方差略增）；基线模型在2秒末速度方差比名义控制器高近两个数量级，群体呈扇形散开、出现两簇智能体朝正交方向运动、间距不均。综合表明基不变架构在数据效率、跟踪性能与泛化上均优于实值基线。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的复值参数化GNN架构对各智能体机体坐标系的选择具有解析意义上的不变性，复值表示使得可利用环境中现成的二维旋转信息在隐空间中显式完成基底间变换，从而免去网络"学习"如何旋转高维隐向量的负担，可直接像本地产生的那样使用消息。该架构在无全局参考系的分布式平面群体控制任务上优于实值基线，在表征容量与泛化性两方面表现更优。主要局限：模型必须依赖人工设计的非线性输入特征（如同文献[6]）才能学到名义控制器，说明聚合前缺少足够的表达能力；未来工作方向是设计带可学习参数与前置非线性（即激活函数之前可学习非线性层）的基不变GNN层，并在更多任务上验证该架构的普适性。

title: Domain-Adapted Retrieval for In-Context Annotation of Pedagogical Dialogue Acts
summary: Automated annotation of pedagogical dialogue is a high-stakes task where LLMs often fail without sufficient domain grounding. We present a domain-adapted RAG pipeline for tutoring move annotation. Rather than fine-tuning the generative model, we adapt retrieval by fine-tuning a lightweight embedding model on tutoring corpora and indexing dialogues at the utterance level to retrieve labeled few-shot demonstrations. Evaluated across two real tutoring dialogue datasets (TalkMoves and Eedi) and three LLM backbones (GPT-5.2, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Qwen3-32b), our best configuration achieves Cohen's $κ$ of 0.526-0.580 on TalkMoves and 0.659-0.743 on Eedi, substantially outperforming no-retrieval baselines ($κ= 0.275$-$0.413$ and $0.160$-$0.410$). An ablation study reveals that utterance-level indexing, rather than embedding quality alone, is the primary driver of these gains, with top-1 label match rates improving from 39.7\% to 62.0\% on TalkMoves and 52.9\% to 73.1\% on Eedi under domain-adapted retrieval. Retrieval also corrects systematic label biases present in zero-shot prompting and yields the largest improvements for rare and context-dependent labels. These findings suggest that adapting the retrieval component alone is a practical and effective path toward expert-level pedagogical dialogue annotation while keeping the generative model frozen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种领域适配的RAG管道用于教学对话标注，通过微调轻量级嵌入模型并在话语层级索引对话来检索标注样本，而非微调生成模型。在两个教学数据集和三个LLM后端上的实验表明，该方法显著优于无检索基线，且话语层级索引而非嵌入质量是性能提升的主要驱动力。
AI.motivation: LLMs often fail at automated annotation of pedagogical dialogue without sufficient domain grounding, and fine-tuning generative models is computationally expensive.
AI.method: Domain-adapted RAG pipeline with fine-tuned lightweight embedding model on tutoring corpora, utterance-level dialogue indexing for retrieving labeled few-shot demonstrations.
AI.result: Best configuration achieves Cohen's κ of 0.526-0.580 on TalkMoves and 0.659-0.743 on Eedi, substantially outperforming no-retrieval baselines (κ=0.275-0.413 and 0.160-0.410). Utterance-level indexing, not embedding quality, is the primary driver of gains. Top-1 label match rates improve from 39.7% to 62.0% (TalkMoves) and 52.9% to 73.1% (Eedi).
AI.conclusion: Adaptation of the retrieval component alone provides a practical and effective path toward expert-level pedagogical dialogue annotation without modifying the generative model.

title: Analytic Drift Resister for Non-Exemplar Continual Graph Learning
summary: Non-Exemplar Continual Graph Learning (NECGL) seeks to eliminate the privacy risks intrinsic to rehearsal-based paradigms by retaining solely class-level prototype representations rather than raw graph examples for mitigating catastrophic forgetting. However, this design choice inevitably precipitates feature drift. As a nascent alternative, Analytic Continual Learning (ACL) capitalizes on the intrinsic generalization properties of frozen pre-trained models to bolster continual learning performance. Nonetheless, a key drawback resides in the pronounced attenuation of model plasticity. To surmount these challenges, we propose Analytic Drift Resister (ADR), a novel and theoretically grounded NECGL framework. ADR exploits iterative backpropagation to break free from the frozen pre-trained constraint, adapting to evolving task graph distributions and fortifying model plasticity. Since parameter updates trigger feature drift, we further propose Hierarchical Analytic Merging (HAM), performing layer-wise merging of linear transformations in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) via ridge regression, thereby ensuring absolute resistance to feature drift. On this basis, Analytic Classifier Reconstruction (ACR) enables theoretically zero-forgetting class-incremental learning. Empirical evaluation on four node classification benchmarks demonstrates that ADR maintains strong competitiveness against existing state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: ADR是一种新型无样本持续图学习框架，通过迭代反向传播突破预训练模型冻结约束，结合层级分析融合(HAM)和分析分类器重构(ACR)实现零遗忘学习，在四个节点分类基准上表现具有竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在三重困境：(1)基于回放的范例学习方法存在隐私风险；(2)基于原型的无样本方法(NECGL)面临特征漂移问题；(3)基于冻结预训练模型的ACL方法模型可塑性不足。需设计既能保护隐私、又能保持可塑性、还能抵抗特征漂移的持续学习框架。
AI.method: 提出ADR框架，包含三个核心组件：1)迭代反向传播：突破冻结预训练约束，适应动态任务图分布；2)层级分析融合(HAM)：通过岭回归在GNN各层执行线性变换的层级融合；3)分析分类器重构(ACR)：实现理论上的零遗忘类增量学习。
AI.result: 在四个节点分类基准数据集上的实验表明，ADR能够保持与现有最先进方法的强竞争力。
AI.conclusion: ADR通过理论与实践结合的方式，成功解决了无样本持续图学习中的特征漂移问题，在隐私保护与模型性能之间取得良好平衡。

title: StoryScope: Investigating idiosyncrasies in AI fiction
summary: As AI-generated fiction becomes increasingly prevalent, questions of authorship and originality are becoming central to how written work is evaluated. While most existing work in this space focuses on identifying surface-level signatures of AI writing, we ask instead whether AI-generated stories can be distinguished from human ones without relying on stylistic signals, focusing on discourse-level narrative choices such as character agency and chronological discontinuity. We propose StoryScope, a pipeline that automatically induces a fine-grained, interpretable feature space of discourse-level narrative features across 10 dimensions. We apply StoryScope to a parallel corpus of 10,272 writing prompts, each written by a human author and five LLMs, yielding 61,608 stories, each ~5,000 words, and 304 extracted features per story. Narrative features alone achieve 93.2% macro-F1 for human vs. AI detection and 68.4% macro-F1 for six-way authorship attribution, retaining over 97% of the performance of models that include stylistic cues. A compact set of 30 core narrative features captures much of this signal: AI stories over-explain themes and favor tidy, single-track plots while human stories frame protagonist' choices as more morally ambiguous and have increased temporal complexity. Per-model fingerprint features enable six-way attribution: for example, Claude produces notably flat event escalation, GPT over-indexes on dream sequences, and Gemini defaults to external character description. We find that AI-generated stories cluster in a shared region of narrative space, while human-authored stories exhibit greater diversity. More broadly, these results suggest that differences in underlying narrative construction, not just writing style, can be used to separate human-written original works from AI-generated fiction.

AI.tldr: 研究提出StoryScope框架，通过10个维度的叙事特征（而非写作风格）区分AI与人类故事，在61,608篇故事的语料上达到93.2%的人机识别准确率，发现AI故事叙事空间集中、主题过度解释、情节单线化，而人类故事道德模糊性更高、时间复杂性更强。
AI.motivation: 现有AI文本检测主要依赖表层写作风格特征，忽视了更深层的叙事结构差异。随着AI生成小说日益普及，需要从叙事构建层面理解人机创作的本质差异。
AI.method: 开发StoryScope管道，自动诱导10维细粒度可解释叙事特征空间；构建10,272个写作提示的平行语料库，每个提示由人类作者和5个LLM各写一篇，共61,608篇故事（每篇约5000词），提取304个叙事特征。
AI.result: 仅用叙事特征实现93.2%人机识别macro-F1和68.4%六分类归属macro-F1；30个核心叙事特征即可捕获主要信号；AI故事呈聚集分布，人类故事多样性更高。
AI.conclusion: 叙事构建层面的差异（而非仅写作风格）可用于区分人类原创作品与AI生成小说；AI故事特征为过度解释主题、单一情节线、事件升级平坦、梦序列过多、外部人物描述等。

title: AXELRAM: Quantize Once, Never Dequantize
summary:
We propose AXELRAM, a smart SRAM macro architecture that computes attention scores directly from quantized KV cache indices without dequantization. The key enabler is a design-time fixed codebook: orthogonal-transform-based quantization concentrates each coordinate's distribution to N(0,1/d), so the optimal quantizer depends only on dimension d and bit-width b, not on input data. The asymmetric path design -- transform on write, table-lookup on read with no inverse transform -- reduces per-query multiplications by 102.4x (a mathematical identity).
  Through multi-seed evaluation (10 seeds x 3 models), we discover that sign pattern sensitivity causes catastrophic PPL spikes (Delta > 50) on certain models (Qwen2.5-3B), while others (LLaMA-3.1-8B) are fully stable. This phenomenon extends SpinQuant's observation of rotation variance in weight quantization to the KV cache domain, where the effect is qualitatively more severe. We trace the root cause to layer-wise norm heterogeneity and propose a gradient-free sign pattern selection (200 candidates, 8 calibration samples, one-time) that eliminates catastrophic spikes with zero additional hardware cost. All source code is available at https://github.com/Axelidea/AXELRAM.

AI.tldr: AXELRAM是一种智能SRAM宏架构，通过设计时固定码本（基于正交变换的量化）和非对称路径设计（写时变换，读时查表无需逆变换），实现直接从量化KV缓存索引计算注意力分数，显著减少乘法运算。该工作还发现并解决了符号模式敏感性导致的灾难性PPL飙升问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）推理中KV缓存占用大量内存带宽和计算资源。传统方法需要解量化后再计算，导致per-query乘法开销巨大。
AI.method: 1. 设计时固定码本：利用正交变换量化将每维分布集中在N(0,1/d)，使最优量化器仅依赖于维度d和位宽b；2. 非对称路径设计：写时变换，读时查表无需逆变换；3. 针对符号模式敏感性提出梯度无关的符号模式选择方法（200个候选，8个校准样本，一次性计算）。
AI.result: per-query乘法减少102.4倍；发现某些模型（如Qwen2.5-3B）存在灾难性PPL尖峰（Δ>50），而其他模型（如LLaMA-3.1-8B）完全稳定；通过符号模式选择可消除灾难性尖峰且无额外硬件成本。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将SpinQuant关于权重量化旋转方差的观察扩展到KV缓存领域，并揭示了层归一化异质性是根本原因。提出的方案在零硬件开销下解决了问题，为SRAM内计算架构提供了新思路。

title: Beyond Precision: Importance-Aware Recall for Factuality Evaluation in Long-Form LLM Generation
summary: Evaluating the factuality of long-form output generated by large language models (LLMs) remains challenging, particularly when responses are open-ended and contain many fine-grained factual statements. Existing evaluation methods primarily focus on precision: they decompose a response into atomic claims and verify each claim against external knowledge sources such as Wikipedia. However, this overlooks an equally important dimension of factuality: recall, whether the generated response covers the relevant facts that should be included. We propose a comprehensive factuality evaluation framework that jointly measures precision and recall. Our method leverages external knowledge sources to construct reference facts and determine whether they are captured in generated text. We further introduce an importance-aware weighting scheme based on relevance and salience. Our analysis reveals that current LLMs perform substantially better on precision than on recall, suggesting that factual incompleteness remains a major limitation of long-form generation and that models are generally better at covering highly important facts than the full set of relevant facts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个同时评估大语言模型(LLM)长文本输出准确性和完整性的框架，利用外部知识源构建参考事实并检测生成内容是否涵盖这些事实，同时引入重要性加权机制。研究发现当前LLM在准确性上的表现显著优于完整性，事实遗漏是长文本生成的主要瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM事实性评估方法主要关注精确度(Precision)，即验证生成内容中的每个原子命题是否正确，但忽视了同等重要的召回率(Recall)维度——即生成内容是否涵盖了应当包含的相关事实。这一评估维度的缺失导致无法全面衡量LLM输出的事实完整性。
AI.method: 提出一个联合评估精确度和召回率的综合事实性评估框架。利用Wikipedia等外部知识源构建参考事实集合，通过外部知识源判断生成文本是否捕捉到这些参考事实。进一步引入基于相关性和显著性的重要性感知加权方案。
AI.result: 实验分析揭示：(1)当前LLM在精确度上的表现显著优于召回率，表明事实不完整性是长文本生成的主要局限；(2)模型更擅长覆盖高度重要的事实，而非完整的相关事实集合。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为LLM长文本输出的完整事实性评估提供了系统性方法论，填补了Precision-Recall联合评估的空白。核心发现表明提升召回率——即确保生成内容涵盖更全面的相关事实——应成为未来LLM事实性优化的重要方向。

title: Conditional Sampling via Wasserstein Autoencoders and Triangular Transport
summary: We present Conditional Wasserstein Autoencoders (CWAEs), a framework for conditional simulation that exploits low-dimensional structure in both the conditioned and the conditioning variables. The key idea is to modify a Wasserstein autoencoder to use a (block-) triangular decoder and impose an appropriate independence assumption on the latent variables. We show that the resulting model gives an autoencoder that can exploit low-dimensional structure while simultaneously the decoder can be used for conditional simulation. We explore various theoretical properties of CWAEs, including their connections to conditional optimal transport (OT) problems. We also present alternative formulations that lead to three architectural variants forming the foundation of our algorithms. We present a series of numerical experiments that demonstrate that our different CWAE variants achieve substantial reductions in approximation error relative to the low-rank ensemble Kalman filter (LREnKF), particularly in problems where the support of the conditional measures is truly low-dimensional.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件Wasserstein自编码器(CWAEs)，通过使用(块)三角解码器并对潜在变量施加独立性假设来利用低维结构进行条件模拟。该方法与条件最优传输问题相关联，实验表明在条件测度支撑真正低维的问题中，CWAE变体相比低秩集合卡尔曼滤波器(LREnKF)能显著降低近似误差。
AI.motivation: 条件模拟在许多统计和机器学习应用中至关重要，但现有方法难以有效处理低维结构问题。当条件测度的支撑是低维流形时，传统方法（如LREnKF）的近似误差较大，需要一种能够显式利用低维结构的条件模拟框架。
AI.method: CWAEs通过修改Wasserstein自编码器实现条件模拟：(1)采用(块)三角解码器结构；(2)对潜在变量施加适当的独立性假设；(3)建立与条件最优传输(OT)问题的理论联系，形成三种架构变体。
AI.result: 实验表明，CWAE变体在条件测度支撑真正低维的问题中，相比低秩集合卡尔曼滤波器(LREnKF)实现了显著更低的近似误差，验证了该方法对低维结构的有效利用。
AI.conclusion: CWAEs提供了一个统一的框架，能够在利用低维结构的同时进行条件模拟，理论分析与数值实验均证明了其有效性和优越性。

title: Detecting and Correcting Reference Hallucinations in Commercial LLMs and Deep Research Agents
summary: Large language models and deep research agents supply citation URLs to support their claims, yet the reliability of these citations has not been systematically measured. We address six research questions about citation URL validity using 10 models and agents on DRBench (53,090 URLs) and 3 models on ExpertQA (168,021 URLs across 32 academic fields). We find that 3--13\% of citation URLs are hallucinated -- they have no record in the Wayback Machine and likely never existed -- while 5--18\% are non-resolving overall. Deep research agents generate substantially more citations per query than search-augmented LLMs but hallucinate URLs at higher rates. Domain effects are pronounced: non-resolving rates range from 5.4\% (Business) to 11.4\% (Theology), with per-model effects even larger. Decomposing failures reveals that some models fabricate every non-resolving URL, while others show substantial link-rot fractions indicating genuine retrieval. As a solution, we release urlhealth, an open-source tool for URL liveness checking and stale-vs-hallucinated classification using the Wayback Machine. In agentic self-correction experiments, models equipped with urlhealth reduce non-resolving citation URLs by $6\textrm{--}79\times$ to under 1\%, though effectiveness depends on the model's tool-use competence. The tool and all data are publicly available. Our characterization findings, failure taxonomy, and open-source tooling establish that citation URL validity is both measurable at scale and correctable in practice.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统测量了大语言模型和研究智能体的引用URL可靠性，发现3-13%的URL是幻觉（从未存在），5-18%无法解析。深度研究智能体比检索增强型LLM产生更多引用但幻觉率更高。不同领域差异显著（商业5.4%至神学11.4%）。开源工具urlhealth可将非解析URL降低6-79倍至1%以下。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型和深度研究智能体在生成内容时提供引用URL来支持论点，但这些引用的可靠性尚未被系统测量。研究者希望解决六个研究问题：引用URL的有效性在不同模型、场景和领域中的表现如何？
AI.method: 使用10个模型和智能体在DRBench（53,090个URL）和3个模型在ExpertQA（168,021个URL，跨32个学术领域）上进行了大规模测量实验。利用Wayback Machine验证URL历史记录，并将失败分解为"幻觉"（从未存在）与"链接腐化"（曾存在但失效）。最后开发urlhealth工具进行自我修正实验。
AI.result: 主要发现：①3-13%的引用URL是幻觉（Wayback Machine无记录）；②5-18%整体无法解析；③深度研究智能体比检索增强型LLM产生更多引用但幻觉率更高；④领域效应明显，非解析率从5.4%（商业）到11.4%（神学）；⑤部分模型制造所有非解析URL（完全幻觉），部分显示链接腐化（真实检索）；⑥urlhealth工具可将非解析URL降低6-79倍至1%以下，但效果依赖模型的工具使用能力。
AI.conclusion: 引用URL有效性是可以大规模测量且在实践中可纠正的。研究提供了失败分类法、开源工具urlhealth及全部数据，为提高AI系统引用可靠性奠定了基础。

title: Generalization Limits of Reinforcement Learning Alignment
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, accepted at JSAI 2026
summary: The safety of large language models (LLMs) relies on alignment techniques such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF). However, recent theoretical analyses suggest that reinforcement learning-based training does not acquire new capabilities but merely redistributes the utilization probabilities of existing ones. In this study, we propose ``compound jailbreaks'' targeting OpenAI gpt-oss-20b, which exploit the generalization failures of alignment. This approach combines multiple attack techniques -- each individually defended against -- to saturate the instruction hierarchy maintenance process. Our evaluation shows that the attack success rate (ASR) increased from 14.3\% with individual methods to 71.4\% with the combined approach. These results provide empirical evidence for the hypothesis that safety training does not generalize as broadly as model capabilities, highlighting the need for multifaceted safety evaluations using compound attack scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"复合越狱"(Compound Jailbreaks)攻击方法，通过组合多种单独已被防御的攻击技术，针对OpenAI gpt-oss-20b模型进行安全测试。实验表明，组合攻击的成功率(ASR)从单方法的14.3%提升至71.4%，证明安全训练泛化能力有限，需采用复合攻击场景进行多维度安全评估。
AI.motivation: 现有理论分析表明，基于强化学习的对齐训练（如RLHF）并不能真正提升模型能力，只是重新分配已有能力的激活概率。这意味着安全训练可能无法泛化到所有潜在风险场景，需要实证研究验证这一假设。
AI.method: 提出"复合越狱"攻击策略：整合多种各自已被防御机制阻止的攻击技术，通过饱和模型指令层级维护机制来突破安全防线。针对OpenAI gpt-oss-20b模型进行评估测试。
AI.result: 复合攻击的ASR达到71.4%，远高于任何单一攻击方法的14.3%。实验结果证实了安全训练泛化边界有限这一理论假设。
AI.conclusion: 安全对齐训练无法像模型能力那样广泛泛化，需建立多维度安全评估框架，采用复合攻击场景全面测试模型鲁棒性。

title: Beyond the Parameters: A Technical Survey of Contextual Enrichment in Large Language Models: From In-Context Prompting to Causal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) encode vast world knowledge in their parameters, yet they remain fundamentally limited by static knowledge, finite context windows, and weakly structured causal reasoning. This survey provides a unified account of augmentation strategies along a single axis: the degree of structured context supplied at inference time. We cover in-context learning and prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, and CausalRAG. Beyond conceptual comparison, we provide a transparent literature-screening protocol, a claim-audit framework, and a structured cross-paper evidence synthesis that distinguishes higher-confidence findings from emerging results. The paper concludes with a deployment-oriented decision framework and concrete research priorities for trustworthy retrieval-augmented NLP.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一篇关于大语言模型（LLM）增强策略的统一综述，以"推理时提供的结构化上下文程度"为主轴，系统梳理了上下文学习、提示工程、检索增强生成（RAG）、GraphRAG和CausalRAG等方法，并提供了透明的文献筛选协议、主张审计框架和跨论文证据综合，同时给出面向部署的决策框架和研究优先项。
AI.motivation: LLM虽编码了海量世界知识，但受限于静态知识、有限上下文窗口和弱结构化因果推理能力。现有方法多样但缺乏统一的整合性分析框架。
AI.method: 以结构化上下文供给程度为单一维度，构建统一分类框架；实施透明文献筛选、主张审计及跨论文证据综合。
AI.result: 系统比较了RAG、GraphRAG、CausalRAG等增强策略；区分高置信度发现与新兴结果；形成面向部署的决策框架。
AI.conclusion: 该领域研究需关注可信检索增强NLP的实践优先级，并为未来研究指明方向。

title: Product-Stability: Provable Convergence for Gradient Descent on the Edge of Stability
summary: Empirically, modern deep learning training often occurs at the Edge of Stability (EoS), where the sharpness of the loss exceeds the threshold below which classical convergence analysis applies. Despite recent progress, existing theoretical explanations of EoS either rely on restrictive assumptions or focus on specific squared-loss-type objectives. In this work, we introduce and study a structural property of loss functions that we term product-stability. We show that for losses with product-stable minima, gradient descent applied to objectives of the form $(x,y) \mapsto l(xy)$ can provably converge to the local minimum even when training in the EoS regime. This framework substantially generalizes prior results and applies to a broad class of losses, including binary cross entropy. Using bifurcation diagrams, we characterize the resulting training dynamics, explain the emergence of stable oscillations, and precisely quantify the sharpness at convergence. Together, our results offer a principled explanation for stable EoS training for a wider class of loss functions.

AI.tldr: 本文引入"乘积稳定性"(product-stability)概念，证明梯度下降在Edge of Stability (EoS)训练模式下仍能收敛到局部最优，突破了传统分析的局限性，并将框架推广到包括二元交叉熵在内的广泛损失函数。
AI.motivation: 现有EoS理论要么依赖过强假设，要么仅适用于特定平方损失目标，缺乏对更广泛损失函数的统一解释。
AI.method: 引入乘积稳定性作为损失函数的结构性质；针对形如 (x,y) → l(xy) 的目标函数进行梯度下降收敛性分析；利用分岔图(Bifurcation diagrams)表征训练动力学。
AI.result: 证明具有乘积稳定极小值的损失函数在EoS训练下可收敛；量化收敛时的锐度(sharpness)；解释稳定振荡的产生机制。
AI.conclusion: 为更广泛的损失函数类别提供了EoS训练稳定性的原则性解释，显著推广了先前的理论结果。

title: Reliability Gated Multi-Teacher Distillation for Low Resource Abstractive Summarization
summary: We study multiteacher knowledge distillation for low resource abstractive summarization from a reliability aware perspective. We introduce EWAD (Entropy Weighted Agreement Aware Distillation), a token level mechanism that routes supervision between teacher distillation and gold supervision based on inter teacher agreement, and CPDP (Capacity Proportional Divergence Preservation), a geometric constraint on the student position relative to heterogeneous teachers. Across two Bangla datasets, 13 BanglaT5 ablations, and eight Qwen2.5 experiments, we find that logit level KD provides the most reliable gains, while more complex distillation improves semantic similarity for short summaries but degrades longer outputs. Cross lingual pseudo label KD across ten languages retains 71-122 percent of teacher ROUGE L at 3.2x compression. A human validated multi judge LLM evaluation further reveals calibration bias in single judge pipelines. Overall, our results show that reliability aware distillation helps characterize when multi teacher supervision improves summarization and when data scaling outweighs loss engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文研究低资源抽象摘要场景下的多教师知识蒸馏技术，提出EWAD（基于教师共识的熵加权协议蒸馏）和CPDP（容量比例散度保持）两种方法。实验表明对数级KD提供最可靠的收益，跨语言伪标签蒸馏可在3.2x压缩下保留71-122%的教师ROUGE-L得分，可靠性感知的蒸馏有助于确定多教师监督与数据规模各自的优势场景。
AI.motivation: 低资源抽象摘要任务面临训练数据不足的挑战，需要通过知识蒸馏从多个教师模型中提取知识，但如何可靠地整合异构教师的监督信号仍不明确。
AI.method: 提出两种机制：1) EWAD在token级别根据教师间一致性动态分配监督权重（蒸馏vs黄金标注）；2) CPDP通过几何约束控制学生模型在异构教师空间中的位置。实验涵盖两个孟加拉语数据集、13个BanglaT5变体和8个Qwen2.5实验，并使用跨语言伪标签蒸馏和LLM多裁判人类验证评估。
AI.result: 1) 对数级KD带来最可靠的收益；2) 复杂蒸馏方法提升短摘要的语义相似度但损害长输出质量；3) 跨语言伪标签KD在10种语言、3.2x压缩比下保留71-122%的教师ROUGE-L；4) 多裁判LLM评估揭示单裁判流程存在校准偏差。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性感知的蒸馏方法能够有效区分多教师监督何时优于数据扩展，为低资源摘要场景下的蒸馏策略选择提供了系统性的指导框架。

title: Low-Rank Compression of Pretrained Models via Randomized Subspace Iteration
summary: The massive scale of pretrained models has made efficient compression essential for practical deployment. Low-rank decomposition based on the singular value decomposition (SVD) provides a principled approach for model reduction, but its exact computation is expensive for large weight matrices. Randomized alternatives such as randomized SVD (RSVD) improve efficiency, yet they can suffer from poor approximation quality when the singular value spectrum decays slowly, a regime commonly observed in modern pretrained models. In this work, we address this limitation from both theoretical and empirical perspectives. First, we establish a connection between low-rank approximation error and predictive performance by analyzing softmax perturbations, showing that deviations in class probabilities are controlled by the spectral error of the compressed weights. Second, we demonstrate that RSVD is inadequate, and we propose randomized subspace iteration (RSI) as a more effective alternative. By incorporating multiple power iterations, RSI improves spectral separation and provides a controllable mechanism for enhancing approximation quality. We evaluate our approach on both convolutional networks and transformer-based architectures. Our results show that RSI achieves near-optimal approximation quality while outperforming RSVD in predictive accuracy under aggressive compression, enabling efficient model compression.

AI.tldr: 本文针对预训练模型权重矩阵的低秩压缩问题，指出传统随机SVD（RSVD）在奇异值谱缓慢衰减时近似质量严重退化；作者从理论与实验两方面展开：首先给出定理，证明低秩近似误差通过softmax Jacobian的Lipschitz性质直接控制类别概率的偏差（‖p̃−p‖∞ ≤ ½R‖W−W̃‖₂）；其次提出随机子空间迭代（RSI），通过q次幂迭代（(WWᵀ)^{q−1}Wω = ΣZᵢsᵢ^{2q−1}uᵢ）放大谱间隙以提升近似质量。实验表明RSI逼近精确SVD的最优误差（VGG19层归一化误差由约2降至1.1），在激进压缩下（如VGG19 α=0.2，Top-1由59.27%提升至78.63%）显著优于RSVD，且全模型线性层压缩耗时不足1秒。
AI.motivation: 预训练模型规模庞大（数亿至数千亿参数），在移动端、嵌入式等资源受限环境中存在存储与内存瓶颈，低秩分解（SVD）是理论上最优的模型缩减手段，但精确SVD对大权重矩阵代价高昂（O(DC²)）。RSVD虽将复杂度降至O(CDk)且适配GPU，但在现代预训练模型常见的"奇异值谱缓慢衰减"区域会严重丧失近似质量（如图1.1中VGG19 4096×25088层：先快速衰减后转为慢衰减，归一化谱误差明显劣化）。同时，"近似误差如何影响预测性能"缺乏理论刻画。作者希望同时解决：理解低秩近似质量与分类可靠性的定量关系，以及开发在慢衰减谱下更准确、更稳健的随机低秩方法。
AI.method: 方法包含两块：(1) 理论分析——引理3.1给出softmax映射的Jacobian为diag(σ(u))−σ(u)σ(u)ᵀ，证明其行绝对和为2σᵢ(1−σᵢ)≤1/2；定理3.2利用均值值定理与对偶配对不等式，推出softmax输出扰动界 ‖p̃(x)−p(x)‖∞ ≤ ½R‖W−W̃‖₂（其中R为特征提取器输出的范数上界），并在备注3.3中结合截断SVD的‖W−W_k‖₂=s_{k+1}以及RSI的期望误差界 E‖W−W̃‖₂² ≤ s_{k+1}²·H^{1/(m−1)}，说明迭代次数m增加时随机误差趋于最优。(2) 算法——随机子空间迭代RSI（算法1）：采样Ω∈R^{D×k}，循环q次执行 X=WY、QR正交化、Y=WᵀX，最后对Yᵀ做小规模SVD并令Ũ=XÛ得到低秩因子 A=ŨS^{1/2}, B=S^{1/2}Ṽᵀ，把单个线性层替换为两个小线性层；q=1退化为RSVD。实验上用单层分析（VGG19分类器4096×25088层、ViT-B/32编码器内768×3072前馈层，20次重复）比较归一化误差与运行时间；再做端到端压缩，对所有线性层（VGG19 3层、ViT 37层）按 k=⌈α·min(C,D)⌉ 设定秩，α∈{0.8,0.6,0.4,0.2}，在Imagenette上直接以未微调的压缩模型评测Top-1/Top-5精度（保留原1000类输出层），报告压缩时间与压缩比。
AI.result: 单层实验：VGG19大层上RSVD(q=1)归一化误差约2，q=2降至约1.3，q=4约1.1（最优值=1）；运行时间上RSI在k=200时比精确SVD（2.33秒）快约76×(q=2)、51×(q=4)，即使k=1000仍快约一个数量级。ViT层上RSVD在k=500时归一化误差超过4，而q=3、q=4始终低于1.2；精确SVD约0.07秒 vs RSI(q=4,k=100)约0.007秒，约一个数量级加速。端到端：VGG19在α=0.2时RSVD Top-1跌至59.27%，而RSI(q=2/3/4)分别达77.50%/78.39%/78.63%（Top-5约95.2%），接近未压缩的82.57%/96.51%，压缩比0.36；ViT在α=0.4时q=4达77.15%/95.54%（压缩比0.68），而q=1仅16.82%/35.43%，α=0.2时所有方法均显著退化；最佳配置下压缩全部线性层耗时不足1秒。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实验共同表明，在奇异值谱缓慢衰减的预训练模型权重上，RSI在近似质量与端到端压缩后的预测精度两方面均优于RSVD，且能保持可观的计算加速；RSI还与LoRA等低秩适配方法互补（可先压缩骨干权重再做低秩适配）。作者指出三个未来方向：为transformer等含大量线性层的架构设计自适应的逐层秩选择策略；把随机低秩近似作为预训练模型低秩适配的统一框架；将方法推广到视觉-语言等多模态模型并支持模态特定的压缩比。局限方面：实验仅覆盖ImageNet/Imagenette上的VGG19与ViT-B/32视觉模型，无微调/再训练，未涉及更大规模模型与多模态实测，α过小（如ViT α=0.2）时性能仍会崩溃。

title: Learning the Signature of Memorization in Autoregressive Language Models
summary: All prior membership inference attacks for fine-tuned language models use hand-crafted heuristics (e.g., loss thresholding, Min-K\%, reference calibration), each bounded by the designer's intuition. We introduce the first transferable learned attack, enabled by the observation that fine-tuning any model on any corpus yields unlimited labeled data, since membership is known by construction. This removes the shadow model bottleneck and brings membership inference into the deep learning era: learning what matters rather than designing it, with generalization through training diversity and scale. We discover that fine-tuning language models produces an invariant signature of memorization detectable across architectural families and data domains. We train a membership inference classifier exclusively on transformer-based models. It transfers zero-shot to Mamba (state-space), RWKV-4 (linear attention), and RecurrentGemma (gated recurrence), achieving 0.963, 0.972, and 0.936 AUC respectively. Each evaluation combines an architecture and dataset never seen during training, yet all three exceed performance on held-out transformers (0.908 AUC). These four families share no computational mechanisms, their only commonality is gradient descent on cross-entropy loss. Even simple likelihood-based methods exhibit strong transfer, confirming the signature exists independently of the detection method. Our method, Learned Transfer MIA (LT-MIA), captures this signal most effectively by reframing membership inference as sequence classification over per-token distributional statistics. On transformers, LT-MIA achieves 2.8$\times$ higher TPR at 0.1\% FPR than the strongest baseline. The method also transfers to code (0.865 AUC) despite training only on natural language texts. Code and trained classifier available at https://github.com/JetBrains-Research/learned-mia.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个可迁移的机器学习Membership Inference Attack (MIA)方法LT-MIA，通过在transformer模型上训练分类器，实现跨架构（Transformer→Mamba/RWKV-4/RecurrentGemma）、跨领域（自然语言→代码）的零样本迁移攻击，无需使用shadow model。
AI.motivation: 现有MIA方法依赖手工设计的启发式规则（如loss thresholding、Min-K%），受限于设计者直觉；且传统方法需要shadow model生成训练数据，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 核心创新：利用微调数据的特性（成员资格已知）生成无限标注数据，突破shadow model瓶颈；将MIA重构为基于per-token分布统计的序列分类问题；通过训练数据的多样性和规模实现泛化。
AI.result: 在Transformer上，LT-MIA在0.1%FPR下达到2.8倍TPR超越最强baseline；零样本迁移至Mamba (0.963 AUC)、RWKV-4 (0.972 AUC)、RecurrentGemma (0.936 AUC)，均超越held-out transformer (0.908 AUC)；跨领域迁移至代码模型(0.865 AUC)。
AI.conclusion: 微调语言模型会产生跨架构家族和数据域可检测的记忆化不变量，梯度下降和交叉熵损失是唯一共同机制；简单的likelihood-based方法也表现出强迁移性，证实该signature独立于检测方法存在。

title: A Numerical Method for Coupling Parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks and FDM for Advanced Thermal-Hydraulic System Simulation
summary: Severe accident analysis using system-level codes such as MELCOR is indispensable for nuclear safety assessment, yet the computational cost of repeated simulations poses a significant bottleneck for parametric studies and uncertainty quantification. Existing surrogate models accelerate these analyses but depend on large volumes of simulation data, while physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) enable data-free training but must be retrained for every change in problem parameters. This study addresses both limitations by developing the Parameterized PINNs coupled with FDM (P2F) method, a node-assigned hybrid framework for MELCOR's Control Volume Hydrodynamics/Flow Path (CVH/FP) module. In the P2F method, a parameterized Node-Assigned PINN (NA-PINN) accepts the water-level difference, initial velocity, and time as inputs, learning a solution manifold so that a single trained network serves as a data-free surrogate for the momentum conservation equation across all flow paths without retraining. This PINN is coupled with a finite difference method (FDM) solver that advances the mass conservation equation at each time step, ensuring exact discrete mass conservation while replacing the iterative nonlinear momentum solve with a single forward pass. Verification on a six-tank gravity-driven draining scenario yields a water level mean absolute error of $7.85 \times 10^{-5}$ m and a velocity mean absolute error of $3.21 \times 10^{-3}$ m/s under the nominal condition with $Δt = 1.0$ s. The framework maintains consistent accuracy across time steps ranging from 0.2 to 1.0 s and generalizes to five distinct initial conditions, all without retraining or simulation data. This work introduces a numerical coupling methodology for integrating parameterized PINNs with FDM within a nuclear thermal-hydraulic system code framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 P2F（Parameterized PINNs coupled with FDM）方法：在 MELCOR 的 CVH/FP 模块中，将动量守恒方程交由"参数化节点分配 PINN"以单次前向推理求解，质量守恒方程仍由有限差分（FDM）推进，从而在完全不依赖仿真数据的前提下，既获得代理模型级的参数灵活性（初值变化无需重训），又通过逐步时间推进规避 PINN 长时程误差累积问题。六罐重力泄流算例验证：水位 MAE ~7.85×10⁻⁵ m、速度 MAE ~3.21×10⁻³ m/s（Δt=1.0 s），在 Δt=0.2~1.0 s 与 5 组不同初值下精度稳定。
AI.motivation: 严重事故分析依赖 MELCOR 等系统级程序，其 CVH/FP、RN 等多物理场模块耦合复杂、重复计算代价高昂，成为参数化研究与不确定性量化的瓶颈。现有两类替代方案各有缺陷：数据驱动代理模型需大量昂贵仿真数据且缺乏物理约束；而 PINN 虽可无数据训练，但只能针对单一初始/边界条件求解，参数一变就须完整重训，无法充当可复用的代理模型。此外 PINN 在长时间积分中误差累积，对需模拟数小时至数天的严重事故过程尤为不利。作者据此提炼两个空白：(1) 尚无面向集总参数热工水力系统程序的无数据代理模型；(2) 尚无在时间推进循环中把无数据 PINN 与传统数值求解器按节点交替分配、数据无关的混合耦合方法。
AI.method: ① 场景与方程：建立与 MELCOR CVH/FP 一致的六罐级联重力泄流模型（CV01–CV06、FL01–FL05，罐截面积 50 m²、高 2 m，管径 0.2 m、长 0.1 m，高差 1.8 m，全开大气）；开放罐假设下动量方程解耦，各流道仅依赖本地水位差 Δh 与摩擦项，可用迎风格式逐流道顺序求解。② 参数化 NA-PINN：单一全连接网络以 (Δh, v₀, t) 为输入、输出流道速度；三输入归一化；硬约束形式 v̂ = v₀ + t·NN_θ(·) 保证初值精确满足，损失仅含动量残差单一项 L∂v/∂t − gΔh + (K*/2)|v|v 的均方值；配点一次采样固定，并按比例 r_h0、r_v0 在 h=0、v₀=0 边界富集以强化零流量区；Adam + 分段学习率 + 梯度裁剪 + 验证集早停，全程无仿真数据。训练时域 T 设为 FDM 最大允许步长 Δt_max。③ P2F 耦合：每个时间步内，先由当前水位算驱动压头与空泡分数 α，再对各流道用单次 PINN 前向推理得 v^{n+1}，最后由 FDM 离散质量守恒方程更新各 CV 水位，保证离散意义下质量严格守恒；推理时仅查询 t=Δt 单点，Δt 可运行时灵活变化（Δt≤T）而无需重训。④ 验证：先做独立三点 (Δh,v₀)=(1.0,0)、(2.0,3.0)、(1.0,6.0) 的独立动量方程对比，再做标称工况 Δt=0.2/0.5/1.0 s 对比与 5 组未见初值泛化测试，并与参考 FDM 计时比较。
AI.result: 独立验证：三种输入条件下 PINN 与 FDM 参考解吻合，MAE 4.10×10⁻³~7.30×10⁻³ m/s、MSE 1.70×10⁻⁴~5.88×10⁻⁴ (m/s)²。混合框架标称工况：水位 MAE 9.32×10⁻⁵(Δt=0.2)、1.01×10⁻⁴(0.5)、7.85×10⁻⁵(1.0) m，MSE 9.92×10⁻⁹~2.26×10⁻⁸ m²；速度 MAE 3.08×10⁻³~5.55×10⁻³ m/s。误差不随 Δt 单调增大，Δt=1.0 s 与 0.2 s 精度相当。5 组初值（覆盖单罐满、多罐不等液位、零初始压头等）水位 MAE 稳定在 9.05×10⁻⁵~9.43×10⁻⁵ m，速度 MAE 3.24×10⁻³~4.17×10⁻³ m/s；Case 1 的同时泄流与液位交叉、Case 2 的 FL02 延迟启动等特征均被正确再现。计时上混合框架反而比参考 FDM 慢约 25 倍（速度比 0.04×），原因是 PINN 前向推理的浮点开销与主机—设备数据传输超过每流道摩擦迭代成本。
AI.conclusion: P2F 方法首次实现了面向核热工水力系统程序的无数据（无需仿真数据训练、无需按初值重训）代理框架，并首次实现无数据 PINN 与传统求解器在统一时间推进循环中的按节点混合耦合：PINN 以单次前向替代动量方程的迭代非线性求解，FDM 保留质量守恒以保证离散精确守恒，从而天然规避长时程误差累积。局限与后续工作：① 现仅适用于开放罐、单一固定流向的简化场景，需推广至含压力差、双向流动及 MELCOR 全局速度矩阵隐式耦合的闭环系统；② 仅覆盖 CVH/FP 模块，未来需整合 HS、RN 等模块构建多物理场框架；③ 当前速度上不具竞争力（约慢 25×），需在更复杂方程下系统基准测试以确定混合方案具备成本竞争力的工况区间。

title: BAS: A Decision-Theoretic Approach to Evaluating Large Language Model Confidence
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often produce confident but incorrect answers in settings where abstention would be safer. Standard evaluation protocols, however, require a response and do not account for how confidence should guide decisions under different risk preferences. To address this gap, we introduce the Behavioral Alignment Score (BAS), a decision-theoretic metric for evaluating how well LLM confidence supports abstention-aware decision making. BAS is derived from an explicit answer-or-abstain utility model and aggregates realized utility across a continuum of risk thresholds, yielding a measure of decision-level reliability that depends on both the magnitude and ordering of confidence. We show theoretically that truthful confidence estimates uniquely maximize expected BAS utility, linking calibration to decision-optimal behavior. BAS is related to proper scoring rules such as log loss, but differs structurally: log loss penalizes underconfidence and overconfidence symmetrically, whereas BAS imposes an asymmetric penalty that strongly prioritizes avoiding overconfident errors. Using BAS alongside widely used metrics such as ECE and AURC, we then construct a benchmark of self-reported confidence reliability across multiple LLMs and tasks. Our results reveal substantial variation in decision-useful confidence, and while larger and more accurate models tend to achieve higher BAS, even frontier models remain prone to severe overconfidence. Importantly, models with similar ECE or AURC can exhibit very different BAS due to highly overconfident errors, highlighting limitations of standard metrics. We further show that simple interventions, such as top-$k$ confidence elicitation and post-hoc calibration, can meaningfully improve confidence reliability. Overall, our work provides both a principled metric and a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating LLM confidence reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了行为对齐分数(BAS)——一种决策理论指标，用于评估大语言模型(LLM)的置信度如何支持"回答或弃权"的决策。BAS源于显式的"回答-弃权"效用模型，聚合不同风险阈值下的效用。理论证明真实置信度估计唯一最大化期望BAS效用。实验表明BAS能揭示标准指标(ECE、AURC)无法捕捉的过置信问题，且简单干预可提升置信度可靠性。
AI.motivation: LLM在不确定场景下常产生自信但错误的答案，而标准评估协议不考虑置信度如何指导不同风险偏好下的决策，存在安全风险。
AI.method: 提出BAS(Behavioral Alignment Score)指标，基于显式"回答-弃权"效用模型，跨风险阈值连续统聚合实际效用。理论证明真实置信度唯一最大化期望BAS。对比log loss的对称性惩罚，BAS采用非对称惩罚，强烈优先避免过度自信错误。
AI.result: 多模型多任务基准测试显示：1)模型决策置信度存在显著差异；2)更大更准确的模型BAS更高；3)前沿模型仍有严重过度自信问题；4)ECE/AURC相近的模型BAS差异大；5)简单干预(top-k置信度诱发、后验校准)可改善置信度可靠性。
AI.conclusion: BAS提供了评估LLM置信度可靠性的原则性指标和综合基准，弥补了ECE、AURC等标准指标的局限。

title: Cross-subject Muscle Fatigue Detection via Adversarial and Supervised Contrastive Learning with Inception-Attention Network
comment: This work has been submitted to ICARM 2026 for possible publication. 6 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables
summary: Muscle fatigue detection plays an important role in physical rehabilitation. Previous researches have demonstrated that sEMG offers superior sensitivity in detecting muscle fatigue compared to other biological signals. However, features extracted from sEMG may vary during dynamic contractions and across different subjects, which causes unstability in fatigue detection. To address these challenges, this research proposes a novel neural network comprising an Inception-attention module as a feature extractor, a fatigue classifier and a domain classifier equipped with a gradient reversal layer. The integrated domain classifier encourages the network to learn subject-invariant common fatigue features while minimizing subject-specific features. Furthermore, a supervised contrastive loss function is also employed to enhance the generalization capability of the model. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model achieved outstanding performance in three-class classification tasks, reaching 93.54% accuracy, 92.69% recall and 92.69% F1-score, providing a robust solution for cross-subject muscle fatigue detection, offering significant guidance for rehabilitation training and assistance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Inception-Attention-Domain-Adversarial-Net (IADAN)：以空洞卷积 + 注意力 + Inception 多尺度模块提取 sEMG 时频图特征，接一个疲劳分类头（NF/MF/SF 三分类）与一个带梯度反转层（GRL）的受试者域分类头，并联合监督对比损失进行跨被试训练。四折交叉验证平均准确率 93.54%、召回率 92.69%、F1 92.69%，显著优于消融模型与对比方法（ResNet+域对抗 86.32%、CLT-Net 71.60%、MFFNet 67.46%）。
AI.motivation: 表面肌电（sEMG）对肌肉疲劳检测灵敏，但特征在动态收缩过程中及不同被试之间存在显著变化与不稳定性，导致跨被试疲劳检测性能下降。传统时域/频域指标（RMS、中位频率、过零率）存在非线性和非平稳性，难以刻画疲劳生理过程；已有深度学习方法（如 MACNet）按被试划分训练，难以泛化到未见被试（如 MFFNet 仅 78.25%）。因此需要同时解决多尺度特征提取与被试不变性两个问题。
AI.method: 网络结构：特征提取器先经两层空洞卷积（膨胀率 D=2，核 7/5）+ReLU+BN+最大池化扩大感受野；交替堆叠 3 次 Inception 与注意力模块（通道注意力块 CAB + 空间注意力块 SAB），并加残差连接防止退化；Inception 采用 1×1 降维后 1/3/5 多尺度并行分支沿通道拼接；全局最大池化 + 全连接得到 128 维特征向量。分类部分：疲劳分类器为两层线性（128→64→3，ReLU+Dropout），对应非疲劳 NF、 中度疲劳 MF、重度疲劳 SF；域分类器结构类似但输出 9/被试数，串接 GRL 前向恒等、反向梯度乘 −λ，λ 按 k(2/(1+e^(−γp))−1) 动态增长（k=0.2, γ=5）。损失：L_total = L_fatigue + 0.5·L_SC + 0.8·L_domain，其中 SupCon 损失以相同疲劳标签为正样本对、温度 τ=0.05。数据：12 名健康被试（8 男 4 女）做单腿负重提踵，采集 6 块下肢肌肉 sEMG（Delsys Trigno，2000 Hz）与 IMU（100 Hz）；IMU 经 4 阶巴特沃斯低通（8 Hz）滤波并重采样至 500 Hz，用状态机分割静止/上升/保持/下降四阶段；sEMG 经 20–400 Hz 带通 + 50 Hz 陷波，以滑动窗（100 样本/步长 50）RMS 的 95 百分位作为 MVC 归一化，降采样至 500 Hz，截取保持相，经复 Morlet 小波（B=1.5, C=1.0）CWT 生成时频图，再做随机平移、缩放、遮挡增强。标签由 Borg CR-10 RPE 分三档（0–2、4–6、8–10，剔除边界附近样本）。训练 4 折交叉验证（每折 9 训 3 测），100 epochs，RTX 3060。
AI.result: 四折平均准确率 93.54%、召回率 92.69%、F1 92.69%（Fold1 达 95.28/94.91/95.09）。t-SNE 显示三种疲劳状态清晰成簇而被试身份混合，验证了被试不变特征学习；域分类损失先降后升体现对抗效应。结构消融：去注意力模块（IDAN）90.82%、去域分类器（ADAN）79.94%、IAN 87.47%。损失消融：仅 FCE 62.44%，FCE+DCE 81.87%，FCE+SC 87.47%，三者联合最佳。对比：ResNet+域对抗 86.32%，CLT-Net 71.60%，MFFNet 67.46%。
AI.conclusion: IADAN 通过多尺度 Inception-注意力特征提取与“域对抗 + 监督对比学习”联合优化，有效提取跨被试共享的疲劳特征，在三分类疲劳识别中取得 93.54% 的准确率，为康复训练中的跨被试肌肉疲劳监测提供了可行方案。局限性：GRL 中 λ 增长过快会导致损失振荡，需更多数据稳定训练；实验仅涉及单腿提踵这一单一动作，尚未覆盖步行、跳跃等多运动模式，跨被试与跨动作联合的疲劳检测仍待研究。

title: Finding Belief Geometries with Sparse Autoencoders
summary:
Understanding the geometric structure of internal representations is a central goal of mechanistic interpretability. Prior work has shown that transformers trained on sequences generated by hidden Markov models encode probabilistic belief states as simplex-shaped geometries in their residual stream, with vertices corresponding to latent generative states. Whether large language models trained on naturalistic text develop analogous geometric representations remains an open question.
  We introduce a pipeline for discovering candidate simplex-structured subspaces in transformer representations, combining sparse autoencoders (SAEs), $k$-subspace clustering of SAE features, and simplex fitting using AANet. We validate the pipeline on a transformer trained on a multipartite hidden Markov model with known belief-state geometry. Applied to Gemma-2-9B, we identify 13 priority clusters exhibiting candidate simplex geometry ($K \geq 3$).
  A key challenge is distinguishing genuine belief-state encoding from tiling artifacts: latents can span a simplex-shaped subspace without the mixture coordinates carrying predictive signal beyond any individual feature. We therefore adopt barycentric prediction as our primary discriminating test. Among the 13 priority clusters, 3 exhibit a highly significant advantage on near-vertex samples (Wilcoxon $p < 10^{-14}$) and 4 on simplex-interior samples. Together 5 distinct real clusters pass at least one split, while no null cluster passes either. One cluster, 768_596, additionally achieves the highest causal steering score in the dataset. This is the only case where passive prediction and active intervention converge. We present these findings as preliminary evidence that genuine belief-like geometry exists in Gemma-2-9B's representation space, and identify the structured evaluation that would be required to confirm this interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合稀疏自编码器(SAE)、k-子空间聚类和AANet单纯形拟合的管道，用于发现Transformer表示中的单纯形结构子空间。在Gemma-2-9B模型中识别出13个优先聚类，其中5个通过重心预测测试，验证了大型语言模型中可能存在类似信念状态的单纯形几何结构。
AI.motivation: 可解释性领域的一个核心问题是：理解Transformer内部表示的几何结构。先前研究表明，在隐马尔可夫模型序列上训练的Transformer会将概率信念状态编码为单纯形几何结构，但大型语言模型在自然语言文本上训练后是否发展出类似的几何表示仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 研究团队提出了一套完整管道：(1)使用稀疏自编码器(SAE)进行特征提取；(2)对SAE特征进行k-子空间聚类；(3)使用AANet进行单纯形拟合。首先在已知信念状态几何的隐马尔可夫模型上验证了管道有效性，然后应用于Gemma-2-9B模型。
AI.result: 在Gemma-2-9B中识别出13个优先聚类表现出候选单纯形几何结构(K≥3)。通过重心预测测试，3个聚类在顶点附近样本上表现显著优势(Wilcoxon p < 10⁻¹⁴)，4个在单纯形内部样本上显著。5个不同聚类至少通过一种分割测试，而所有零假设聚类均未通过。其中聚类768_596还获得了数据集中最高的因果干预得分。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了初步证据表明Gemma-2-9B的表示空间中可能存在类似信念状态的真正几何结构。同时指出需要更结构化的评估来确认这一解释，并强调了区分真实信念状态编码与平铺伪影的重要性——单纯形结构的存在并不必然意味着混合坐标携带超越单个特征的预测信号。

title: Beyond Semantic Manipulation: Token-Space Attacks on Reward Models
summary: Reward models (RMs) are widely used as optimization targets in reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), yet they remain vulnerable to reward hacking. Existing attacks mainly operate within the semantic space, constructing human-readable adversarial outputs that exploit RM biases. In this work, we introduce a fundamentally different paradigm: Token Mapping Perturbation Attack (TOMPA), a framework that performs adversarial optimization directly in token space. By bypassing the standard decode-re-tokenize interface between the policy and the reward model, TOMPA enables the attack policy to optimize over raw token sequences rather than coherent natural language. Using only black-box scalar feedback, TOMPA automatically discovers non-linguistic token patterns that elicit extremely high rewards across multiple state-of-the-art RMs. Specifically, when targeting Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B, TOMPA nearly doubles the reward of GPT-5 reference answers and outperforms them on 98.0% of prompts. Despite these high scores, the generated outputs degenerate into nonsensical text, revealing that RMs can be systematically exploited beyond the semantic regime and exposing a critical vulnerability in current RLHF pipelines.

AI.tldr: TOMPA是一种在token空间进行对抗性优化的攻击框架，通过绕过解码-再分词接口，直接在原始token序列上优化，从而发现能够诱使奖励模型给出极高分数的非语言token模式。该攻击能够使SOTA奖励模型的分数翻倍，但输出退化为无意义文本，揭示了当前RLHF流程中的关键安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有的奖励模型攻击主要在语义空间操作，构造人类可读的对抗性输出以利用RM偏差。本文认为这种范式存在根本性局限，需要探索完全不同的攻击路径。
AI.method: TOMPA通过绕过策略与奖励模型之间的标准decode-re-tokenize接口，直接在token空间进行对抗性优化。使用黑盒标量反馈，自动发现能够跨多个SOTA RM引发极高奖励的非语言token模式。
AI.result: 针对Skywork-Reward-V2-Llama-3.1-8B，TOMPA使GPT-5参考答案的奖励几乎翻倍，在98.0%的提示上优于基线。尽管获得高分数，生成输出退化为无意义文本。
AI.conclusion: 奖励模型可以在语义机制之外被系统性利用，这暴露了当前RLHF流程中的关键漏洞。RMs的优化目标与其实际语义理解能力之间存在严重偏差。

title: Adaptive Semantic Communication for Wireless Image Transmission Leveraging Mixture-of-Experts Mechanism
summary: Deep learning based semantic communication has achieved significant progress in wireless image transmission, but most existing schemes rely on fixed models and thus lack robustness to diverse image contents and dynamic channel conditions. To improve adaptability, recent studies have developed adaptive semantic communication strategies that adjust transmission or model behavior according to either source content or channel state. More recently, MoE-based semantic communication has emerged as a sparse and efficient adaptive architecture, although existing designs still mainly rely on single-driven routing. To address this limitation, we propose a novel multi-stage end-to-end image semantic communication system for multi-input multi-output (MIMO) channels, built upon an adaptive MoE Swin Transformer block. Specifically, we introduce a dynamic expert gating mechanism that jointly evaluates both real-time CSI and the semantic content of input image patches to compute adaptive routing probabilities. By selectively activating only a specialized subset of experts based on this joint condition, our approach breaks the rigid coupling of traditional adaptive methods and overcomes the bottlenecks of single-driven routing. Simulation results indicate a significant improvement in reconstruction quality over existing methods while maintaining the transmission efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向MIMO衰落信道的多阶段端到端图像语义通信系统，其核心是“自适应混合专家Swin Transformer块”（AD-MoE STBlock）：门控机制联合实时CSI与图像块语义内容计算路由概率，并以权重差阈值自适应决定激活的专家数量；配合负载均衡、熵正则与专家利用率方差惩罚三项辅助损失抑制专家坍缩，在保持传输带宽效率的同时显著提升重建质量（PSNR/LPIPS优于DeepJSCC与SwinJSCC）。
AI.motivation: 传统语义通信基于Shannon比特传输范式，忽略数据内在含义，难以应对带宽瓶颈；深度学习语义通信（从CNN到Transformer）虽提升了性能，但计算开销与推理时延随之上升，且大多依赖固定模型，缺乏对多样图像内容与动态信道条件的适应能力。已有自适应方案分为内容自适应（如内容感知注意力融合）与信道自适应（如JSCCformer-f的块级信道反馈、SNR-EQ-JSCC的SNR嵌入与SNR查询注意力）两类，二者均依赖辅助模块直接融合侧信息与语义特征，造成刚性耦合、特征纯度下降与可扩展性受限；而已有MoE语义通信工作只关注内容驱动或信道驱动之一，缺少统一的联合驱动路由机制。
AI.method: 1）总体架构：四级编码器，前两级用卷积层在高分辨率快速提取特征，后两级采用AD-MoE STBlocks在低分辨率提取深层特征；图像切块后经5×5卷积（stride 2）嵌入为C₁维表示，各阶段间用LayerNorm+FC降采样；W-MSA与SW-MSA交替以兼顾局部与跨窗交互；输出经FC投影到C维后分配至N_t根发射天线与K个时隙构成传输矩阵y∈C^{N_t×K}，功率归一化后经MIMO衰落信道ŷ=hy+n（h∈C^{N_r×N_t}，n~CN(0,σ²)）；解码器与编码器对称（patch division、上采样层、AD-MoE STBlocks、FC）。2）AD-MoE MLP：含E^s个共享专家（恒激活）与E^r个路由专家，路由器联合输入特征与CSI生成路由权重；动态门控按权重排序，先选最高权重专家，再比较相邻权重差——差值小于阈值T则继续激活候选专家，差值超过T或达到上限k时停止，从而自适应确定激活专家数量；共享与路由专家输出聚合为FFN输出。3）训练：主损失为重建图像与原图的MSE，并附加三项辅助损失——负载均衡损失L_b=E^r·Σf_i p_i、熵正则L_e（防止路由收敛到确定性分配）、专家利用率方差惩罚L_v（防止个别专家系统性欠利用），总损失L=L_MSE+λL_b−αL_e+βL_v。4）设置：4阶段，[N₁..N₄]=[2,2,6,2]，[C₁..C₄]=[128,192,256,320]，E^s=1、E^r=5、k=2、窗口大小8；DIV2K训练（900张高分辨率图）、Kodak测试，图像裁剪为256×256，初始学习率10⁻⁴，NVIDIA RTX A6000；以带宽比R=K/(H×W×3)衡量信道使用效率。
AI.result: 在MIMO衰落信道下（2×2与8×8天线配置）以Kodak数据集评估：所提方法在所有SNR与带宽比下PSNR均优于DeepJSCC与SwinJSCC，LPIPS在多数SNR与带宽比下亦优于SwinJSCC（与SwinJSCC的对比同时构成加入AD-MoE STBlock的消融验证）；视觉对比图显示重建细节更清晰。在SNR=10 dB、R=0.0833条件下于CLIC2021数据集60张图像上统计最后一层AD-MoE STBlock的专家激活频率：5个专家被较均衡地利用，无过度使用现象，平均每张图像仅激活1.683个专家，验证了稀疏激活与动态激活数量控制的有效性，同时保持传输效率不变。
AI.conclusion: 将新型自适应MoE架构集成进Swin Transformer骨干，构建了高效鲁棒的无线图像语义通信系统；通过联合视觉语义与瞬时MIMO CSI形成最优路由策略，并配合动态专家门控机制智能调节激活专家数量，突破了模型容量与计算复杂度之间的刚性权衡，在保持带宽效率的前提下于标准数据集上显著优于基线方法。局限与后续方向：训练与评估规模仍有限（仅DIV2K/Kodak/CLIC2021、单一信道模型与单一分辨率），未见与JSCCformer-f、SNR-EQ-JSCC等自适应方法的直接对比，跨信道模型/跨数据集泛化性有待验证。

title: LieTrunc-QNN: Lie Algebra Truncation and Quantum Expressivity Phase Transition from LiePrune to Provably Stable Quantum Neural Networks
summary:
Quantum Machine Learning (QML) is fundamentally limited by two challenges: barren plateaus (exponentially vanishing gradients) and the fragility of parameterized quantum circuits under noise. Despite extensive empirical studies, a unified theoretical framework remains lacking.
  We introduce LieTrunc-QNN, an algebraic-geometric framework that characterizes trainability via Lie-generated dynamics. Parameterized quantum circuits are modeled as Lie subalgebras of u(2^n), whose action induces a Riemannian manifold of reachable quantum states. Expressivity is reinterpreted as intrinsic manifold dimension and geometry.
  We establish a geometric capacity-plateau principle: increasing effective dimension leads to exponential gradient suppression due to concentration of measure. By restricting to structured Lie subalgebras (LieTrunc), the manifold is contracted, preventing concentration and preserving non-degenerate gradients.
  We prove two main results: (1) a trainability lower bound for LieTrunc-QNN, and (2) that the Fubini-Study metric rank is bounded by the algebraic span of generators, showing expressivity is governed by structure rather than parameter count. Compact Lie subalgebras also provide inherent robustness to perturbations.
  Importantly, we establish a polynomial trainability regime where gradient variance decays polynomially instead of exponentially.
  Experiments (n=2-6) validate the theory: LieTrunc-QNN maintains stable gradients and high effective dimension, while random truncation leads to metric rank collapse. At n=6, full metric rank is preserved (rank=16). Results support a scaling law between gradient variance and effective dimension.
  This work provides a unified geometric framework for QNN design, linking Lie algebra, manifold geometry, and optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LieTrunc-QNN框架，将参数化量子电路(PQC)建模为u(2^n)中的Lie子代数，并把其作用诱导的可达量子态流形视为CP^{2^n-1}上的黎曼子流形。其核心结论是：量子 expressive(表达能力)实为该流形的本征维度与FS度规几何性质；当有效维度d_eff增大时，因测度集中现象梯度方差呈指数衰减(barren plateau)，而通过将生成元Lie代数结构化截断(LieTrunc)使流形收缩，可获得首个"可证明的多项式可训练性"区间——梯度方差仅按n^{-k}衰减。实验(n=2..6)显示：随机截断导致FS度规秩塌缩至2(d_eff≈2)，而LieTrunc在n=6时保持满秩rank(G)=16、d_eff=13.36、梯度方差1.16，优于完整PQC基线(2.00)。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习受两大瓶颈制约：(1) barren plateau——参数梯度方差随量子比特数与电路深度指数消失，使基于梯度的优化不可行；(2) 噪声敏感性——NISQ设备的退相干与门误差导致量子演化不稳定、性能严重退化。同时，现有QNN架构依赖启发式电路构造，缺乏统一理论框架来刻画、预测并控制表达能力、可训练性与鲁棒性。作者延续其前作LiePrune的思路(利用参数空间动力学的Lie代数结构做结构化压缩)，追问"结构化Lie代数约简能否推广到量子神经网络，从而在NISQ环境下同时获得可证明的可训练性与内在鲁棒性"。其核心观点是：这些瓶颈本质上是几何性的，而非纯算法或经验性的——PQC诱导Lie群在量子态空间上的作用，barren plateau是高维黎曼流形上测度集中的直接后果。
AI.method: 1) 几何重构：将态空间取为Kähler流形CP^{2^n-1}，定义可达流形M={U(θ)|ψ0>}；由生成元的Lie闭包得电路Lie代数g_circ⊂u(2^n)，并证明切空间刻画T|ψ>M={X|ψ>:X∈g_circ}/~（模去U(1)全局相位纤维）。2) 度规与有效维度：在CP上取Fubini–Study度规，定义参数空间拉回度量g_ij(θ)=Re[⟨∂iψ|∂jψ⟩−⟨∂iψ|ψ⟩⟨ψ|∂jψ⟩]，并给出实用估计量；定义有效维度d_eff=(Tr g)^2/Tr(g^2)，条件数κ(g)=‖g‖op‖g^{-1}‖op。3) 梯度谱分解：由dU_θ的SVD导出∇_θL=Σσ_i⟨df,v_i⟩u_i及Var(∇_θL)=Σσ_i^2Var(⟨df,v_i⟩)，得到通用标度律Var(∇_θL)≍O(1/(κ(g)·d_eff))。4) 定理集：定理3.9(barren plateau的测度集中起源 Var≤C·exp(−c·d_eff))；定理3.11(多项式可训练性：若d_eff=O(n^k)且度规良态，则Var≥Ω(n^{-k}))；定理6.1(生成元张成定理：rank(G)≤dim span{H_1,…,H_L}，即表达能力由生成元的代数张成而非参数数目决定)。5) LieTrunc算法(Algorithm 1)：在保持生成元张成与有界伴随谱的前提下选取结构化Lie子代数g_trunc⊊g_circ，得M_trunc={exp(X)|ψ0>:X∈g_trunc}，形成"Lie约简⇔流形收缩⇔切空间约简"三层等价的几何正则化流水线；并以推前测度与Jacobian范数引理给出分析基础，用紧Lie子代数的扰动稳定性界提供免纠错的内在鲁棒性。6) 实验：在固定深度下对n=2..6的Full PQC / RandomTrunc / LieTrunc三种架构，测量梯度方差、d_eff、任务损失与FS度规谱/秩，检验Var·d_eff≈常数。
AI.result: n=6结果：Full PQC出现明显barren plateau，d_eff=12.41、rank(G)=16、梯度方差2.00；RandomTrunc发生灾难性秩塌缩，rank(G)→2、d_eff→1.99，其低方差源于功能崩溃而非优化改善；LieTrunc-QNN保持满秩16、d_eff=13.36、梯度方差1.16，且任务损失稳定且优于RandomTrunc与Full基线。FS度规特征谱显示Full与LieTrunc具有丰富谱结构而RandomTrunc完全塌缩。Var(∇_θL)·d_eff在各架构与规模下近似恒定，直接验证几何容量–高原原理与通用标度律。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出统一的代数–几何框架：量子表达能力、可训练性与鲁棒性由可达态流形的几何性质（尤其是有效维度与FS度规谱）共同决定，而非由电路参数数目决定；过多表达能力通过测度集中导致梯度指数抑制，而结构化Lie代数约简则实现可控的流形收缩，从而维持非退化梯度。核心贡献是首个"可证明的多项式可训练性"区间（梯度方差至多按多项式衰减），并证明紧Lie子代数带来有界演化与免显式纠错的内在噪声鲁棒性。实验在n=2~6上验证理论预测，为可训练、可扩展的QNN设计提供了从启发式构造走向几何感知范式的路径；未来方向包括硬件感知的LieTrunc编译、更深的度规谱分析与大规模量子/混合系统扩展。

title: FluxMoE: Decoupling Expert Residency for High-Performance MoE Serving
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become a dominant paradigm for scaling large language models, but their rapidly growing parameter sizes introduce a fundamental inefficiency during inference: most expert weights remain idle in GPU memory while competing with performance-critical runtime state such as the key-value (KV) cache. Since KV cache capacity directly determines serving throughput, this mismatch leads to underutilized memory and degraded performance. In this paper, we present FluxMoE, a new MoE inference system that decouples expert parameters from persistent GPU residency. FluxMoE introduces an expert paging abstraction that treats expert weights as streamed, transient resources, materializing them on demand and evicting them immediately after use, allowing GPU memory to be preferentially allocated to throughput-critical runtime state. We implement FluxMoE atop vLLM to enable efficient MoE inference under severe memory constraints. Experimental results demonstrate that FluxMoE achieves up to 3.0$\times$ throughput gains over vLLM in memory-intensive regimes, without compromising model fidelity.

AI.tldr: FluxMoE是一个基于vLLM的MoE推理系统，通过将专家权重作为流式瞬态资源进行按需调度，释放GPU内存用于KV缓存等关键运行时状态，在内存受限场景下实现高达3.0倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: MoE模型虽利于扩展，但推理时大量专家权重在GPU内存中处于闲置状态，与性能关键的KV缓存形成内存竞争，导致GPU内存利用率低、吞吐量受限。现有系统将专家权重持续驻留GPU，造成资源浪费。
AI.method: 提出专家分页抽象（expert paging abstraction），将专家权重视为流式瞬态资源，按需物化（materialize）使用后立即驱逐（evant）。在vLLM基础上实现FluxMoE，支持极端内存约束下的高效MoE推理。
AI.result: 在内存密集型场景下，FluxMoE相比vLLM实现最高3.0倍吞吐量提升，且不影响模型精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦专家参数与持久GPU驻留，使内存分配优先保障吞吐量关键的运行时状态，为MoE模型的高效推理提供了可行的系统级解决方案。

title: Generative Frontiers: Why Evaluation Matters for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models have seen exciting recent progress, offering far more flexibility in generative trajectories than autoregressive models. This flexibility has motivated a growing body of research into new approaches to diffusion language modeling, which typically begins at the scale of GPT-2 small (150 million parameters). However, these advances introduce new issues with evaluation methodology. In this technical note, we discuss the limitations of current methodology and propose principled augmentations to ensure reliable comparisons. We first discuss why OpenWebText has become the standard benchmark, and why alternatives such as LM1B are inherently less meaningful. We then discuss the limitations of likelihood evaluations for diffusion models, and explain why relying on generative perplexity alone as a metric can lead to uninformative results. To address this, we show that generative perplexity and entropy are two components of the KL divergence to a reference distribution. This decomposition explains generative perplexity's sensitivity to entropy, and naturally suggests generative frontiers as a principled method for evaluating model generative quality. We conclude with empirical observations on model quality at this scale. We include a blog post with interactive content to illustrate the argument at https://patrickpynadath1.github.io/blog/eval_methodology/.

AI.tldr: 本文讨论扩散语言模型的评估方法论问题，指出当前标准的局限性，并提出基于KL散度分解和生成边界的改进评估框架。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型相比自回归模型具有更灵活的生成轨迹，但现有评估方法（如使用OpenWebText基准和似然评估）存在根本性问题，导致模型比较不可靠。
AI.method: 1) 分析OpenWebText成为标准基准的原因及LM1B的局限性；2) 将生成困惑度分解为熵和生成分布与参考分布的KL散落两个分量；3) 提出生成边界(generative frontiers)作为评估生成质量的原则性方法。
AI.result: 揭示了生成困惑度对熵变化的敏感性来源，建立了生成困惑度-熵-KL散度的数学联系，并说明为何仅依赖生成困惑度会产生误导性结论。
AI.conclusion: 在GPT-2 small规模(150M参数)下进行扩散语言模型评估时，应采用生成边界方法替代单一生成困惑度指标，以确保模型质量比较的可靠性和信息量。

title: Understanding Latent Diffusability via Fisher Geometry
summary: Diffusion models often degrade when trained in latent spaces (e.g., VAEs), yet the formal causes remain poorly understood. We quantify latent-space diffusability through the rate of change of the Minimum Mean Squared Error (MMSE) along the diffusion trajectory. Our framework decomposes this MMSE rate into contributions from Fisher Information (FI) and Fisher Information Rate (FIR). We demonstrate that while global isometry ensures FI alignment, FIR is governed by the encoder's local geometric properties. Our analysis explicitly decouples latent geometric distortion into three measurable penalties: dimensional compression, tangential distortion, and curvature injection. We derive theoretical conditions for FIR preservation across spaces, ensuring maintained diffusability. Experiments across diverse autoencoding architectures validate our framework and establish these efficient FI and FIR metrics as a robust diagnostic suite for identifying and mitigating latent diffusion failure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散模型在潜在空间（如VAE）中训练时性能下降的问题，通过最小均方误差（MMSE）变化率来量化潜在空间的可扩散性，并将MMSE变化率分解为Fisher信息（FI）和Fisher信息率（FIR），揭示了几何失真的三个可测量惩罚项。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在潜在空间中训练时性能下降的根本原因尚不清楚，缺乏系统的诊断工具来识别和缓解潜在扩散失败。
AI.method: 通过MMSE沿扩散轨迹的变化率来量化潜在空间的可扩散性，将MMSE变化率分解为FI和FIR两部分，分析全局等距性确保FI对齐，而FIR由编码器的局部几何特性控制。将潜在几何失真解耦为三个可测量惩罚：维度压缩、切向失真和曲率注入。
AI.result: 建立了FI和FIR作为诊断工具，能有效识别和缓解潜在扩散失败。理论推导出了跨空间FIR保持的条件。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的FI和FIR指标可作为诊断潜在扩散失败的鲁棒工具套件，实验验证了该框架在不同自编码器架构上的有效性。

title: STDDN: A Physics-Guided Deep Learning Framework for Crowd Simulation
summary: Accurate crowd simulation is crucial for public safety management, emergency evacuation planning, and intelligent transportation systems. However, existing methods, which typically model crowds as a collection of independent individual trajectories, are limited in their ability to capture macroscopic physical laws.
